reviews.title: Nice service
reviews.text: Perhaps I’m spoiled by the many steakhouses I can choose from in the New York metro area where I live, so I guess J & G is an unfortunate victim of the comparisons I can make. This place had lovely service in a lively space, but it’s just not a NY Steakhouse. I guess I expected more. It was good, but not worth the big price tag.
reviews.author: Kara M

reviews.title: posh/tranquil property, J & G Stake House food didn't stick out
reviews.text: My sister from Bay area was visiting me so I took her to dinner at the J & G Stake House J & G Stake House at the Phoenician.  The drive through the resort property did not disappoint with its breath taking gorgeous landscape. The posh and tranquil scenic garden tarain ooze luxury elegance with beautiful architectural interesting buildings weaved through the grounds. The hotel marble laden lobby emulates the Renaissance period. Unfortunately as welcoming as the ambience made us feel, one of their, apparently regular, patron made it clear we were not welcome. As for the J & G Restaurant I went with high anticipation but unfortunately what we ordered was very underwhelming.  Lobster Mac and Cheese, the Lobster pieces were chewy and the roux or rue was not developed, very grainy, the crab cakes had minced crab and very little of it, mostly filling  My Sister's stake was just ok.  Overall wanted this place to be great but just Ok.
reviews.author: Donna D

reviews.title: Very, very nice
reviews.text:
Absolutely loved everything about our experience at the J & G Steakhouse. Great atmosphere (lively but not too lively), we had a nice table to take in the fabulous view, the service was impeccable, and everything we ate was superb. Light brioche bread roll, delightful gruyère and truffle appetiser, the porterhouse steak was cooked to perfection and melt in the mouth, and our scallop dish was just delicious. Generous sides of asparagus and potato gratin were also first class. 
For us the J & G Steakhouse was faultless and worth every penny.
reviews.author: LSMS

reviews.title: Nice view
reviews.text: Food was really good and Jose was excellent server. Need better signage inside hotel to restaurant. We were not staying at hotel so were a bit confused. Menu prices need to be UPDATED ! Prices are DOUBLE what are listed on this site
reviews.author: Tesa I

reviews.title: Very helpful servers
reviews.text: Very lovely servers - both the main lady waitress and the lady who cut the steak.  This creates a nice friendly atmosphere.  There is a nice view outside across the whole resort with pretty sunsets.  Good advice about the portions - they are huge and can easily be shared.  Nice bread and butter.  Could do with better choice of soft drinks - tomato juice, cloudy apple juice.  If you want to access via stairs (I don't use elevators) a member of staff will take you to the restaurant via stairs.
reviews.author: LAW64

reviews.title: Noisy restaurant hurts the experience
reviews.text:
We were staying at the hotel so booked two dinners here for our family of six. Our table was next to the bar which was noisy, the live music was also too loud for a dinner restaurant and then the booth where we sat was right on top of another booth with young kids that sat at the same time. Overall the atmosphere was way too crowded and loud to be enjoyable especially at this price point. 
The food was mixed. The calamari had a tempura type batter and a citrus dip neither of which we cared for. The Caesar salad was bland. I had the salmon which was tasty but cold, my family enjoyed the steaks. The wine list is limited and way over priced. 
The view is probably good from the deck or window seats but not from the booths. 
The service was attentive but overall we weren’t that impressed so we canceled the second reservation.
reviews.author: FamilyOf6

reviews.title: Birthday dinner
reviews.text: Steak was tender and perfectly cooked.  Shrimp on the side had a tasty grilled flavor.  The Caymus wine by the glass was excellent, even if it wasn’t the flagship brand. Vegan coconut ice cream was an excellent touch for my diary intolerant wife.
reviews.author: AD

reviews.title: Great food, great service
reviews.text: This is a great steakhouse with great service. Daniel at the bar/bar area is incredible. He is personable, kind, attentive, and provides great service. The food is great as well.
reviews.author: Kapanda

reviews.title: Thumbs up!
reviews.text: Great view, great service and great food. J&G far exceeded any expectations I had going in. We would definitely return.
reviews.author: alimentoD

reviews.title: Breathtaking views and friendly staff -  get a table at the window!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Phoenician overnight in Jan 2025 and dined at J&G.  

The restaurant is on a top floor of the hotel, and the floor to ceiling windows and outdoor balcony/patio with fire pits provide a truly breathtaking view of Phoenix city lights after dark.  Ask for a table at the window  !

The service was unexpectedly slow, and we waited at least 15 min after being seated to get menus, water, or honestly acknowledgement.  Granted, it was the week of the Barrett Jackson car show, and I'm sure they were busier than usual.

I ordered a glass of red Bordeaux, and it tasted off (corked/spoiled) - they were gracious to replace with a pinot noir and did not charge me. 

The popover like bread was a nice presentation, but not crispy outside or soft inside, like most popovers and honestly tasted similar to Hawaiian rolls from the store.  Very edible but nothing overly unique or delicacy. 

The caesar salad was very good - unique with lemon flavoring, certainly not a traditional caesar, if that's what one's looking for, but excellent greens, nicely presented and very tasty.

The mashed potatoes were to die for.  Creamiest, tangiest, most delicious I've had in a long time (and we are steakhouse regulars).  Don't miss them.  The asparagus was excellent, just slight crisp on outside but tender inside, with tasty but glaze but not overpowering. 

The steaks were a bit of a letdown.  I ordered filet medium well, and wife ordered Ribeye medium rare -  and unfortunately they reversed those, so neither of us got what we had wanted/ordered  - but we were both so hungry from slow service that night we didn't want to wait and start over, so just ate as is.  Regardless of the mis-cooked nature (although i'm sure it biased us) , we both felt neither steak to be among the top 5 (or maybe even top 10) of steakhouses we visit in the valley.  They were good, but little fattier and/or tougher  than we are used to.   Very edible, but nothing that knocked our socks off, and at the fairly elevated prices this establishment carries, it was honestly a disappointment.

The deserts were amazing. We had the chocolate cake with caramel ice cream, and the apple crisp with ice cream , both of which melted in one's mouth and were just delicious!

We both felt it was a unique place we would go back, perhaps for a lunch or happy hour drinks and burger on the patio, but perhaps less likely for an elegant dinner.

I would give a 5 stars for atmosphere, and 3-4 for food/service...
reviews.author: Dan M

reviews.title: Top notch high end AND celiac friendly
reviews.text: Amazing all around!  I went with my family including 2 children.  Great atmosphere, service, and food.  Attention to detail including accommodations for celiac (gluten allergy).  Carefully noted what items could be prepared celiac safe (not just gluten free), including gluten free bread which delighted my child.  Filet mignon was perfectly prepared as were the scallops and all the sides and appetizers.  Truly a top notch high end dining experience!
reviews.author: Seaside766334

reviews.title: Steakhouse worth every penny!
reviews.text: Definitely a splurge, but every bite of everything we ate was perfect.  My husband remembered a great au poivre steak fondly from a previous Phoenix trip- just as good as he remembered.  We also shared incredible Thai chili butternut squash soup to start and incomparable potato au gratin as a side.  The service is exacting and views of Phoenix amazing.
reviews.author: Jamie S

reviews.title: Highly recommend for great food and service.
reviews.text: Great food, service and the most beautiful sunset ever. We were celebrating a birthday and they gave the birthday guy dessert with happy birthday written in chocolate. The next day, I received a call asking how our meal and service was. Very customer oriented. The Phoenician Resort is beautiful too.
reviews.author: Lori A

reviews.title: Fantastic View and 1st rate service.
reviews.text: View at sunset was amazing.  We sat inside due to high heat but they have a nice outdoor seating area. Service was impeccable. My steak was cooked perfectly and aides were good too.
reviews.author: Shirley G

reviews.title: Fantastic, Intimate Dinners!
reviews.text: We had dinner here twice while staying at the Canyon Suites. Located on the 5th floor away from the hustle and bustle of the lobby, it was a beautifully intimate place with wonderful views of the pool and Phoenix. All of the staff were friendly and helpful, the dinners were exceptional both times, and their wine list has some beauties on it that we purchased. Definitely would come back here again!
reviews.author: ECTraveler

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant, fantastic food, and impeccable service. My husband and I celebrated our wedding anniversary there. Have nothing but compliments for J & G.
reviews.author: Farrah G

reviews.title: Great atmosphere, beautiful views,  but surprisingly average food
reviews.text:
Great atmosphere, beautiful views,  but surprisingly average food.  
Had an assortment of items including calamari, crab cake, steak, cream spinach. 
Overall the food is OK, except the watery cream spinach was just bad. 

The waiters & service was good, but we did wait a long time to order and receive drinks.  It's still a nice restaurant, just lower your expectations & don't order too much.
reviews.author: HowTraveler

reviews.title: Amazing view!
reviews.text: The view is incredible and worth every penny! The food itself is pretty good, but not amazing. Overall, it’s a solid choice for a celebration dinner or romantic night out. The staff were friendly and accommodating. We will be back for sure! Good spot!
reviews.author: Greatoutdoors23

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Great option. Great food, wine selection, atmosphere, service and fantastic view. Would definitely recommend and go back.
reviews.author: lgd007

reviews.title: Amazing steaks and views
reviews.text: My family of four (including 6 & 3 y/o kids) had a reservation here the first night we checked into the hotel. They were super accommodating with the kids, splitting a specialty drink and a kids entree between the two. My wife and I both had filets, while there was a slight hiccup with temperature they took care of it immediately. The lobster shells and cheese were underwhelming especially for the price. The cheesecake and warm chocolate cake were very good. The views at sunset were beautiful! Pricey but worth it.
reviews.author: Justin M

reviews.title: Excellent restaurant
reviews.text:
Our dinner was awesome
The employees are so welcoming and kind exceptional customer service
The salmon was out of this world
Sea bass and steak was also amazing
We come here every year and will continue since we never leave disappointed with our dinner's
reviews.author: Sun236

reviews.title: It's that good.
reviews.text:
J & G Steakhouse nestled atop the posh Phoenician in the foothills of the Camelback Mountains offers a comprehensive menu of steakhouse classics. The restaurant portrays a sophisticated vibe and is draped in a rich palate of purple and gold with a modern swanky atmosphere. The food catalogue showcases stellar steaks, incredible seafood, top-notch cocktails & a spectacular wine list. Starters like tuna tartare and crag cakes set the bar high for apps, but I choose French Onion soup and Crispy Calamari....I love calamari. There is a mouthwatering 'from the grill' option for everyone........from the 10 oz. peppercorn prime New York Steak or Lamb T Bone to the 30 oz. Wagyu Tomahawk Ribeye....all saucy meats. I fell for the Sauteed Dover Sole ........ the fish melted in my mouth as did the sides of Potato Gratin and Steamed  Broccoli. The J & G Cheesecake was a great sweet tooth fixer.
J & G pairs award-winning premier meats with a global selection of seafood complemented by fresh local ingredients and worldly spices. It's that good.
reviews.author: Conny Wylie

reviews.title: Amazing dinner at J&G Steakhouse
reviews.text: Oh boy. We had been in an AirBnB in Scottsdale with family for Christmas. Decided to send the family home and spend some "couple time" at the Phoenician Spa. J&G was on the list and we were not disappointed. Our server Isaac and his assistant Abighail were phenomenal. All of there recommendations were spot on. The squash butternut soup to the NY Strip with the Wine pairing were perfect. The sticky toffee pudding was the icing on the cake.
reviews.author: nickfulton

reviews.title: Not a quality steak
reviews.text: Steak was tougher tougher than a turtle shell.  Went for my 60th birthday with my wife and 2 other couples.  Our waiter was very good, the bread seemed like it was purchased at the grocery store and heated up.  The big loser was the steak, I ordered medium rare and it was well done which was bad enough but it was slightly more tender than beef jerky. My friend got the same steak and his was cooked correctly but still very tough.  Ruth Chris price which is okay but golden  corral quality is not.
reviews.author: rdatma1

reviews.title: Terrible Experience!  Staff unfriendly, decor dour, many empty tables wouldn’t  seat us early. Save your money, stay way
reviews.text: Staff were unfriendly and unhelpful. Would not seat us early even though many tables open and we were hotel guests.  The bar tables/couches were empty but we were told we had to “sit at the bar” but the bar seats were all full. Bartender was unfriendly, wait staff were unfriendly. We left and had the most amazing service and dinner at Eddie V’s. Highly recommend that restaurant. Phoenix has so many restaurants so don’t waste your hard earned money  at J&G with staff who are unhappy to serve you.
reviews.author: Edward R

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text: Wow. So bad we left before we even sat down for dinner.  We had an 830 reservation but called to ask to be seated around 7.  We were hotel guessts spending $1000 a night to stay at a luxury hotel.  We were told there was no outside service even though it was a beautiful evening and all the promo photos show dining outside.  The place is very large and more than half the tables were empty.  We asked for a glass of wine and we’re told we had to go to the bar to get it as no bar table seating.  We took our wine outside and enjoyed the view.  Asked repeatedly to be sat early and could see the there were many tables open.  No was always the answer.   We spoke to the manager who was curt and unhelpful.  The vibe was bad.  The servers were all surly .  No one smiled. We have dined at GV flagship in new work so expected a great experience.  This was just a  badly run hotel dining room in a badly run conference hotel.  We left and asked them to cancel our Reservation.  Had a great dinner at Eddie V.   Really a bad experience
reviews.author: Samdyredm1

reviews.title: Hands down, best steaks!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful dinner. Becky was fantastic and provided perfect recommendations. The men in the group all ordered the bone in rib-eye and said it was one of the bests they’ve had and these guys have eaten a lot of steak. The girls had filet mignon and those were good as well. All were cooked perfectly based on how we ordered them. Sides were all great. Nice view. A great place for a special occasion dinner.
reviews.author: Lauri Z

reviews.title: Bien du début à la fin
reviews.text: Excellent dîner, viandes parfaites, sauces d’accompagnement excellentes, très bons vins et service chaleureux. Bref, un total réussite pour notre dernier dîner aux États Unis cet été.
reviews.author: tonioflorence

reviews.title: Highly overrated
reviews.text:
What started as a wonderful experience with our family celebrating our grandson’s 16th birthday devolved into a disappointing evening. Initially the service was as expected for an upscale steak house but it quickly declined. While eating our appetizers, including a seafood platter, we encountered an unopened mussel, which never should have made it past inspection in the kitchen. When it was pointed out to staff, it was taken to the bar for inspection and subsequently to a manager. A while later, a single mussel in a dish was brought to the table without a word being said. One grandson ordered a ribeye and requested it blue; it came medium. Another ordered the tomahawk which he normally devours but this one lacked any seasoning. The sea bass and the lobster, as well as the brussel sprouts were undercooked and under seasoned. We experienced long delays between courses and were unable to even get our water glasses refilled. 

Our family has enjoyed dining at many of the finest restaurants in the Phoenix area over the years and this was decidedly not one of them.
reviews.author: Steve F

reviews.title: The best steakhouse in Scottsdale AZ.
reviews.text:
If I could go higher than 5 stars, I would.  The view alone is 5 stars. 
Our server, David was very helpful and attentive without hovering. We both order steak, a filet migon and a ribeye.  A very extensive wine list. Steaks so tender they practically melted in your mouth. Simple sorbet and an ice cream for desert. 
Valet parking is free as long as you get your ticket validated. It’s expensive, but worth every penny.
reviews.author: David H

reviews.title: Amazing Customer Service AND Food
reviews.text: We dined here as a family on a quick layover back from from Cabo. I googled restaurants and liked the menu and reviews about the view so we decided to try it. They did NOT disappoint! The service was amazing. Even though it was closer to when they closed the service was impeccable as if it was busy. Becky our waitress was amazing and recommended great suggestions for our meals and appetizers. Our food runner Quentin took the time to introduce himself and let us know he would be serving us for the evening. And our other food runner Nathan was so quick with clearing our table and prepping us for the next portion of our meal. I had to compliment the manager Frank Armanetti in person for his staff and the food being a great way to end our family vacation and my husband's birthday before we traveled back home. Thank you for a great experience. 10/10 would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jasmine B

reviews.title: A culinary delight
reviews.text: What a culinary delight! I had the halibut, which was unique and cooked to perfection. My husband said his lamb was the best he’d had, even better than in New Zealand. The asparagus was magic and the potatoes…delish. The kitchen was running behind and our meal took quite a bit of time, BUT the team acknowledged it and did more than make up for it, which I appreciated. Service was excellent.
reviews.author: AroundTheWorld

reviews.title: Dinner with coworkers!
reviews.text: Phil here again, me and the Misses had a great dinner at J&G Steakhouse. First thing you notice is the awesome view from the restaurant. Definitely somewhere I’d go again. Me and the Misses both ordered a filet and it didn’t disappoint. We had asparagus and mashed potatoes for our sides. The staff were very friendly and did a great job.
reviews.author: Phil Clarkston

reviews.title: Beautiful Birthday Dinner
reviews.text: We had the 5 course meal and it was phenomenal. Everything about the meals was so delicious. Appetizers to the main course.  Our service was out of this world. Tom was our waiter and his knowledge about wine and food is spot on. The view is incredible. The hotel is beautiful. Staff is wonderful. We had a great time and can't waite to go back again.
reviews.author: Tom L

reviews.title: Go for the view!
reviews.text: Magnificent views of the famed Camelback Mountain sunset. Professional, discreet wait staff. Melt-in-you mouth steaks (filet mignon, NY strip) and generous side portions. Salad dressing, bread and butter were below average, however, and reminded me of a 1960's diner experience before American restaurants began to aspire to European standards, and salad and bread are very important to the overall experience, imo, especially at a luxury-priced restaurant, hence, the four, and not five stars. I would recommend going for the view, the steak and the service if you're prepared to pay top dollar. The view of the desert and the mountain are truly unparalleled.
reviews.author: Louise K

reviews.title: A nice steakhouse
reviews.text: This place is a bit on the pricey side but it has good quality food and even better service. I do recommend it.
reviews.author: Tal_Hameed

reviews.title: Great food, drinks and service.
reviews.text: Delicious food and drinks and the views are amazing! We will be back next year and highly recommend it.
reviews.author: Music-Lover-Music

reviews.title: Shocking Dining Experience
reviews.text:
The experience at J & G Steakhouse at the Phoenician  in Scottsdale was shocking and upsetting; and represents the first time in several decides of dining where I left zero tip

The waitress dropped an  almost full bottle  of  wine on my sister which then  soaked through a large portion of the front of her dress to her skin in the area of her lap. She was wearing expensive items , as she usually does.

The waitress did not apologize and did not seem  concerned nor did the gentleman who was acting as manager that night. Neither he nor the waitress seemed concerned , apologetic nor interested in making it right.

We told him that we feel strongly that we ought to receive a much more proportionate accommodation  than a  vague offer for dry cleaning . We told him that  it certainly seemed that much more compensation should be offered immediately. His reply was that the bottle of wine which  the waitress  had dropped resulting in considerable spillage had been comped!!!!! We were speechless.

Since that night, I have sent 2 emails to the General Manager who was not on property that night. One went to the address the acting manger gave us that might . The other went to a different email address at the restaurant’s own domain. As of today there is  no reply.

We are very interested to know if M. Jean-Georges Vongerichten of the famous Jean Georges restaurants  where I have dined knows that this  restaurant named for him is so dismissive of his customers. 

By the way, to add insult to injury the restaurant made an unauthorized and unexplained $45.92 charge on my AMEX after we left. I guess the $581.35 we paid for everything on the bill was not enough.
reviews.author: Joanne P

reviews.title: Nice steakhouse
reviews.text: The steaks were superb.  The atmosphere is nice.  I would suggest smaller portions.  I'm not a seafood person, so I felt the options were limited to steak and there were no petite servings available. 8 oz is just too large as the smallest serving.
reviews.author: ChicagoHiker11

reviews.title: Stellar two nights in a row!
reviews.text:
5 stars all the way! Hit this place up two nights in a row during our two night stay In Scottsdale lol because yes, it’s that good! 
The ratio seems like it’s literally 1:1 staff to patrons. Kudos to Austin, Scot D, Mike, and the entire tremendous staff! What a stellar team! 
My Man literally came for the fries he had tried and loved pre-Covid and 3 years later they did not disappoint either night! The fritters, Mac & cheese, Brussels and spinach are all amazing! The rib eye is to die for! The filet with blue cheese may just be the best filet I’ve ever had! The peppercorn sauce is also amazing! 
And the the gravy is the view! It’s a painting that changes minute to minute as the sun goes down and the sky is GORGEOUS! 
The Friday night guitar player in the bar was also incredible. 
Take your date and grab a photo outside for sure. 
Enjoy- they really do a stellar job at J & G
(From Jen & Mo from Austin).  PS Congratulations Austin on your engagement,  hope Austin TX was a blast!
reviews.author: Jennifer Whitney

reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: I enjoyed myself so much my first visit I decided to make this my go to spot whenever I am in Phoenix.    The food is amazing and the service is exceptional.    I was nervous because I was by myself and I really hate eating alone but the staff constantly was there engaging me.   I love this place and you definitely should put it on your places to come in Phoenix.
reviews.author: KMJ

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text:
Delicious.   The parmesan crusted chicken is incredible.  We sat at the bar and received excellent service.   

Great atmosphere.   Beautiful location.   Friendly staff.
reviews.author: Christy D

reviews.title: Excellent sur toute la ligne
reviews.text: Nous avons été pour souper à ce restaurant et nous sommes extrêmement satosfaits du repas. Austin, notre serveur nous a offert un service impeccable. Le restaurant est magnifique et nous avons beaucoup aimé le poulet et le filet mignon. Les entrées sont excellentes aussi.
reviews.author: Mlaithier

reviews.title: Fine dining with exemplary service!
reviews.text: We had the tasting menu, it offers four of the best dishes on the menu for 99$! Food and service are exemplary! The Potato gratin with Comte is the best potato dish ever!
reviews.author: AUKTourist

reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: Although the food was good, the waiter was rude and arrogant.  We were celebrating our anniversary and his only interest was catering to business or larger parties.  We had to ask for bread and water and took forever to get served.  Then he forgot our dessert! A restaurant of this caliber should have professional servers
reviews.author: MIS

reviews.title: Good if You're on the Company Dime
reviews.text: I dined at J&G with family.   Service was exceptional.   As you might expect, the prices are very high.  I had the strip steak.  It was good but not great.   When I spend that kind of money I expect the steak to be one of the best I've had.  I have eaten prime beef multiple times and don't think it's worth the stratospheric price.  Your mileage may very.    It's also very dark in the restaurant.  I've never understood why restaurants  want like that.  Like eating in a closet.   This is a good place to eat but is not a good value.
reviews.author: InvisibleReviews

reviews.title: Best Dover Sole with 6 Star Service
reviews.text: Last night the four of us dined at this wonderful restaurant located at the Phoenician. Although we were not able to indulge in any of the steaks on the menu since it was Friday in the Lenten season, there were enough seafood items offered so that we still had many other choices in which to choose from. As far as entree selections, the Sea Bass was excellent but the Dover Sole was by far the best we had ever eaten in 45 years of dining out. It literally melted in your mouth. But the top notch service from David and his partner was what made the evening a special experience! Although we were disappointed we were not able to dine outside that evening, due to the weather it was not possible - yet David and his team made sure we still had an exceptional evening!
reviews.author: Jim2344

reviews.title: Outstanding service and food for a special dinner
reviews.text: We chose J&G for a special birthday dinner and it did not disappoint.  The view of the sunset is outstanding with outdoor areas for family photos before dinner.  The food is top notch with typical steakhouse fare. Service is attentive and didn’t rush us through our special dinner.  We thoroughly enjoyed the evening and would come again. Live music added a nice touch.
reviews.author: Familytravelmaven

reviews.title: Disappointing!
reviews.text:
Hello,

We were at J&G dinner last night. 

Dinner was mostly wonderful except our wagyu ribeye tomahawk (for a price of $150) was not cooked to order.  The wait staff immediately recognized it - but there was absolutely no adjustment to the rest of the meal.  Our side dishes ended up getting cold while we were waiting for the steak to be re-done and cooked  to the proper temperature.  No one checked on us while we were waiting during this entire time.

So, all in all, the experience started off well, but ended less than expectations.  Very disappointing for a restaurant of your caliber.  I would have expected more attention than what we ultimately received given the undercooked steak.
reviews.author: adas

reviews.title: The Best Phoenix Has to Offer
reviews.text: Dining at the J and G is an experience not to be missed. The views are incredible as is the food, the atmosphere and the attentive staff.  Thank you for a wonderful evening.
reviews.author: Leighton R

reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: Had a dinner with friends and family for the holidays. The food was very good but the service was outstanding. Giovanna and  Jose Luis were amazing with the attention to detail. They made sure we were not waiting for anything and always there when you had a question. Made sure that our food was spaced out and not brought out while we were still eating our appetizers. One of the best experiences I have had in a restraunt. Thank you Giovanna and Jose Luis for a great time!
reviews.author: Benjamin F

reviews.title: Outstanding Food and 5 Star Service
reviews.text: This is an upscale restaurant with white table clothes and nice crystal. The service was attentive but you never felt rushed. The meal and wines selection is outstanding. You need reservations well in advance and if you want to sit outside you need to book even earlier. The dinner was not inexpensive but it was a great place to treat yourself to a wonderful experience.
reviews.author: Jim F

reviews.title: Bad treatment
reviews.text:
I got here 1.5 hours before my reservation.  I was hungry since I was on the plane all day. I checked in and asked to be seated early
If possible.  At 815 I went up because I never got seated early. I was told by hostess you’ll have a table in 15 minutes. I asked for a manager. Erinn the manager was great typical JG style. She said ahead try to get us a table for our anniversary ASAP.  When she walked off I said to the hostess I see  many empty tables you couldn’t get us in early little  or on time?  She responded  not my job.  I said ok I’ll go else where.  Thanks JG grill for the horrid treatment.  Not only will I no longer stay at the Phoenician I’ll NEVER be back to JG.  Bad employees cost you.
reviews.author: Thomas L

reviews.title: Perfect Anniversary Dinner
reviews.text: Typical high end steak house but with a fantastic sunset view.  I had a Blue cheese wedge salad, Lamb T-bone chops, and a glass of red.  My husband had French onion soup, a filet Oscar, and 2 vodkas.  We got creamed spinach and roasted mixed wild mushrooms.  Since it was our Anniversary, they gave us dessert which was molten chocolate cake with coffee ice cream.  It was an excellent meal – just WAY too much food.  We ended up taking at least half the meat home.  Next time we should look at splitting a steak as we basically took home enough meat for a second meal.  Service was outstanding!  Dinner with drinks and tip was $275.
reviews.author: AZ-LGE

reviews.title: So good we went back
reviews.text:
We ate there twice during our stay.  The steaks were outstanding! Every dish was perfectly done.  The service was exceptional.  
And the bacon was perfect!
reviews.author: Dan O

reviews.title: 5 star meal
reviews.text: Wow!!!! The hotel is gorgeous and the steakhouse did not disappoint. Received excellent service from Michael J., had a wonderful leisurely dinner overlooking the city (cities), watching planes arrive off in the distance, the sunset was beautiful to see from the balcony of the restaurant, and the steak was cooked perfectly and mouthwatering. Best Yukon gold mashed potatoes I have ever tasted and the cream spinach had just a hint of nutmeg. Prices are what you would expect from a 5 star restaurant/hotel but for such a lovely dining experience, it was well worth it.
reviews.author: FLGIRL

reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text: While the property was beautiful and has great ambiance we had a terrible experience. Over an hour and a half for food to arrive, steaks cooked incorrectly and will not return.
reviews.author: FellowTraveler267783

reviews.title: Delightful Dinner in Scottsdale
reviews.text: Great evening fine wine delicious drinks and the appetizers were flavorful. The wait staff was very good, Jeff was guiding us through the dinner.
reviews.author: NYtravman

reviews.title: Wonderful food and great service
reviews.text: Very impressed with the food and service during my recent stay.  Everything was wonderful - particularly the service!
reviews.author: Theshirlgirl

reviews.title: Awesome service and food
reviews.text:
We came here for our 17th wedding anniversary and it did not dissapoint. Meal was delicious and the service was spectacular. We had David as our server and he was so great! He made our night very special. Thank you David! 
Also the views are great from this restaurant. Would have loved to sit outside but it was raining when we went.
reviews.author: knj2

reviews.title: 5 Star in all respects
reviews.text: J & G has outstanding food, outstanding service and a great view.  Highly recommend the lamb t-bone and mushroom side.  Service is superb, not rushed and very efficient.  Large wine list with great choices.  We will definitely be back.
reviews.author: patraveller2007

reviews.title: Stunning View
reviews.text: Suzan was our server and she was very good. She assisted with our Rose choice and our food came out quickly. The dessert took a little bit longer, but was very good.
reviews.author: mlemasters1

reviews.title: First class service and food
reviews.text: First class service and food ! We went there on our anniversary and they gave us a nice glass of champagne to celebrate . Had the large filet and split it, the most tender steak I have ever had . Also had Caesar salad and lobster Mac and cheese both delicious as well . Asked for our bill and they surprised us with a dessert - chocolate lava cake with Carmel icecream - amazing !
reviews.author: Robin Cassel

reviews.title: Outstanding service and food
reviews.text: J & G is ultra-fine dining.  Service approaches perfection.  Menu is varied and portions are large.  Iceberg wedge salad is fresh and large enough to share.  Meats were cooked perfectly.  Sides are outstanding.  We had the mushrooms and salt and pepper baked potato.  Both were delicious.     Reservations are a must.  Covid restrictions in place and we felt very comfortable.  First time here and will definitely return.
reviews.author: patraveller2007

reviews.title: Nice hotel steak and fish place
reviews.text: We had a nice time.  Manager was nice, wait staff was nice and attentive. We had fun cocktails. We ate more seafood: scallops were great, crab was flavorful, sole was good.  Live musician was a nice touch.  Preferred to eat outside, it was a perfect night out, our reservation was noted for outside, but they decided not to open their outdoor patio. We were in PHX 5 nites, the other 4 nites we ate outside everywhere else.  Tables were distanced, staff was masked.  We did feel comfortable being forced to eat inside (which was not our preference),  they did do a good job.  Menu was a QR code.  They only told us mid afternoon and all the other top restaurants were booked (we did look elsewhere), as we were hesitant to eat inside.  Phoenix has plenty of top steak restaurants that I would go to again, before I'd come back here, but our service and food quality was good.  Quiet meal, but not an upbeat/trend/fun vibe.  We had a good meal, great service and a nice time.
reviews.author: abmilw

reviews.title: PERFECTION!
reviews.text:
Just what you would expect from a restaurant at The Phoenician!  Perfection at every aspect of your meal!

Friendly greeting, professional service, excellent accommodations, fantastic cocktails, wonderful steak cooked to perfection, great salad and sides, beautiful views!

You get what pay for - and we got perfection!
reviews.author: Martin S

reviews.title: Slightly dissapointing
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Phoenician for a week, and tried almost all of their restaurants. We ate at J&G twice, and were a bit dissapointed in the quality of the entrees. Starters were good, and the heirloom tomato salad is imaginative and delicious. The first time I was there I had the filet. A lovely piece of meat and appeared perfectly cooked, but it was dry, and came with no sauce. For $55, I expected better. The second time my wife and I both had the Dover sole. We have had this dish many times, and expect it to be light, melt-in-the-mouth and flavorful. This was dense, chewy and only mildly flavorful. At $66 each, we expected more. The carrot cake dessert was overly sweet. 

Service was great, and it is a lovely dining room with a beautiful view, and for our first fine dining experiences in 11 months we were thrilled to be out. Tables were safely distanced. So, overall it was a nice experience, but we were not impressed with the quality of the food.
reviews.author: TravelinJabbo

reviews.title: Romantic dinner for two
reviews.text: The sea bass was exceptional. The service was excellent. The background music was good but a bit too loud for us.
reviews.author: N1335FBjoyceh

reviews.title: Will go again but................
reviews.text:
J&G at the Phoenician is fantastic looking restaurant. 5th floor overlooking the resort and Phoenix lights in the background. All the employees are great. Well all except the individuals in charge of cooking the steaks. 4 steaks for the table of 6. 2 of us ordered medium rare. Presented with well done, duh? 
Kinda of baffling for a steakhouse to mishandle the $65-80(retail)piece of meat. 

Other than than that it is marvelous darling.
reviews.author: THEFATHER

reviews.title: Great Birthday Dinner
reviews.text: During our stay in the Scottsdale area we went to J&G to celebrate my husbands birthday. From when we arrived till when we left the service was top notch. They gave him a birthday card as well as a birthday dessert. Our waitress was great as well, I wish I could have remembered her name. The food was also top notch with the steaks being cooked perfectly.
reviews.author: Bcapp298

reviews.title: 10 Days in Phoenix
reviews.text: This restaurant is incredible. It comes with a great view, friendly and knowledgeable staff, classy atmosphere and great food!  We orders 2 appetizers, 1 main course, 3 side dishes and of course dessert. Every dish had great taste, great presentation and great favour! Highly recommend the restaurant! Suggest you make reservations.  Enjoy!!!
reviews.author: Shreder

reviews.title: Not your classic steakhouse
reviews.text: I'm a big fan of the old classic steakhouses...tufted leather booths, dark wood, etc. etc.  J & G is anything but a classic old steakhouse...until you get to the food.  The steaks are excellent, the salads and appetizers outstanding, the service is impeccable.  Located in the Phoenician Hotel, the views of this 5th floor restaurant are spectacular.  While it's not the old classic, it certainly ranks right up there with the quality.  And the prices really aren't that bad!
reviews.author: Jerry P

reviews.title: Great dinner on Valentines Weekend.
reviews.text: Great dinner at J&G Steakhouse.  The view, food and service were excellent. The restaurant is beautiful inside and creates and great ambiance.
reviews.author: Rick S

reviews.title: Super service and food in beautiful setting
reviews.text: We enjoyed a late night dinner here after our arrival from the East Coast. The table by the window and the expert service were ideal. Our choices (heirloom tomatoes, scallop appetizer, filet and the cauliflower steak) were all beautifully presented and delicious. Wine list was also excellent. Would highly recommend especially if staying at The Phoenician....great spot!
reviews.author: DennisG50

reviews.title: Best service!
reviews.text: Amy is an outstanding waitress! We felt welcome from start to finish! An excellent server for anyone that comes in!
reviews.author: Joshua K

reviews.title: Went for a business meeting
reviews.text: Went for a business meeting this week. My colleague had a bison chop and i had atlantic cod . We both enjoyed the food. The restaurant is quiet enough to have a good business discussion without having to be so quite to not be overheard. Prices were consistent with other higher end restaurants
reviews.author: Jerry L

reviews.title: Disappointing Christmas dinner
reviews.text: Our extended family of 7 (we met up in Scottsdale for Christmas) had booked our Christmas dinner at J&G over a month before arriving. We were looking forward to a nice fine dining experience since we were all away from home for the holidays.  The restaurant itself is very nice, and we were seated quite quickly.  Our female server seemed, right from the first moment, to be a little bit "off" in that she didn't seem overly engaged with our group, and scattered.  We ordered drinks, and our bottle of wine took approximately 20 minutes to arrive.  We tried not to mind, as we were enjoying each others' company, and it was Christmas after all. I will make a long story short here, and cut to the chase. Our meal was not served until we had been at the restaurant for TWO hours.  There was never a mention of why it was taking forever, nor was our server even really around.  We finally flagged her down after waiting an hour and a half, and all she said was "yes, it's coming". So disappointing. We had a tween in our group who wanted dessert, so we ended up waiting another 45 minutes for that. Sigh. I was very close to asking to speak to the Manager, as this was unacceptable, but I didn't want to make a negative scene, given this was our family Christmas meal. I didn't feel it was right to do so then, but I will say so now.  This was altogether very disappointing. I will give a couple of stars for the food that we ate, it was good and a couple from our group thought the salmon was outstanding (thank goodness for that!). When we received the bill, not one word was said (from the server) about why it had been such a long wait for dinner, and nor was one single item removed from the bill for any kind of apology or service recovery. This is far from standard practice at most fine dining restaurants. We paid the bill, and left...with a very bad taste in our mouths.
reviews.author: MTVandend

reviews.title: if you want a great steakhouse
reviews.text: if you want a great steakhouse experience, J and G is a good place to start. The service was very good and the view was spectacular. The Phoenician resort is beautiful and creates a nice ambience for the entire experience. I had the bone in ribeye and my wife had the filet. Both were cooked to perfection and the quality of the meat itself was, as expected, excellent. They have a nice wine list. Remember, this is a standard steakhouse experience and while excellent overall and a fun experience, it does not really give you a taste of any sort of local flair or local culinary experience. It is a standard steakhouse sautéed spinach, bake potato, french fries à la cart menu. Don’t get me wrong, if you want a steakhouse experience this is first rate. But if you’re looking for more of a local flare then I would pick something that offers that rather than the standard steakhouse experience.
reviews.author: Edward R

reviews.title: Great service!!!
reviews.text: Ula & Tristan were AMAZING! They were so attentive & kind. Great food, wine & view. Fabulous but mostly because of Ula & Tristan!!
reviews.author: Kristie P

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: Give Amy a raise! We had a great time and enjoyed our time! Highly recommend checking it out! I’ll be back
reviews.author: Ricky D

reviews.title: J & G restaurant
reviews.text:
FANTASTIC! Service from Amy & Rosa was top level and the food...OMG...the food! We had the Tomahawk Wagyu Steak = you could tell that cow had a happy life!

One of the best restaurants I’ve ever been to. Period.
reviews.author: F Wellington

reviews.title: Great night!
reviews.text: Ula was great. Great place to dine in Scottsdale whether you are staying at the hotel or not. Great views of the valley with fire features on the patio.
reviews.author: cczims

reviews.title: Superb steak and scenery
reviews.text: Every once in awhile you really just want to go out and splurge on a nice dinner. You can certainly do that here so be prepared to pay but it was completely worth it. On a side note, while the hotel does charge for parking, the steakhouse will validate for you. When you are seated one of the first things you notice is the wonderful view of the valley below. My server was simply amazing as she was very friendly and attentive. I ordered a bison ribeye with a chili glaze along with the mashed potatoes on the side. Let me say, that steak was absolutely amazing. It was perfectly cooked and putting the chili glaze on top made it that much better. The mashed potatoes were light, fluffy and just wonderful. I will certainly be going here again.
reviews.author: EpicGuy12

reviews.title: Not Even Close to 5 Star!
reviews.text: Way too expensive for a filet that was no better than Texas Roadhouse!  Dirty martinis were excellent!!  But, that's it.  Since we went for our Anniversary we asked for a table with a view.  They looked at us like "How dare you ask that!"  Our server, Zachary M, was mediocre at best.  He really had no interest in giving good service.  We tried to have pleasant conversation with him....no can do.  We made sure he didn't ruin our night and $300 later, we were kind and still gave him 20% thinking that he might be having personal problems.  Like all businesses, this is a reflection of the management at the top.  This was our second time at J&G and will be our last.  There are too many other excellent restaurants to choose from.
reviews.author: Kathy P

reviews.title: Mrs. Johnson
reviews.text: Amy and John were amazing! Thank you for a wonderful night, food was great, and service was top notch! Couple that with an incredible view and this place is winning on all levels.
reviews.author: jlofromrifle

reviews.title: Amy is a star waitress!!
reviews.text: Talk about a dining experience! Amy and Janice made ours exceptional. My friend was eager about going to J&G Steakhouse for his birthday and we were not disappointed. Amy was attentive, prompt and extremely accommodating. The food was also exquisite and our steaks were cooked perfectly. All of the staff were great from Amy to Jose that brought our dishes out. Thank you for the experience! Happy Holidays!
reviews.author: Jolene

reviews.title: Dinner in Scottsdale
reviews.text: During our vacation in Scottsdale we had the opportunity to eat dinner at J&G Steakhouse at the Phoenician.  We booked an earlier dinner time so that we could watch the magnificent sunset from our table and it didn’t disappoint. Service by Ula and Steven was incredible and we highly recommend them.  Our meal and desert were excellent. I had the Slow Cooked Salmon and my wife had the Parmesan Crusted Chicken. Both meals were very, very good.  We then had desert that I believe was called sticky pudding, whatever the name it was excellent.  This is our second or third time eating hear and I highly recommend
reviews.author: ScottJoynt

reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text:
Excellent food, fantastic service from Ula and her team! Great experience, thank you so much, Ula.

The  Arnott’s
reviews.author: Elena P

reviews.title: Good But Not a Wow!
reviews.text: J&G was our choice for an anniversary celebration. We started with cocktails at the well-known Thirsty Camel bar in the lobby. It was an exceptional experience! Particularly enjoyed the Thai Fighter- vodka, Malibu, basil, and other yummy ingredients. Cannot wait to try it again. The steakhouse has a nice atmosphere- energetic, nicely appointed, AND, you can hear yourself think! The service was 100% on the mark, and there is an excellent wine list. Only 1 type of bread is offered, a roll that is only okay and not worth the calories. The real standout of dinner were the sides- excellent salad, fabulous roasted beets, and wonderful parmesan risotto. On to the steaks- Surprisingly, not the best. The meat was of an okay but not superior quality. We both had filets and they were not flavorful. Once again, Capital Grille is my standard and the steak is significantly tastier. Since it was our anniversary, we were treated to a great chocolate lava cake with caramel ice cream!
reviews.author: rabbibjk2018

reviews.title: Anniversary dinner
reviews.text: Ula and Steven were great! What an amazing anniversary dinner!! We love this place and look forward to coming back.
reviews.author: Katy W

reviews.title: Fantastic views and food
reviews.text: First of all the restaurant is beautiful and the views are amazing but the service and food where even better thanks to ula and John for helping us celebrate our 10 year anniversary
reviews.author: Jose

reviews.title: Amy & Tristen
reviews.text: These two were simply fantastic. We were celebrating a lot of accomplishments and they both made our dinner a memorable event. They even treated us to a dessert! Highly recommend the restaurant and especially these two.

reviews.title: Dinner @ steakhouse

reviews.author: Kaitlin H

reviews.title: Eat here
reviews.text: Food and service excellent. Not cheap but not shocking either. Good wine list.  Crab cake very good.  Will go back when in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Twinskie1

reviews.title: 10/10 Service!
reviews.text:
Ula & Hector,
Thank you so much for making our evening so special! Food and service were divine. 
Ula is outgoing, kind and very fun! Will definitely return.
reviews.author: SCA

reviews.title: Dinner
reviews.text: Excellent experience all around! Service food and atmosphere was perfect. Will for sure be back soon!
reviews.author: Lauren B

reviews.title: Lots of elegance--with food and entertainment to match
reviews.text: The J & G Steakhouse at the Phoenician Hotel in Scottsdale, Arizona, is an elegant eatery with floor-to-ceiling window walls, glass teardrop chandeliers suspended over the lounge's red onyx bar top, fire pits and outdoor patio. And it features live entertainment on Friday and Saturday nights. For native Chicagoans, it reminds of an old-time night club. The only thing missing was Frank Sinatra or Tony Bennett or Dave Brubeck. But my wife and I had an thoroughly enjoyable evening, just the same. We started with a jumbo shrimp cocktail, mushroom soup and hearts of romaine Caesar salad. For an entree, my wife chose sauteed Dover Sole with mashed potatoes, brussel sprouts and truffle vinaigrette. I opted for a 10-ounce prime New York strip steak with three shrimp, bearnaise sauce, creamed spinach and mashed Yukon Gold potatoes. For dessert, which offered a host of exceptional choices, we shared green apple cobbler with cinnamon ice cream and sticky toffee pudding with coconut ice cream and toasted pistachio. It doesn't get much better than this...food, service, ambiance, atmosphere.
reviews.author: Taylor B

reviews.title: Great dinner at J&G Steakhouse
reviews.text: Three couples enjoyed a spectacular meal celebrating one of our birthdays. The best part of the evening was our INCREDIBLE server, Amy! She is by far one of the most attentive, helpful, knowledgeable servers, without being intrusive or overbearing, that any of us have experienced. Highly recommend the restaurant AND Amy!!
reviews.author: Lisa S

reviews.title: Wonderful week at The Phoenician
reviews.text:
J&G Steakhouse
Delicious meal, lovely setting and wonderful associate, Candace, and support staff.
Great evening anytime
reviews.author: 1515T

reviews.title: Tasting menu
reviews.text: I always love to do a tasting menu. Tonight the stand outs were the tuna tartare and the mushroom risotto. Everything was delicious. 2nd time here. Will be back! David, our server, was excellent!
reviews.author: Ttug

reviews.title: Celebrated 26th Birthday
reviews.text: The evening was perfect! From drinks and appetizers in the bar, to an amazing dinner with our Servers, Ula and Darius! The Butternut Squash salad was amazing and the cauliflower steak was beyond expectations!
reviews.author: Lganzer

reviews.title: Very nice restaurant with perfect view for sunset
reviews.text:
Very nice location with a perfect view - especially for sunset. 
The restaurant is very elegant inside. We were sitting outside and the terrace is not so nice. Could be modernized with glas roof etc.

But in general everything was great. Food was delicious- besides the steak I can recommend the mushroom risotto.
reviews.author: Simon G

reviews.title: We love Amy!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful dinner thanks to our server Amy! She was so amazing and we laughed all night! We will be back to request sitting in her section!
reviews.author: Alyssa E

reviews.title: Amazing times
reviews.text: The service was amazing, Ula was very pleasant and the food was delicious. Also very beautiful view!!
reviews.author: LaTonya G

reviews.title: Great Steakhouse!
reviews.text: From the appetizers(tuna tartare) to the desserts everything is fabulous and the service is excellent.
reviews.author: Dale M

reviews.title: Birthday celebration
reviews.text: Awesome service,  great atmosphere. Ula was a server. Recommend coming. J&G steakhouse has great potion sizes and made a birthday celebration very special.
reviews.author: Maps764138

reviews.title: What a dissapointment
reviews.text: When we checked in to the hotel earlier today I asked about a reservation for dinner at J & G. I was told I didn’t need one. My wife and I arrived at 7:30pm at the restaurant and they told us they were completely booked and could not accommodate us at a table. So we were offered seats at the bar which had 4 people at it. The restaurant was only 30 percent full. As we are leaving at 9:15 it is maybe 10 percent full. Absolutely disappointed. Our meal was fine and the bar tender was a nice guy but a very lousy experience for hotel guests. We were hoping for a great experience and while we enjoyed ourselves we were very disappointed. Meanwhile we are Marriott loyalists!
reviews.author: Michael V

reviews.title: Awesome meal
reviews.text: We had a delicious meal and left very happy. Our waitress Ula was kind and spot on with the service. No complaints
reviews.author: Mike4786

reviews.title: Engagement Dream Dinner
reviews.text: Following our Engagement my fiance and I had a lovely dinner at J&G Steakhouse. Our server Ula was absolutely amazing - she made us feel special, took our picture outside and provided amazing service. We will request her section when we return. The food and wine were delightful. We very much enjoyed our visit.
reviews.author: RiannePond

reviews.title: Amazing service and meal
reviews.text: Amy was absolutely amazing! We had so much fun!! The food was fantastic too, but the service was among the best we’ve had!
reviews.author: kelseybaker615

reviews.title: Best steakhouse in town
reviews.text: We decided to go on restaurant week this time at J & G Steakhouse and we are glad we did. Our food was perfect, the grilled sirloin was on point and my asparagus salad was delicious. We ended up the night with our tradicional chocolate cake. If you have the chance to go during restaurant week or in season you won't be dissappointed.
reviews.author: Kathy Jones

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel and delicious food
reviews.text: It was nice to get dressed up for the night and enjoy a delicious meal. Our waitress was very friendly and we all really enjoyed our dinner. 5 star dining
reviews.author: DaniPum

reviews.title: Great service and food
reviews.text: First off, our server was Amy and she was amazing. Willing to customize anything to make our experience special.  Au gratin potatoes and Mac and cheese were amazing...steak was great too.  Would go back but would want Amy to be our server!
reviews.author: jeffjey42

reviews.title: Food so good that We went twice
reviews.text: It is a little pricey but less than most steakhouses these days. Wine list was wonderful and reasonable. Both Monday and Tuesday nights they had 50% off any bottles under $100 which was a great deal. Get a seat by the window or outside if it’s cool enough. The view at sunset is really lovely. The window seating has an odd shape for more than 2 people though. My husband loved the halibut so much that we went back the second night after a long day of being in the sun. Good gluten free bread if you ask for it. Sides are alacarte but large enough to share with 4 people. Broccoli was hard to share in huge hunks. Service was a little slow and atmosphere except for view was a little boring. But would go back again even if it wasn’t as convenient as being a hotel guest.
reviews.author: Rsprenk

reviews.title: Good food albeit overy expensive
reviews.text: Good food well prepared but cost very high for portions served and simple ingredients used. Also restaurant not overly clean...clear dust bunches showing above wood ledges.
reviews.author: RaiDoc

reviews.title: Who owns Marriott and have they ever met a customer
reviews.text: Am in the so called ‘fine dining’ restaurant, where the food could could rival Macdonalds for speed of service, The quality is ‘meh’, the drinks feel watered (I’ve come across this before in Marriott hotels) and the staff don’t give a stuff. Rubbish really.  Avoid.
reviews.author: VonUngernSternberg

reviews.title: A great AZ experience
reviews.text:
My first visit although I have lived in the Valley nearly 30-years. The view, service and wine list make this a must. Suzan’s service was outstanding and the salt and pepper baked potato is the bomb.
Won’t wait long to return.
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.title: Picked a bad night
reviews.text:
Go Daddy had a large group in a “private“ dining room in the restaurant. They were very loud with cheers erupting every few minutes for most of the 2 1/2 hours we were there.

Our food was very good and the service was good as well but I have an issue with their wine list. They list vintages on the wine list but they don’t have the vintages that they advertise. Not sure why they put vintages on the list if they don’t carry them in stock.
reviews.author: Bill B

reviews.title: Food Good/ Service Not
reviews.text: I’ve been to J&G Steakhouse many times and they have always gotten 5 stars from me for food and service.  However, this time I went the service was lackluster.  We waited for bread, waited for someone to check on us when we finished our entree, wanted to order desert. My daughter got up and asked another server to get our server.  We ordered desert and asked for the check at that time, so we would not have to wait too long for that. Disappointed ☹️.
reviews.author: Denise S

reviews.title: Always amazing...
reviews.text: I am always leery of hotel restaurants,  but this is one of my favorites.  The steak are as good or better than some of the steak houses in the valley, if not better.  Also,  the views cannot be beat.  Great for a special occasion.
reviews.author: Jose F

reviews.title: Wonderful restaurant for living large!
reviews.text: We were out for a night above the norm and the last time we were here was the final serving at Mary Elaine’s. This is a great replacement for her and we are happy to see the success carry on. Fabulous food broad wine list and very attentive service. A grand dining experience
reviews.author: TARCGAZ

reviews.title: Outstanding Tasting Menu with Wine Pairings
reviews.text: We always eat here at least once when visiting Paradise Valley.  We chose the tasting menu with the wine pairings, our waiter was excellent.  He shared his knowledge of the wines with us and explained how they complemented each dish.  Such a treat!
reviews.author: AUKTourist

reviews.title: Over Priced
reviews.text: Tried this steak house for convenience on first night of stay at the Phoenician. I ordered the tastting menu for $120.00 and none in our group felt that the quality was worth the price. Maybe shoud have just ordered a steak. There are better restaurants a short distance away in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: PKPOWELL

reviews.title: Beautiful View and great service
reviews.text: We arrived  before sunset and it was beautiful. A view of the entire valley. Food and service were exceptional. Don't shy away because it is a hotel restaurant, this is a great place.
reviews.author: ktaddie

reviews.title: Excellent view from restaurant.
reviews.text: Very nice restaurant with great views. And on beautiful grounds. All the food was excellent. The steaks. The salmon, the risotto. But the Ceaser Salad was plain and very dry.
reviews.author: nbommer

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: The outdoor view during dinner was amazing. The structure & organization of the property grounds with the view of the mountains as a backdrop was beautiful. My steak was very tender & needed absolutely no steak sauce to enhance flavor of the steak. I especially enjoyed the choices of deserts. There were non-dairy selections as well as traditional dairy deserts.  I selected the lemon sherbet.... delicious.
reviews.author: Toyia H

reviews.title: WOW food and a view
reviews.text: The food was delicious and the view to die for.  It available, def sit outside...the view overlooks the property and you can see for miles.
reviews.author: TropicalBreezeZz

reviews.title: Amazing meal
reviews.text: One of the best meals I’ve had in a long time. Tasting menu was amazing! Service was spectacular. Used the kids club for the ‘night owls’ program while at dinner and my daughter loved it.
reviews.author: MMCT62

reviews.title: Solid dining experience
reviews.text:
Stayed at Phoenician over spring break. Late arrival meant  dining on site so we came here. Atmosphere was excellent. Service very attentive. We had crab legs and a strip steak. Both prepared excellently. The crab legs looked small but were filling. Steak prepared to my specifications. They brought out- without asking- 3 -4 sauces for the steak. Totally unnecessary as it’s flavor spoke for itself. Sides were also excellent- cream spinach and a peppered baked potato. We split a Caesar salad and I assure you each half was the size of a regular salad. 
No real negatives for the main meals- I will day the rolls looked like warmed up Hawaiian rolls you buy at the supermarket. Those were a slight detraction. 
Service was A+. Timing and sequence of service was quite good. Overall, J and G is a fine dining experience on a posh resort.
reviews.author: Jim P

reviews.title: Fantastic Venue
reviews.text: Attended a friend’s 50th Birthday celebration - a group 75.  Cocktails and appetizers on the terrace were awesome.  Dinner was great considering such a large group.  Private room perfect for 75 people.
reviews.author: worldtravel

reviews.title: Marginal Steaks, Too Noisy to Talk
reviews.text: The 4 of us could not communicate easily since we were seated next to a 10-12 person table with screaming diners.  They were seated afterwards and I assume some of the responsibility since I should have noticed the large empty table near us and asked to be seated elsewhere.  The waiter was great but our steaks were all on the tough side.  For what we were paying we expected some pretty tender meat.
reviews.author: jjder8

reviews.title: Excellent food
reviews.text: We are staying at the Phoenician on vacation and we wanted to try this steakhouse! All of the food is absolutely exceptional. We ordered the wagyu steak for two and mashed potatoes and Brussels sprouts and a shrimp cocktail appetizer and everything was really delicious. One of the best steaks I ever had. I wasn’t too crazy about the service. The person that cut and served our steak was excellent, but I felt like our waiter didn’t care too much about us because we were only a couple and didn’t order copious bottles of wine and dessert because we were so stuffed from eating our gigantic steak! When we first walked in it was insanely loud from the bar, but once we sat down it was much quieter.
reviews.author: Justine and Matthew Metzler

reviews.title: J & G Steakhouse is a very good steakhouse
reviews.text:
J & G Steakhouse had excellent food. We went with traditional steaks.  I had the french onion soup, which was very good.  My Wife had the butternut squash soup, and she loves butternut squash.

I had a bone in rib-eye steak, which was excellent.  It might have had a little too much salt taste to it.  We had the mashed potatoes, which were excellent, although only enough for 2, so if you are getting sides for a larger group, it might be an issue.

We split a a green apple cobbler and cinnamon ice cream for dessert, which was good, but not great.

The ambiance was pretty good, but loud.  

The assistant waiter was very attentive.  The main waiter was just OK.

It was hard to get to.  You have to park in a parking garage, which doesn't say it is for the restaurant.  The elevators are tricky.  you have to tell the elevator where you are going when you call the car.
reviews.author: Jim H

reviews.title: Nice experience
reviews.text:
Staying at The Phoenician it is very convenient.
The bar experience is not good because it is not large and many people dine at the bar.
The night we were there it was impossible to get a drink with only 2 bartenders and the bar full of people dining.

The restaurant is excellent and our server was super good.
I had Lamb  t-bones which were a first for me and trey were exceptional.

Great experience except the bar.
reviews.author: Ron M

reviews.title: Definitely worth a visit
reviews.text: We are local residents in the community and have dined here from the very beginning of the hotel, when it was named Mary Elaine's after Keating's (the developer) wife, who participated in the design and development of the resort.  Though the location has remained the same, the restaurant has not.  After several reincarnations the new J&G result is worthy of being the fine dining experience in this wonderful resort hotel.  It is the finest of the places to dine on site.
reviews.author: F8314LTjackf

reviews.title: Can’t beat this place!
reviews.text: Service food and views were superb...can’t wait to go back. Fantastic for romantic evening or just having drink at bar for the game.
reviews.author: Jimmy D

reviews.title: Great food and ambiance at five star prices.
reviews.text: Very classy upscale restaurant. Friendly, efficient and tasty offerings. Enjoyed watching the sunset on the outside deck. I look forward to returning soon!
reviews.author: Saabselr

reviews.title: yum
reviews.text: Perfectly cooked steak and brussel sprouts have never tasted so good.  You can't beat the view of the pool.
reviews.author: sjlewis82

reviews.title: Tuesday Nite Solo
reviews.text:
A Tuesday nite solo dinner at the bar. The first thing you notice is this restaurant(and bar) is incredibly DARK. Dining solo, I went straight to
the bar. Good service. A nice glass of wine. A GREAT tuna tartare app, but a really poor 8oz filet. Ordered medium rare, delivered medium plus and with a strange texture I had not
experienced before.  Should not be 
something so difficult for a high-end
steakhouse!?!  I may go back next time at the Phoenician, but not for a 
steak for sure.
reviews.author: Glenn17

reviews.title: Beautiful Views
reviews.text: The J & G Steakhouse is located at The Phoenician which is a gorgeous golf resort located at the edge of town.  It has a lovely desert garden to walk through if you have time.  The restaurant has huge glass windows and looks out over the valley, so it is lovely at sunset.  The service was very professional, and our food was excellent.  It is a fine dining restaurant.
reviews.author: Laura J

reviews.title: J&G Restaurant- Great Evening
reviews.text: My date and I had an excellent evening, the decor was great, the view enjoyable. We were able to get a window table and the food magnifcant.  Jeff our waiter was very helpful, and his assistant met our every need with a smile. I started dinner with the Heirloom Tomatoes (excellent, highly recommend). I choose the Rib Eye Steak and my date chose Salmon both cooked to our taste and perfection.  Highly recommend this restaurant when you visit phoenix. January 5, 2019
reviews.author: Paul S

reviews.title: Exceptional in Every Way
reviews.text: This restaurant ranks personally as one of the finest ever. It excels in everything: food quality and presentation, service, atmosphere, decor, efficiency, precision and attentiveness. Adding anything would be superfluous. Compliments to everyone who is involved in this exceptional restaurant!
reviews.author: Daniel1244

reviews.title: More than just a steakhouse - GREAT fish here
reviews.text: Scottsdale is not the easiest place to find good quality, fresh seafood.  So we were delighted to discover that the J&G Steakhouse also has a variety of wonderful fish dishes.  My husband had the salmon (which was wild) and I splurged on the whole sole (Grenobloise) was very yummy.  The calamari appetizer was absolutely the best calamari we have ever had ANYWHERE - light, tender and crispy, with a great lemon dip.  Wine list has reasonable variety of choices.  Wait staff was also very attentive without being annoying.
reviews.author: Janae L

reviews.title: Beautiful View
reviews.text: The menu may have been created by a Chef, but the food is definitely not prepared by one. The food was average at best. Desserts pre-packaged. The 3 star rating based solely on service and view. Good place for a cocktail, but if your are looking for a steakhouse I would suggest Dominick's.
reviews.author: bestfamilyadventures

reviews.title: Delightful and professional
reviews.text:
Nice views of the area, this was our first time here. Amazing service! I ordered the Tasting Menu. (67) along with the wine pairing (40). My mother ordered the salmon (36).
Delicious! Perfect presentation. The wine pairing was superb!
We will defiantly be going back! 
Very professional staff, a breath of fresh air.
reviews.author: HeathersS

reviews.title: Resort dining with a view
reviews.text:
Recently visited J&G twice during their 10th Anniversary promotion and had two very different experiences. On both, the proteins were perfectly prepared and of the highest quality, luscious steaks and fish but all of the starters and sides tasted one note and didn’t enhance the dining experience.

On the first night with six friends we sat for four hours and finished with warm bitter coffee. Nice because we didn’t feel rushed but still, four hours!? 

The second night with family the service was gracious and impeccable. A token to pick up the doggy bag as we left. Birthday greeting and celebratory dessert. 

The restaurant has one of the best city views and the hotel was decorated for the holidays and provided a festive backdrop.
reviews.author: JP_Phx

reviews.title: Our wedding anniversary
reviews.text: The restaurant is way over priced, first and foremost, shots $18.00, beers $7.50. The beer was flat, and the whiskey, was not worth the price we paid for it. The food was average, mostly presentation, the portions are kids portions. Really not worth $350.00 for 3 people. The wait staff was not very attentative, I literally had to go twice to the bar and order my own drinks, the femail bartender stated your server will be here shortly. What a joke 15 minutes later? The service was so so, I left more hungry than I was before I sat down to eat. The lighting is very dark, I had no idea what I was eating:( I will not be going back there again anytime soon.
reviews.author: Rob R

reviews.title: Awesome, special meal!
reviews.text: I had salmon with mashed potatoes and shaved brussel sprouts - does not sound exciting but it was Sooooo good! Husband had steak which was also very good and well prepared. Atmosphere is rather rarified and high end but we went in with no reservations and had a table within 15 minutes (8:15 p.m. mid-week).
reviews.author: Janie S

reviews.title: great service and food
reviews.text: Beautiful,Quiet restaurant with first rate service and excellent food. Also great views from almost any table. N Y strip was fabulous and better seasoned/prepared than most high end steak houses. Expensive but service,view and food worth the price.
reviews.author: kent r

reviews.title: Stunning view
reviews.text:
We found this restaurant quite average. We had high expectations and it just didn’t hit our expectations. Our steaks were good, but for the price we were expecting outstanding!
Great place to people watch and enjoy and gorgeous view
reviews.author: Joanne M

reviews.title: Fantastic setting in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
During a trip to Phoenix to celebrate the birthday of my husband, a group of six of us dined here.  From the moment we arrived we were treated very well.  We were seated promptly, and because I had made the reservations saying we would be celebrating a birthday, the staff was nice enough to leave a birthday card on the table for my husband.  We started out our meal with salads/soups rather than an appetizer, and they were all fantastic.  I had the opportunity to try a number of them around the table, from the wedge salad to the chop salad, all wonderful.  I didn't try the french onion soup, but it also looked amazing.  We all ordered steaks, and they were wonderfully prepared and thoroughly enjoyed by all guests at our table.  The restaurant also offered a complimentary dessert to my husband for his birthday, which was very nice.  

Finally, I just have to comment on the view.  Since you're up on the side of a mountain, it offers gorgeous views of phoenix, and it's really cool to be able to watch the planes coming in for landing while you dine.  They also have a really nice outdoor patio if you prefer to dine outside.  Highly recommend this place... it was my second time here and we would certainly return!
reviews.author: ollipop87

reviews.title: What a disappointment, I would not return
reviews.text:
What a disappointment! Located inside the Phoenician Resort on the 5th floor. Beautiful resort, but where are all the people?  No resort employees visible. Couldn't figure out where the restaurant was, no one in the entry to ask questions.  Then, how do you operate the elevator?? This was really strange. Most high tech elevator I have been in, you don't push any buttons once inside, and when we left the restaurant, couldn't figure out how to get back to the lobby area!

We arrived within a few minutes of reservation which was 6:45 PM. It was not very busy. After we were seated, the beverage girl came by with water. That was it!  We waited for at least 30 minutes before we even saw our waiter, Really bad. He kept walking behind us, but never came and introduced himself.  It was ONE HOUR after we were seated before we were served.  We sat there with absolutely NOTHING to eat! no bread, no crackers, NOTHING! The food server brought us our food, served it (still no waiter) and left. No one came by to check on "how is everything".  Finally at 8:30 (remember we arrived at 6:50) we asked for our check and left.  If the service had not been so bad we would have had dessert. As it was, our bill for 2 people was $200!! Horrible experience.  Food was good, but $66 for filet of sole? really? not sure why it was so expensive.  The meat was less. Everything was a la carte. We had asparagus, mashed potatoes and bernaise sauce, all which was in addition to the entre.

By the time we left, it was busier. This was for a Wed evening. I don't know if the other tables got better service or not, but I would not come here again. Plenty of other choices. The service in this hotel overall is awful!
reviews.author: Sally H

reviews.title: Best Steak Ever
reviews.text: The tuna tartare and calamari were great apps.  My Filet Mignon was out of this world good.  The wines by the glass were great.  We had the grilled asparagus and broccoli for sides.   It was an expensive night, $340 for three people before the tip, but it was worth it.
reviews.author: John S

reviews.title: Delicious Food and Lovely Views
reviews.text: Had a delicious steak, fixed to perfection, along with vegetables and an apple cobbler for dessert. Was a delightful experience! Wait staff were very attentive to all of our needs and wants.
reviews.author: Linda M

reviews.title: We love to eat at the bar!
reviews.text: Cold lobster tail, crab cakes and chopped salad. Start with oysters and a Manhattan. Add a nice glass of Oregon Pinot and it doesn’t get much better.
reviews.author: Scott A

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: We were visiting from Ottawa, Canada and decided to treat our friends to a lovely night out. Unfortunately that is not how things turned out! Our service was extremely poor as we waited 90 minutes for our main course which ended up being average....at best. When asked what was going on; we were told that we came in after a large party so we might as well order another bottle of wine because it was going to be a long wait! Lamb was tough, fish was tasteless and the person that served our table couldn’t care less. Won’t be going back there next time we are in Scottsdale; loved Dominick’s Steakhouse the night before! Lesson learned! The hotel itself is fabulous; we loved our stay at the Phoenician however the restaurant was a big disappointment.
reviews.author: OttawaCanada2007

reviews.title: Disappointment of a lifetime, unworthy of being located in the Phoenician
reviews.text: The service was crazy slow (30 minutes until I had my first drink) and the steaks were poorly cooked.  I sent my overcooked medium-rare back only to have it return rare-raw.  I ate around the edges.  The salads and mashed potatoes were great and they ended up not charging us for the steaks but that doesn't cut it.  There are tons of fantastic steakhouses out there that rank above J & G.  In fact, the lower end Mowry & Cotton within the hotel is much better.  Too bad but we couldn't recommend anyone spend their time and money at J & G.
reviews.author: davidfromop

reviews.title: A+ and The Phoenician Manhattan Too
reviews.text: As you would expect -- an upscale, convienient location for a business dinner. Excellent food, drink and service at the Phoenician's steakhouse. Tuna Tartare was excellent and the locally-curated infused bourbon, made for an excellent Manhattan.  Tenderloin was topped with an interesting tomato reduction -- would suggest the filet or sirloin for beef purests.
reviews.author: MDMensch

reviews.title: Disappointing tasting menu and acidic wine pairings.
reviews.text: We picked this restaurant for a special occasion after consulting guidebooks and some pretty thorough online research. We were really disappointed with the quality of the food and the acidic wine pairings. We thought the tasting menu would be a great way to sample a broad selection of dishes from this highly rated restaurant.
