The risotto was the best by far; the snapper was fishy smelling and too close to the same mushy texture as the previous dishes, including the tuna tartare (all served in bowls). The beef was the biggest letdown— underscored by the fact that it’s a renowned steakhouse. The tough medallion was on par with what you would expect at a bad banquet dinner, and the sauce quite bitter. While the service was good and the views amazing, I felt heartsick that we dropped so much money for a mediocre meal on a special night. We didn’t even stay for dessert. On future trips I will think twice before going to another highly rated (expensive) restaurant to mark a special occasion. Fortunately we had a few amazing meals in the area, at Pizza Bianco and even La Grande Orange. My advice: Keep it simple.
reviews.author: Takeitallinstride

reviews.title: Renovated, updated menu=best steakhouse in Phoenix/Scottsdale
reviews.text: Located at the top of the luxurious Phoenician resort, J&G has beautiful views south over the Phoenix area.  The renovated restaurant (reopened Sept 2018) is handsome.  The updated menu is excellent.  The tuna tartare is excellent; the red snapper and filet on the five course tasting menu ($67) are excellent.  Nice variety of appetizers, side dishes, steaks and other entrees.  Excellent professional and friendly service. However, wines by the glass are not outstanding and bottle prices are high.   Priced like top steakhouses in Scottsdale. Now the best overall steakhouse in the Phoenix/Scottsdale area.
reviews.author: daggertravel

reviews.title: Beautiful view and great food
reviews.text: our waiter was very polite and made sure we had a great experience, the new restaurant look is beautiful and still sophisticated and elegant. The desserts are a must specially the cheesecake and the lava chocolate cake!
reviews.author: alizia

reviews.title: Delicious dinner!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful dinner at J & G Steakhouse,our server was so attentive. We had a table with amazing views!!!
reviews.author: michf

reviews.title: Delicious food
reviews.text:
Wonderful view teamed with delicious food, steaks cooked to perfection.

We really enjoyed the atmosphere of this fine restaurante. Will plan a visit in the very near future.  Reservation is recommended.
reviews.author: Mariam K

reviews.title: Sensational outstanding
reviews.text: Great wonderful service excellent. Food wonderful the amazing part they even have crayons and paper for the little ones. Prices are high however worth it
reviews.author: denise k

reviews.title: May be the best steak I ever had!
reviews.text: We were here with a large group for a dinner party and everything.....EVERYTHING....was perfect.  Crab cake and the biggest shrimp I ever ate for appetizers.  The crab cakes were moist and sweet, the cold shrimp cooked to perfection.  I had the filet for my entree.  I do believe it is the best steak I ever had,  seasoned perfectly, cooked to a perfect medium rare..yum!  The view is nice, the service impeccable (waitress actually walked me to the restroom rather than point the way).  Fantastic place to go!
reviews.author: Wendy D

reviews.title: Best steak ever...
reviews.text:
A phenomenal dining experience - J & Gs at the Phoenician Resort met our every experience, outstanding atmosphere, steak prepared to perfection and wine list exceptional.  All of this comes at a price - i.e filet steak - $44.00 + sides and wine.  Final tab was a small 
mortgage payment...
reviews.author: Harold F

reviews.title: When a steak house gets the steak wrong...the rest is irrelevant.
reviews.text: Simple thing to do...get the steak temperature correct,  When you miss one the whole experience for all involved Is ruined.  I like my steak rare and it came dead medium.  When you go out for fine dining and one person has to send their steak back everyone is uncomfortable.  It took 15 minutes to get the steak back and by then the sides were all cold so they brought us new sides which took another 10 minutes. In addition the $10 home cut french fries were not home cut but rather string fries like you would get at Mac Donalds. The comped my steak and the sides and gave us free desert which was not important as we were stuffed. We did not want a free meal but rather a fine dining experience which we would have gladly paid the top dollar they charge. When you are steak house job one is to get the steak right!!!!!
reviews.author: Charles B

reviews.title: beautiful bar and view!
reviews.text: Abbey  the bartender was very service oriented  and so nice! Shrimp cocktail was huge and crispy! Filet was perfection.
reviews.author: ShuGirl6

reviews.title: Service way below expectations...
reviews.text: For a Phoenician restaurant... Expectations were that service would be, at a minimum, present. We were seated on the patio, which has beautiful views of the valley. Once seated we were presented with food and drink menus... Then we waited 15 minutes for our waiter to arrive and ask us if we wanted to get started with drinks. We ordered a round, and were ready to order food... And 15 minutes later had to flag down the waiter to submit our order... Had to ask if there were specials. Waiter never checked in to see if we wanted additional drinks, or to see how our starters were... Had to flag him down again after 15 minutes with empty glasses to order more wine... One hour and forty minutes in, our entrees arrived. Steaks were great, Oscar style was unique (mayonnaise type sauce?), Parmesan chicken was dry and peculiar looking... But overall food was good. Too bad the service made us want to leave from the get go. Waiter really couldn't be bothered with even attempting to provide decent service. Very disappointing restaurant experience at this property... Would not recommend.
reviews.author: caros

reviews.title: The food and view were unforgettable
reviews.text:
What a wonderful choice. We were staying in Phoenix and did a Uber ride her. Was a quick easy ride and worth the trip. We were seated outside with a view of city. 
The wine list and menu was great. 
The absolute best staff. The staff had full understanding of the menu and all items on the menu. They were very helpful when placing the order   

The nightly special was scallops prepared as an appetizer or as main course 
I am so glad I ordered.  The scallops were perfect
reviews.author: RosiePeoria_Illinois

reviews.title: Some of the best service
reviews.text: Service is something that is sadly lacking in restaurants today however this restaurant was the exception.  Probably my favorite thing about it.  The food was good nothing really different from a good steak house, but the pace of the meal and the service was beyond fabulous.  The only negative was the bill got screwed up a little which needed to be fixed. The wait staff was attentive without being suffocating.  Great pace, never felt hurried or rushed.  I thought it was a little tacky for them to charge for a birthday dessert but oh well.
reviews.author: LilysMum0723

reviews.title: Business Dinner
reviews.text: A group of us are in Scottsdale for a project so we are trying all the highly recommended restaurants.  The atmosphere and customer service at the J&G is outstanding.  You cannot beat the awesome views while dining.  I was not over impressed with my meal though - I created a surf and turf and felt like it was just average.  I would return just for the atmosphere alone but would try another steakhouse for a good surf and turf.
reviews.author: Terimorton

reviews.title: Great all around!
reviews.text: J & G is perfectly located atop the monolithic Phoenician resort beside Camelback, with full-height windows offering a premium view of Scottsdale even to inside diners.  Our waiter was very professional and knew the intricacies of each menu item as one would expect in a fine restaurant.  Steaks were cooked perfectly and seasoned very well.  Their signature salads and tuna tartare appetizer didn’t disappoint.  A great choice for casual dining in a formal atmosphere if you are staying or nearby to the resort!
reviews.author: Brian T

reviews.title: Top shelf steakhouse with a view
reviews.text: Shared dinner with my wife on X-mas eve at J&G. Wonderful dinner and even better service. After dinner we enjoyed the views from the patio. I highly recommend!
reviews.author: rick c c

reviews.title: Dining at J & G Steakhouse at the Phoenician...
reviews.text: We dined at the J&G Steakhouse on Jan.12 while staying at the Phoenician....it was amazing - the ambience, the food - which was beautifully served - and there was a big variety as well. Be prepared to pay a little more, but definitely worth it!  Have no regrets at all.  Looking forward to going back there again in the near future!
reviews.author: Jenette A

reviews.title: Amazing Steak, Amazing Service!!!
reviews.text: J&G Steakhouse is a must when I come out to Scottsdale! The food in taste, and presentation is always top notch. The service is superb and the General Manager makes a point of making each guest feel special. Love this restaurant, when in town this is a must!
reviews.author: Leona M

reviews.title: Delicious chicken parm and excellent live music at the bar
reviews.text: The steak and chicken dishes are both excellent.  Great service.  One of the nights we went we sat in the bar area and heard an amazing live guitar player. Enjoy!
reviews.author: janecR8033VM

reviews.title: Disappointing Christmas Brunch
reviews.text: My family and I have been to wonderful brunches at many fine resorts, including the Phoenician. This year, we decided to go to J&G Steakhouse for Christmas brunch. First the good stuff. The quality of the food and the food selection was excellent. They had offerings such as lamb chops, grilled salmon, a seafood bar, and your common breakfast options. The ambiance was great. However, there was some disappointment. The service was sorely lacking for such a high-end restaurant. After waiting for a period of time, the waiter finally came up to our table to offer us juice or coffee, but did not ask us if we were interested in champagne. After ordering some juice or coffee, it then took yet another long period of time to get it. After we were done with our plates, it would take quite some time to clear our dirty plates and get new silverware. At one point, my husband had to get up and track down his own silverware. Given the high cost of $120 per person (which does not include champagne), the service was mediocre. On top of the cost per person, there was an additional 20% service charge added to the bill. We will definitely not be returning there.
reviews.author: kathuria4

reviews.title: Is it the food, the service or the view?
reviews.text: I am not sure what I liked better, the food or the view, or maybe the great service.  All were top drawer.  Really, really good quality steaks with unique adult beverages.
reviews.author: TXflyfisher

reviews.title: Great Evening !
reviews.text: Everything was as it should be - beautiful decor, great views, good service and delicious food. We all had Rib eye steaks or lamb chops. The sides were mashed potatoes, mac & cheese, mushrooms & potatoes au gratin. Everyone enjoyed it very much.  I highly recommend it for a special night out.
reviews.author: Stephen1952a

reviews.title: You get what you pay for
reviews.text: This place is pricey, the drinks, the wine and the food. However, the setting is awesome, the staff if great and the food is worth it. You can eat cheaper at Outback, but the steaks here are really Prime. My salad was a stack of Heirloom Tomatoes with a spicy drizzle and four onion rings. It was every bite good. The steak was tender, cooked as requested. Our reservation was ready on arrival, even though it was a very busy Saturday night. We really enjoyed this, just expect it to be expensive.
reviews.author: happyg68

reviews.title: Great Food With Awesome Views and Amazing Service
reviews.text:
Staying at the Phoenician with a conference this week and snuck away for a nice dinner at the J&G Steakhouse!  I could not have been happier with our decision!  The food was delicious - the pork belly appetizer was especially tasty, and the view from our outside table could not be beat!  That said, the evening would not have been near as special if if weren't for our amazing server Candace.  She possesses excellent customer service skills and knew how much to interact & joke with our table.  Candace also knew the menu well and provided many recommendations.  We had a diner at our table who had significant dietary restrictions and Candace was able to guide her to appropriate items based on her extensive knowledge of the ingredients.

Superb night with food, views, and outstanding service!
reviews.author: Michele W

reviews.title: More than just a special occasion!
reviews.text: This ranks as my fav restaurant in Phoenix.  It is way more than a steakhouse with a variety of great selections.  Go early and enjoy a cocktail in the lounge with an incredible view and great drinks!  Then on to dinner with even more great views and superb service.  you can't beat the steaks but the fresh seafood ranks right up there too.
reviews.author: Jpcphx

reviews.title: Wine, steak, amazing views
reviews.text: The service at J&G was impeccable from the moment we were greeted to when we finally departed the table.  We tried so much of the menu and it was all memorable.  The French onion soup, Parmesan risotto, Sole and Rib eye were my favorites.  You really can't beat the service, view, food and wine/cocktails - its the best in the valley.
reviews.author: Julie C

reviews.title: Great steaks with a great view
reviews.text: I had a wonderful meal and enjoyed the setting sun at J&G Steakhouse at the Phoenician. The waitstaff was great and the meal was superb.
reviews.author: Suzan F

reviews.title: Fantastic night out
reviews.text:
My wife and I always go here for our anniversary dinner each year, because the food and atmosphere is simply wonderful.  The appetizers, main courses and desserts are delicious.  They have a wide selection of wines and drinks.  They also have a wonderful menu with a lot of choices and prepared just the way you like it.

PS - We also like this place because my wife's name starts with 'J' and mine starts with 'G' which makes it special for our anniversary every year!!!
reviews.author: BisonMan1989

reviews.title: Very disappointed!
reviews.text: We were staying at the Canyon Suites at the Phoenician and decided to go to the steakhouse on Sunday night at 7pm. I asked the hostess if we could get a table for 4 but that we didn't have a reservation. She looked at her nightly reservation list and said that the dining room would be full in about 20 mins. and said that we could eat at the bar or another table in the bar area. I asked her if she was kidding because there were only 2 tables occupied at this time. So we proceeded to a table in the bar area, where we sat for about 15 min. and the bartender did not even acknowledge we were there. One of the hostesses came over and gave us menus, it was another 10 - 15 min. before she came back over to see if we wanted cocktails or not. Someone came by with water and then the hostess brought our drinks. About 15min. later the hostess again took our order. We ordered 2 parmesan crusted chickens and 2 salmon entrees.  About 20 mins. later our entrees arrived but there was only 1 chicken and 2 salmon entrees served. We asked about the 2nd chicken dish and they looked at us like we were crazy. Anyway, we cancelled the 2nd chicken and split the 1 dish. After we were done guess who came over to take our drink glasses away? Yes, it was the bartender who barely made eye contact with us. He waited on other people but didn't pay us any mind. Don't waste your money, go somewhere else!
reviews.author: Marie D

reviews.title: Love Jean George
reviews.text:
Love Jean George in NYC so was excited to find this place in my hotel. Could of been 5 stars but hostess ruined that one. The som was great I 
Believe also the managers. Waiter and bartender also great.  Had the lamp and it was nice.  Very good meal
reviews.author: Thomas L

reviews.title: Unrefined Dining
reviews.text:
We are fans of The Phonecian resort. Indeed, it has a lot to offer. The exception is a true fine dining restaurant. J & G is promoted as such but falls well short of such. A few of the shortfalls: 

1)Paper placemats. Yes, you read that correctly. At a restaurant that promotes itself as a fine dining establishment, when you are seated for dinner your table is adorned with paper placemats. I was stunned. Perhaps management is tired of washing so many bath and poolside towels so it decided to skip table clothes. Bad call. At the very least, cloth place mats. 

2) If that were not contradictory to a class establishment, before our dessert was served, the busser crumpled our paper mats right in front of us and then replaced them with new paper mats before dessert was served. I was transported to dining at IHOP.

3) We both ordered the Tasting Menu. One of her items was Sea Bass. Way over cooked and way to salty. I inquired as to the broth in which the Sea Bass sat. “Miso Soup” I was told. It was a salt bath. There was minimal to no fish taste.

4) We asked our waiter to compare two of the Northern Rhône wines with a  2010 Southern Rhône about which we were very familiar. The waiter was honest and classy enough to share he did not know but would get the Sommelier. The Som heard our question and paused a long while (he had no idea) and then finally pointed at wine menu and said “this one is simple and this one is bitter;” certainly not wine terms. We ordered a bottle of the 2010 Southern CdP. We were charged for such. We were served a 2012. Uggh!

5) Maybe most difficult for us was the music...the over the top, loud and dance club-like hip-hop and techno style music. Really? In a “fine dining” establishment? In a dance club certainly. At a street bar certainly. But it was a comical contradiction for what the restaurant described itself to be. 

There were positives. The Tuna Tartare to start our Tasting Menu was superb. The steak was excellent although my ordered medium came barely medium rare. 

Give J & G Steakhouse a pass. Scottsdale has a plethora of restaurants that understand how to produce a fine dining experience.
reviews.author: Love To Savor

reviews.title: Great Place to Enjoy an Expensive meal
reviews.text: This is the premier restaurant at the Phoenician resort. The food is great and elegantly presented. The setting is luxurious and the food is exquisite. Very good for special occasions. Be prepared to pay for the luxe!
reviews.author: Travel Ameniti

reviews.title: Great fine dining experience
reviews.text: If you want great service, AMAZING food, this is a must. It was our first visit. We enjoyed their famous Tomahawk wagyu Steak. It was cooked to perfection. The corn ravioli appetizer was awesome. Simply the best ravioli I've ever had. Views are a bonus!
reviews.author: Janet H

reviews.title: Solid food but odd service
reviews.text:
All of the food was prepared perfectly and everything was tasty.    My husband and I both had Filets and they were perfect.  However the service was not good.  It started off slow as server left us with wine menu and dinner menu for a good 15+minutes before asking for drink orders.    

When I asked him about couple of Pinot Noir options he said he had not tried either and both were new to the menu.  I made my choice on my own.  When he presented the bottle he walked away to server island with his back to us.  Opened bottle and proceeded to taste the wine.   Never asked if he could or should taste it and never presented the cork.  Strange.  The wine was excellent.  My other issue was it took us almost three hours to get through the meal. Manager proactively apologized.  Last straw was my meal was overcharged on the check as entree including wine pairing which was a $35 up charge. Food was great but frustrating service
reviews.author: Melnap

reviews.title: Uneven food, service and ambience
reviews.text:
Enjoying the sweeping views of Phoenix metropolitan area from inside this restaurant is a rare dining perk in a city that is scorchingly hot during the summer. You would think nothing can go wrong in a Jean-Georges Vongericten restaurant. First, I ordered oysters which I was craving that day. I wasn't sure where the East Coast- listed oysters came from since the nicest waiter cannot name the oyster. Then, I started naming most of the popular oysters from the East Coast. He then repeated it was a Pemaquid, yeah a Pemaquid! He later told me it was definitely from Virginia after he came back from the kitchen. Ok granted there is another bay named Pemaquid other than in Maine, I let it go. So the oysters tasted bland typical of the Virginia oysters, and not necessary a bivalve I would expect served in a J-GV restaurant. Worst, the last oyster I ate was way past dead! I ended up spitting it out. He replaced it with an overly tap water-rinsed oyster. Main dish of swordfish could have saved the meal. The fish was cooked well in a broth of miso and Japanese mushrooms. However, the dish was just ok, and quite frankly a bit salty. I had to rinse my mouth frequently with wine. On the positive note, my asparagus was cooked perfectly. 
The restaurant was mostly empty with only a few patrons so I had to move to the bar after I finished eating. And the bar? Not sure what the young girl manager was doing there but I could see the bartenders where annoyed when she starting monitoring them.
reviews.author: ebbtide123

reviews.title: Excellent choice
reviews.text:
Had a surprise wonderful dinner at this steakhouse with a view located at the Phoenician resort in Scottsdale. The resort is undergoing a multi-million dollar renovation in the offseason and the steakhouse is offering extremely attractive discounts in this slow period. The food was outstanding and the wine we selected was a delight - at about 50% off.  Unbelievable. I would recommend the experience at full price as well, but do check it out at 50% off. 

Very nice ambiance, had an amazing waiter. Has a nice, big balcony to enjoy the view. It was my best dining experience in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Nadia1919

reviews.title: Yummy food
reviews.text: I thought the food was good ad the J&G but was slightly overpriced, even for the resort, especially during renovations.
reviews.author: LisaBsTravels

reviews.title: Excellent cuisine with a view!
reviews.text: J & G Steakhouse is named after the renowned  chef Jean-Georges Vongericten. While there, the four in our party all partook of the $40 special which was appetizer (we chose cool gazpacho with melon and tomatoes in a bisque like soup that had crab in the middle), main dish (salmon or steak) and then dessert (we chose the chocolate lava cake with ice cream). Presentation of the meals was awesome (ie steak came with a pesto for dipping and bok choy as the vegetable). We all enjoyed our meal. Zack was a great waiter, and service here is a priority. Views to the south and east mountains very nice! Highly recommend this 5 star experience! We will return! This is what fine dining should be like!
reviews.author: bobbyza

reviews.title: Dads birthday party at j&g steakhouse
reviews.text:
Last night we had an amazing family dinner at j&g steakhouse. Service and the food were both amazing. Our server zack was very attentive and really went above and beyond for us. I personally ordered the tuna tartare and a peppercorn ny strip. Both were executed to perfection. Our steak was a perfect medium rare. Our aides consisted of Asparagus, mushrooms, mac and cheese and my all time favorite potatoes au gratin, they were impeccable. We finished our beautiful dinner with a variety of desserts that really were the cherry on top to our night. We were lucky enough to enjoy the chocolate cake, cherry cheesecake, toffee pudding and the raspberry sorbet. The desserts were outstanding! Especially the toffee pudding! 

Again, there is not enough good things I could say about our over all experience. We will definitely be coming back to j&g steakhouse.
reviews.author: Maps316568

reviews.title: Sensational
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about our dinner here!!

The rib eye, asparagus and chop salad were wonderful

Ask for a table by the window.  

By the way don't skip the desserts!
reviews.author: TravelingFamx

reviews.title: Amazing view ambience, excellent service- lacking in the food area
reviews.text: We decided to give it a try again during restaurant week. Like I mentioned the views out the window are breath taking,we had to notch service for the most part. Side of Mac and cheese is a must! The steak was not impressive for a steak place. The dessert was away
reviews.author: laurieSue

reviews.title: Delightful
reviews.text: Excellent food and service, a tad expensive but well worth it. Had the pepper steak and lamb chops with a shared calamari to start all excellently prepared. Attractively served and delicious to taste. Very knowledgeable wait staff who were professionally friendly. An excellent evening out with lovely views.
reviews.author: John Warren

reviews.title: Great sunset view. But just a typical steak house
reviews.text: It has a great sunset view. The bar is nice.  We didn't have the best server, he was uptight.  So many steak houses in AZ, and the menu is typical steak house.  Steaks were good, not GREAT and for the price, the service, and the many many other choices for steak houses in AZ with easy access , probably would not go back.
reviews.author: UmmaBAtraveller

reviews.title: excellent meat, nice ambiance, some improvements welcome
reviews.text:
dark atmosphere and woods, good view (too bad they have the singer at the bar that increase the noise level in the restaurant - i never understood why places put entertainment at noise level that impair discussion at the table).
my steak was excellent. service was good and efficient.
my dinner was not perfect though. 
I took the NY steak with six peppers. well, six peppers there was. a bit too much. but i got full recovery by scrapping it off.
more definitive was the tuna carpaccio : mostly avocado puree with cubes of tuna on top and some sort of (good tasting) salad sauce in the plate. honestly, the sauce and the avocado together made an excellent guacamole. tuna was wasted in here.
So, steak it is, and the side dishes were quite OK.
reviews.author: 645DavidS

reviews.title: Poor poor service!
reviews.text: Atmosphere ok, view of pool excellent….food ok, service very poor.  Two in our party ordered the price fix menu….some of the price fix courses were served when the rest of us had finished our dinner.  A medium rare steak came rare, and the lamb chops were overcooked and not as ordered.
reviews.author: 246kab

reviews.title: Anniversary dinner
reviews.text: Terrible service. The waiter forgot to put my order in ( only 2 of us at the table) my husbands steak came, then about 4 minutes later the waiter (Greg) quickly came over to let us know he forgot to submit my entree. Then he ran away ignoring us. So much for a romantic anniversary dinner TOGETHER !!
reviews.author: jleebrown

reviews.title: Anniversary dinner
reviews.text: Had dinner here, ordered 24 oz porterhouse and a 8 oz fillet. Porterhouse was a little tough for being prime steak. Fillet was ordered med well and was brought out well. Steaks were still good but could have been better. The sides and appetizers were delicious. Service was good and our server new his business. Overall it was a good dinner.
reviews.author: cheftod67

reviews.title: Good steaks
reviews.text: Although the steaks were fabulous i would have expected the waiter to  be able to allocate the correct steak to each diner . There was only 3 of us.Not what I would expect from the Phoenician
reviews.author: criskros

reviews.title: Outstanding Dining in AZ
reviews.text:
Staying at the Phoenician and looking for an offsite dinner, we had a tire blow out and opted for a night in.  Great choice!  While not perfect, (in spite of my 5 star review), the food was outstanding.  I was leaning toward fish, but the waiter described the steak and I was in. One of THE best I've ever had.  I like a steak medium well and often I have chefs try to give me a lesser grade option thinking I do t know what I'm talking about.  But this was PERFECT!  Perfectly seasoned (not too salty), perfectly cooked.  And I LOVED the sauces.  LOVED!  I can't say I had a favorite.  So good. 

Other winners were snap peas (with mi t and ginger) which were other-worldly and beets.  My wife opted for Tina taretar as an entree and loved that.   Toffee pudding was ridiculous!  

The only "miss" was the four gras appetizer which was delicious but inexplicably served with a tart rhubarb purée.  The rhubarb sounded good but so over-powered and disappointed that we opted to forego it altogether Bd just do the pate with toast.  Really good. But in my humble opinion, a sweeter option would have made this as good as the rest of the meal.  

Drinks were great a an excellent wine menu.  The place is a must!  

Shoutout to bartender Brian, who made excellent drinks and listened to us.  And to Chris, who backed up our waiter and was just excellent!
reviews.author: jon5cts

reviews.title: BEST DINING IN ARIZONA
reviews.text: Absolutely fabulous from our waiter, Jeff, to the outstanding food preparation and presentation.  Also want to acknowledge Lobby hostess, Mandy, for her efforts in securing a dinner reservation.
reviews.author: 27Sparky

reviews.title: A must experience
reviews.text:
When staying at the Phoenician you have to dine at J G 

Our dinner at J G was not only delicious but made all the more enjoyable by our Mr server Jeff Cardwell, a true professional, he made our evening most special with his humor and reading everyone in our party and making sure we all enjoyed not only our meal but the banter we exchanged 

Dining is not only a culinary experience but also the good time you enjoy with friends and Jeff brought it all together 

V Weyand
reviews.author: viktor334

reviews.title: Treat yourself once in a while
reviews.text:
Our daughter toook us to this Resurant for my Wife's BD, very very upscale.  Had a very nice Table and very good Waiter service.  Menue had something for everyone, but Steaks were their specialty.  Two
\ of us ordered the Rib Eye two orderd the filet (Small size), All thought was very good, but not sure they were any better than other Steakhouses in the area, was also very pricy
reviews.author: palomah1

reviews.title: Excellent dinner for a large group!
reviews.text: Our business trip team all got together here for a final evening dinner. The view was awesome, the food was fantastic and the service was excellent.
reviews.author: Matthew C

reviews.title: Great food & wonderful atmosphere
reviews.text: Loved this place so much we went 2 nights in a row. The tuna tartare is incredible! Wine list is very nice, we chose Faust & hope they start getting it in a FULL bottle! Make sure you sit outside & stay late to watch all the planes lining up to land.
reviews.author: freddiecat7

reviews.title: A nice getaway, not flawless
reviews.text:
Came here for a Valentine's dinner. It was our first time at this restaurant. I'd probably go elsewhere for the price. 

Pros:
-the ambience is very original. The lighting is really unique. It's a beautiful restaurant. 
-it's casual enough that you don't need to worry about dressing formal, though we did see a mix of both. 
-the carrot cake with the ice cream was amazing. The carrot flavored ice cream was really new and worked well with the cake. 
-they offered high quality decaf teas and unique "mocktails". (I'm breastfeeding, this made me happy.)
-live music in the bar was really really good. Like a jazzy version of different country and pop songs. 

Cons:
-the steak was not the best I've ever had. It was an 8oz filet. It lacked flavor. The temperature was right. The dipping sauces were fun to try with each bite, they are included and you get 4 different ones. 
-no butter served with the potato. We asked for some and there was a scant amount in the ramekin they brought. 
-the server muttered under his breath "another pregnant woman" when I said I couldn't drink. Instead of pointing me to the mocktails he took my husband's order and ran off to the bar. If he had taken the time to point the non alcoholic drinks to me I wouldn't have had to wait so long to order one when he came back and have it delivered. 
-it took an unreasonable amount of time for our steaks to come out. I don't know when I've waited that long at a restaurant that nice. 
-there was no crouton in the French onion soup. I have never had his soup anywhere else that didn't include a large piece of bread under the cheese. 
-paper placemats?!
-some manager looking person came up to our table during dinner and scrubbed something off a spare chair without even acknowledging us. 
-the seared scallop appetizer had a bitter flavor to it. 
-it's an odd maze of elevators to get to the restaurant. Not easy to find. 
-$8 for parking and no option for validation. May as well do valet. 

For the price go to Mastro's or Ocean Club. It's a good restaurant but I'm not sure $200 is justified.
reviews.author: kellyfamilytempe

reviews.title: The Definition of Average
reviews.text: I debated between rating this place a 2 or a 3. I was hopeful, based on the reviews I had read, that this would be a great dining experience. It wasn’t. The service was good—Rosa and Candice did a nice job. But the food is underwhelming. I had the tuna tartare as an appetizer because my server told me it was one of their signature dishes. Flavorless, boring, and without any creativity in either its preparation or presentation. I followed the first course with the peppercorn New York. It was fine, but I felt like it wasn’t grilled at a hot enough temperature. Seemed almost “baked”—a la Sizzler style or something. Will not return. Not because the food is bad, but because the value, given the tab, just isn’t there.
reviews.author: Jack H

reviews.title: Wonderful bartender Brian does  great job!
reviews.text: Phenominal au gratin   potato it's beyond spectacular !! Service, decor is truly exceptional.  Lovely views! Rib eye was wonderful it comes with a variety of sauses. Dinner rolls are amazing too! Large bar and cool lounge!
reviews.author: ShuGirl6

reviews.title: Great beef
reviews.text: Tastiest filet I have ever eaten.  Asparagus tasted as if they were picked that day.  Salmon a bit overcooked.
reviews.author: Elayne S

reviews.title: Great steak house!
reviews.text: My wife and I and another couple enjoyed a sumptuous meal here on a Friday night in late January, 2017.  Service was outstanding and the food absolutely delicious.
reviews.author: David S

reviews.title: Great steak in luxury hotel
reviews.text: J&G always delivers and continues to do so at the Phoenician.  Top notch steaks and service are the hallmark of J&G and when mixed with the luxury experience at the Phoenician... it really can't be beat.
reviews.author: Andrew H

reviews.title: Sin palabras... maravilloso
reviews.text: El ambiente, decoracion, menu, comida es maravilloso, muy recomendable, un poco caro, pero vale la pena
reviews.author: Alejandro G

reviews.title: Gorgeous views, great food!
reviews.text: We ate a light meal here and the food was as good as the views. The service was top notch and we got lucky enough to have most of the dining room to ourselves as we were eating early. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: SUNandSANDLOVER77

reviews.title: A Great Thanksgiving Meal!
reviews.text: I was in Scottsdale for Thanksgiving and selected this restaurant, based in part on reviews from TripAdvisor, and it did not disappoint.  It was everything you would expect from a high-end, fine dining establishment.  Great food, great service, nice views.  I recommend.
reviews.author: Richard D

reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.text: We went to the Phoenician with friends be able to site outside and enjoy the evening since the resort does have fabulous views of the Valley from patio beyond the lobby. We decided while there to have dinner at J&G. This is a beautiful restaurant also with great views of the Valley and can be a very romantic spot to dine with its dim lighting and soft live music. Also the service is good but that's where it ends. It is certainly overpriced for what you get. After reviewing the wine list we decided to stick with sparkling water. I've gotten Dr. Loosens Riesling in plenty of restaurants in the Valley but never have I seen it cost $48.00 for a 1/2 bottle (2 glasses according to our waiter) that alone is ridiculous. My husband and I had the chopped salad and I have had much better chopped salads, it was just mediocre at best consisting of a few greens, apple that could have been cut smaller and a few pecans on top and a little too peppery for my liking even the dressing was underwhelming. There was even nothing  special about the popover rolls and normally the bread is one of my favorite parts of dining out! I ordered an 8oz filet medium rare and it was almost medium well, they did take it back but it took quite sometime before the waiter returned with another steak by then everyone was done eating; at least it was medium rare this time. Their signature sauces were okay but really not necessary when you have a good steak. If this is such a great steakhouse they should have gotten right from the beginning. My husband and I shared the Brussels sprouts which were also nothing special, again it had a few pecans sprinkled on top. If I'm going to drop $200 on dinner there is no reason to return here when we have some great steakhouses like Mastros, City Hall Steakhouse, Dominick's, Capital Grille or Fleming's to just name a few in the Scottsdale/Phoenix area.
reviews.author: Denise M

reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: So enjoyed the atmosphere and food at the lovely Phoenician Resort! Food and service were very good!
reviews.author: Webbie69

reviews.title: Excellent food
reviews.text: Everything was fantastic! Apps were great, entrees were cooked perfectly- Chicken Parmesan was to die for, and desserts were on point. Be sure to try the toffee pudding cake with coconut ice cream!
reviews.author: michaelsw89

reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.text: When you drive thru the fabulous Phoenician hotel with its gardens and desert landscape and enter thru the fabulous lobby to get into the elevator to be taken into this fantastic restaurant: all you can say is Wow.... The views at J& G are unbeatable... just breathtaking. We like to go there and sit on the balcony and have a drink and watch the sunset overlooking the entire valley before we go in for our dinner. The shimmering city lights of the valley during dinner just transport us to a wow kind of a feeling... Now the staff: Wow... courteous, un pretentious, happy, prompt, polite....and informative... The food: unbeatable... seriously unbeatable... every dish and every course is carefully and lovingly prepared....The pricing: so so reasonable for the kind of place you are at, especially since Chef Jean is a Michelin chef. Yes, you can absolutely go crazy with the food and the wine but what we love about this place is that you have options as far as how much you want to spend... Go there... will not regret it...
reviews.author: jyotsnadietrich

reviews.title: My Favourite Restaurant at the Phoenician
reviews.text: When I was book this restaurant they asked if we could come half an hour later than we wanted which wasn't a problem and when I arrived I understood why.  They had several large noisy tables in and they had anticipated this and put us in an area that was much quieter.  The excellent service didn't end there, we had a lovely waitress who not only advised us of food choices and interpreting what things were was also extremely helpful in telling us places that we should visit in and around Phoenix.  We all had fantastic steaks that were cooked to perfection. Would certainly visit here again.
reviews.author: beckytowler

reviews.title: Business Dinner Event
reviews.text: The restaurant has an amazing view of the grounds. The decor is nice but not artistic. The appetizers were shrimp, chicken, and beef which were very tasty with nice savory flavor. The salad with bacon on top was delicious, the sides were family style which were very good and the steak was awesome.
reviews.author: Sean A

reviews.title: Romantic setting!
reviews.text: I highly recommend this restaurant for a romantic date night.  Beautiful views overlooking Phoenix, out door fire pits on the balcony are great for enjoying a glass of wine or cocktail after dinner.
reviews.author: Cathy S

reviews.title: Evening with a view
reviews.text: Modern, spacious, a very nice and warm atmosphere to relax with a superb view and good food and wine.  We were a party of 11 and it took a long time to be served but we were comfortable and the wait easy to overcome. The food, both meat and fish, was good and nicely presented. A good wine list.  Not everybody managed to the desserts because portions are generous and the espresso was a real one.   It's a few minutes drive from scottsdale downtown and deserves a stop.
reviews.author: Michele M

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: The restaurant is a do not miss.  I was stunned how great the service and the food were.  I have eaten all over the world at fine restaurants and I would put this up there with any place. The steamed shrimp salad was over the top. Loved everything about this place.
reviews.author: SierraToGo

reviews.title: Great food, wonderful view, romantic place to dine
reviews.text: We've eaten at J&G a few times now and it never disappoints.  At the right time of year, you can eat out on the balcony and enjoy a wonderful view.  Tuna tartar is the best around.  Dover sole is great as well.  Good service and a wonderful place for that special dinner.  You will not go wrong!
reviews.author: Robert E

reviews.title: Steaks and a view!
reviews.text: Awesome steaks, salmon, chicken, and vegetarian menu. Friendly staff , great service. Beautiful resort.  Valet parking.
reviews.author: Bodean2

reviews.title: Absolutely Worth It
reviews.text: My husband and I are serious steak snobs. We lived in NYC for many years and now live in the Bay Area, so we've tried them all. Also, my husband makes an incredible steak. So, it takes a lot to impress us. J&G did just that. We were in a bit of a rush, as we were trying to have a "quick" steak dinner before catching a flight back to SF. The service was great, they were very accommodating. I was actually a little concerned that some corners would be cut because we were rushing, but it was pure perfection. We got a bone-in ribeye and a bone-in filet. Temperature was spot on, flavors were impeccable. All in all, I can't wait to go back!
reviews.author: Shara W

reviews.title: Anniversary Dinner Hit
reviews.text: Dining experience was almost magical as everything was perfect. Informed the restaurant when booking, it was our anniversary. They greeted us with such upon arrival, and gave us a card that was placed on the table. Everyone that passed the table, congratulated us. Recorded music, then alter live music was at the correct volume for conversation. Appetizers were amazing; steaks were even more amazing. Our server, Jeffrey, was informative and never rushed us. Special complementary dessert topped the evening.
reviews.author: Lou B

reviews.title: Great meal overlooking Phoenix
reviews.text: We were staying at the resort when another guest mentioned how great J&G's is and we were not disappointed.   I had 1/2 of the tasting menu with a yummy non-alcoholic Homemade ginger-ale prior to an excellent white chosen by the waiter to pair with the beet risotto.  My husbands ginger margarita was out of this world and he enjoyed the peppercorn encrusted steak.  My daughter's kids meal was still kids meal priced making it fun for her and for us.  Best ending was the baked Alaska served on flambé at the table.  This meal was an experience like no other.
reviews.author: Jamie S

reviews.title: Delicious meal with a view of the Valley
reviews.text: I have to admit that the reason we went to J&G is because we were given a gift certificate. That said, we were pleasantly surprised. We arrived before the regular dinner crowd rush so we were seated right at a window that over looked a patio and then a pool. As the sun set, the lights of the city came into view - spectacular. Our server was excellent with a real command of the menu and the nuances of the various flavors we could expect. The portions were generous. The server was able to pair each course with a wine recommendation - which was very helpful. If you are staying at the Phoenician this is an excellent choice for dinner on night.
reviews.author: Michael T

reviews.title: Definitely worth a visit
reviews.text: We were staying at the Phoenician and did not feel like leaving the property, and had heard that J&G was a decent restaurant.  What a great surprise, as it was a heck of a lot better then just decent.  Both my wife and I enjoyed both our appetizers and our entrees---she was quite pleased with her Slowly Cooked Salmon.  I had the Chicken Steak and a wonderful chocolate cake for dessert, however, my favorite dish of the night was the Charred Corn Ravioli with basil sauce--the various intricate flavors were really something special.  The restaurant looks out toward some city lights and the atmosphere is warm and relaxing.  September is not too busy a time in Scottsdale, so it was hard to get a feel for the vibe at the bar contiguous to the restaurant.  Our service was good.
reviews.author: adalbert3

reviews.title: What a Great Deal!
reviews.text: We were fortunate to be visiting friends in Scottsdale during restaurant week and they suggested that we dine at J&G Steakhouse at the Phoenician Resort. It was a beautiful Arizona evening so we ate on the balcony overlooking the grounds and the pool area. The prix fixe menu for $44pp had many of the offerings from the ala carte menu so it really was perfect. I started with their signature cocktail The Patio Spritz which was  actually an Aperol Spritz with a splash of St. Germaine elderflower liqueur. So delicious as dusk settled in. I enjoyed a butternut squash salad, Parmesan crusted chicken and a poached pear for dessert. My dinner was so fabulous that I don't even remember what anyone else ordered but I do remember that we all were very happy with our choices and were impressed with the quality, creativity and flavor or everything we had that evening. Service was impeccable, the ambiance was delightful and even the volume of the music being performed inside was adjusted so that it complemented the atmosphere and didn't drown out the conversations. It was a beautiful dining experience.
reviews.author: madamsusan

reviews.title: Great food with a view
reviews.text:
Had dinner there last night. Everything was wonderful.  We went with some friends and her parents. The entire staff was amazing! Very polite and one of the best customer experiences I've had in a restaurant. 

The view is spectacular, the entire side of the restaurant has windows to look out and see beautiful AZ. They have put door seating with a gas fireplace to enjoy the view from outside. 

Our table had Wagyu beef bone in steak, serves 2, 15oz perfect medium/rare filet. And a peppered filet. They had bottles of Cristom, one of our favorite wines. 

We had side to share, this is why I didn't gov it the full rating, for sides to sure they were on the smaller side. $10 side. We had 5 people and the sides were all gone once they went around the table once. I guess I am use to Morten's or Manny's where the sides are large enough to take home for leftovers. Still, they tasted great. 

Loved the atmosphere and again, the staff was great! Made the experience that much better. 

All ice cream and sweet treats are made in house. Make sure to save some room! 
Enjoy!
reviews.author: Anna P

reviews.title: Good food with better service.
reviews.text:
We always talk about eating at the places in Scottsdale, but since we live all the way out in San Tan Valley we never make it. Well we stayed in the area we decided our first Scottsdale steakhouse would be J&G. 

We have dined at Jean-Georges place in the Aria in Vegas so we were excited to try this location. The food was good. Not Vegas good, but good for Phoenix. We started with the caramelized pork belly. It was tender. The ginger that topped it was fantastic. We wanted surf and turf, but is not on the menu. Our server, who was fantastic, helped us out. We ordered a 16 oz New York and lobster tail. She had them split to make a surf and turf. We added the potato gratin for our side and it was delicious. 

Our server, if only I could remember her name, and bus person were exceptional. Never wanted for anything. Even when there was a delay in our appetizer they were quick to let us know what was going on. 

While food was good we would return just because of the service.
reviews.author: bqaz2006

reviews.title: An Amazing Evening
reviews.text: My wife and I had dinner on September 17, 2016 and our Waiter was David and his assistant was Chris O.  The food was awesome and the service was amazing.  Chris O in particular was very attentive and took care of our every need.  The food was cooked to perfection.  We highly recommend this restaurant but more importantly we recommend both David and Chris O as servers.  Make sure you ask to have them as your servers if you want the very best food and service. Dave and Marion
reviews.author: daved0rsey

reviews.title: Great View
reviews.text: The steaks were perfect.  It took quite a while to get our main corse after the soup was gone.  We enjoyed it over all.
reviews.author: Eric H

reviews.title: A Fabulous Anniversary Dinner
reviews.text: A friend suggested that we make a reservation at J&G to celebrate our anniversary.  We knew that it was upscale & pricy, but that's okay.  We were willing to splurge a bit for a great meal, great view & great service.  We were not disappointed - we got all 3.  When we made the reservation on Open Table, we noted that we were celebrating our 22nd anniversary.  Upon arriving for our reservation, the hostess seated us and then presented my view with a card wishing us happy anniversary.  The wait staff was super attentive throughout the evening.  The cocktails were excellent, the corn ravioli was a tasty appetizer & our meals were fantastic.  My wife's 8 oz filet was cooked to perfection & could have been cut with a butter knife, while my baked & deshelled lobster was excellent - especially the corn & potato basil hash that it was served over.  After dinner, an on-the-house dessert was presented, complete with "Happy 22nd Anniversary" written in caramel sauce.  Again, it's pricey, but we knew that going in.  But the food, service & atmosphere were all well worth the final check.  We'll be back for our next special occasion!
reviews.author: Dave J

reviews.title: A Place to Savor and Remember!
reviews.text: Last night we went to J&G Steakhouse for a date night dinner.  It was such a delicious dinner.  The view is amazing and we had wonderful service from a team of wonderful servers.  I thought it was neat how we got a number for our doggy bag to pick up at the end from the hostess.  My chair was not comfortable and they offered another one even before I thought of asking for one.  The view was of the whole east valley and we enjoyed the sunset.  I ordered the tasting menu and enjoyed 5 courses.  It was quite a treat.
reviews.author: Diane G

reviews.title: Top Notch Food & View to Match
reviews.text: The food was excellent and the wait staff were very helpful.  We were seated by a window that provided a superb view of the adjoining mountains.  Everything we were served was prepared perfectly, absolutely no complaints!
reviews.author: Bison09

reviews.title: solid steakhouse nothing more
reviews.text:
Had dinner there one night while staying at the Phoenician. JG is a solid steakhouse, nothing more nothing less. Nothing special about the menu or the place.
Full disclosure I don't know Scottsdale so I have no idea if there is a better option in the area.
reviews.author: l n

reviews.title: Great atmosphere and food
reviews.text: We love the service, steaks and feel of this place. It does offer price fix three course dinners that we have tried and are well worth it. The wine list is extensive and I do like sampling before I order and they are very gracious in allowing that. The view is stunning and the music is light so it is a romantic place as well.
reviews.author: Debbie M

reviews.title: Trying
reviews.text: So is my husband's 60th birthday and I ordered a half a bottle of Chardonnay which was $35 for a Sonoma bottle my has been ordered a glass of cab at the house and the shifted bring us out some delicious which was the highlight of the dinner truffle fritters The waiter started out good but his closure was not great he got busy and kind of forgot about us he did bring out a happy birthday cake or mud chocolate soufflé the steak was very fatty I would not recommend it it was from Australia and the way the waiter described it to us was interesting and he also described it that they had pork pigs they were fed AAA Corinth and the description was a little left to be desired I have to say the best part of the dinner was the different sauces and the view there should be some live entertainment if you can it's been more than $400 for dinner for three and the way the dining room is it's not private Cici everyone coming in it's a little more on the Las Vegas side less intimate then a steakhouse in a five-star hotel should be and I did order port for dessert and that was very goodbut the restaurant itself seems like a good old boys club and not really romantic did not see very much flowers and I'm not sure I would recommend it as a cutting-edge place to go for steak in Scottsdale. The mashed potatoes were to die for the better or whatever is inside of them is delicious and the asparagus is good and definitely just order steak. We left the restaurant they give you a tag for your doggy bag which is a little bizarre in itself and said to bring you back the food to your table you're like almost coat checking your food out so that was not really comfortable. I would have to say that the atmosphere is if maybe 4 to 6 and they could actually do a nine if the waiters were a little more engaged and you really don't leave remembering the name of the restaurant or anything real special save your money and go somewhere else in Scottsdale that has a steakhouse with a little more of a published fun romantic atmosphere.
reviews.author: DDLMaverick

reviews.title: Nice but not special
reviews.text:
After Mary Elaine’s at the Phoenician closed in 2007 we never went back to try its replacement, J&G Steakhouse. There already were so many steakhouses in the central Phoenix-Scottsdale area. Finally this month we decided to visit, using their $40 three-course “Culinary Countdown” as an opportunity to sample the new layout.  (For a regular ala carte dinner, budget at least $75 per person not including beverages.)
The first thing to note:  unlike the old Mary Elaine’s, J&G is not an “elegant” restaurant. The remodeled layout, already 9 years old, is today’s contemporary, more casual design. Nice, but not dressy elegant. As an upscale resort restaurant it is good for business entertaining and fine for families visiting Phoenix or taking local staycations. 
Hardwood floors, dark wood tables with bench seating and chairs, and some standard tables make up the dining areas. We were surprised by the thin paper placemats (reminiscent of Denny’s) used for table settings --- no white table cloths.  
Beverage/food service was prompt, cordial and knowledgeable. The extensive wine list is excellent. The appetizers were the best part of our meal. I had the Charred Corn Ravioli with cherry tomatoes and basil fondue; my husband had the Chilled Corn and Lemongrass Soup with roasted tomatoes. Their presentation was artistic with excellent flavors. All the appetizers on J&G’s menu sounded so good, we could have made our entire meal just choosing from them.  
The entrees we selected from the Culinary Countdown menu were average.  The braised salmon with mashed potatoes and basil vinaigrette was good, but no better than the salmon I’ve had elsewhere. My husband had the roasted chicken:  a breast and thigh on bone.  He described it as an excellent sauce on average chicken. 
In comparing J&G to our other favorite upscale steakhouses, we like the ambiance at Capital Grille, Donovan’s and Ruth’s Chris better. This first visit to J&G was to sample their service and environment, before spending $200+ for dinner. J&G is too casual for us.  It has one of the more distinctive views in greater Phoenix, but the restaurant itself didn’t seem special. It was not intimate. The dining and bar areas are today’s typical resort contemporary design found many places. Nice, but not special.
reviews.author: CJSArizona

reviews.title: Delish!
reviews.text: Check out the Culinary Countdown! Good flavor and fabulous service. Make reservations during high season. Have a drink in the bar and take advantage of the gorgeous view!
reviews.author: LuvnKanaDan

reviews.title: Cool experience - ate at the bar with a friend
reviews.text: Liked the more casual dining atmosphere in this room, surrounded by windows - makes the space more open.  Looks a little stodgy in the dining rooms, but bar area is open and more my speed.  Same menu.  Had to track down the bartender for orders sometimes, but overall he was super cool.  Hostesses are great here!  Food stellar.
reviews.author: Anne Marie P

reviews.title: Great service, great food, but stay away from the cherry dessert.
reviews.text: Our wine, salads, steak and seafood were excellent!  The waiter was a pro!   The only thing that did not go over well was the cherries jubilee dessert that has a final preparation at table side.  The alcohol element of it was not burned off thoroughly it was like eating Rum.  They took care of this problem and made us happy in the end, so our overall experience was still lovely.   The view here is gorgeous!  If weather permits, I'd sit outside.
reviews.author: femiaheather

reviews.title: Good not Great Steaks
reviews.text: In NYC, we have plenty of dry aged prime steak options. J&G serves wet aged so you end up paying a premium for steaks that aren't worth it.  The apps were very good as were the sides.
reviews.author: pmc1492

reviews.title: Location and quality
reviews.text: J & G offers a bird's eye view over the Phoenician and beyond. The staff is professional and food is good quality. We arrived early (5:30) as our stomachs were on NY time. We were the first to be seated. We sat at a front window and were impressed by the view. We ordered from the summer promo menu and both had the baseball cap steak. My husband thought it was a little tough. The desserts were fab.  Recommend. Have attached photos of our plates, drinks and view. Pricey if not taking advantage of the summer promo.
reviews.author: Reasonable50

reviews.title: Tomahawk Chop Best Ever
reviews.text:
This was one of our best Dining experiences both on and off the Resort Property. Starting with the Service (top notch).We ordered the Tomahawk Chop 32 Oz. Ribeye for two, which was honestly the best Steak we have ever had, and we eat alot of Steak.
We would definitely go back to eat here even if we weren't staying at the Phoenician. The meal wasn't cheap by any means, but well worth it for sure.
reviews.author: liketotravelplaces

reviews.title: Perfect place for a special occasion
reviews.text: Chose this place to celebrate our 12th anniversary. First, the location is great, right in the center of Scottsdale. The views at Sunset from this 5th floor restaurant are truly amazing.  The service was on point and the food was top notch.  The Asian inspired accents to the menu bring a new touch to the over done steak house concept.  The Miso Mustard sauce was great.  Restaurant can get loud, but the views make up for it.  Our waiter Greg was very friendly.  Definitely a must stop place on any Phoenix visit.
reviews.author: Jose F

reviews.title: Great hotel restaurant, fantastic view, attentive service, good food
reviews.text: Here for business in June, so the hotel is pretty empty.  Which meant the restaurant was not at all busy and just LOVELY on the patio as and after the sunset.
reviews.author: Alycia S

reviews.title: Birthday Dinner
reviews.text: Christian was our server.  He took very good care of us.  It was a warm evening and we ate outside.  Nice view and a nice wind
reviews.author: TimDGVAZ

reviews.title: Anniversary dinner
reviews.text: It was our last minute early anniversary dinner together. And the food was delicious. Steak is what we wanted.and the best stake is what we got. The best food and drinks was on point. As my husband was geeking out on the wine and the wine list. I knew it was the probably the best choice to come to dinner on a very last minute. Server was great, dinner was awesome. I'll never forget our dinner there. And expect to see us again. Overall it was the best anniversary dinner I've had. Thank you 😊
reviews.author: Melissa L

reviews.title: Delicious Fine Dining
reviews.text: Even though this is upscale fine dining, I'm confident that almost anyone could find something that they would thoroughly enjoy. The endive salad was out of this world, and their soups & side items tasted deliciously fresh. My husband very much enjoyed his fish, and was even jealous of the couple next to us who had tasty looking steak. Highly recommended for a special night out.
reviews.author: KC M

reviews.title: Excellent, Albiet Pricey...
reviews.text: One of the best steaks I've every had. Service is efficient, menu options are extensive and side items are plenty. A glass of wine and small 8oz steak with salad + tip = $100... I would have complained of it being too pricey is there were flaws... There weren't any ! Will return when my wallet allows...
reviews.author: PG13LA

reviews.title: Great optoin to stay on property at the Phoenician
reviews.text: Outstanding steaks and I am from TX so it has to measure up.  Great selection of decently priced wine from California and France.  Our partner meeting dinner was a success at J&G.
reviews.author: DogDad_68

reviews.title: Excellent Service and Food
reviews.text: J & G is an excellent restaurant with delicious food, outstanding wait service, and gorgeous views of the valley. I had a sample of their truffle balls, which melted in my mouth and very flavorful. I also tried the crab cake and the risotto, both of which I would recommend. The halibut was also quite tasty... I would recommend asking your waiter for a few of the sauces because they accented the fish quite well. Overall a great experience and you definitely get what you pay for.
reviews.author: Natasha F

reviews.title: Fantastic food and views
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful dinner and fantastic views of the valley. Wonderful wines to select from.  The tuna tartar was a great starter to share while we enjoyed the salads and soups. The steaks and seafood were good to perfection and the desserts were exquisite. 

The wait staff is very helpful and friendly.  They will answer your questions and explain everything.
reviews.author: Douglas T

reviews.title: Loved it.
reviews.text: We had such a great experience at J&G. Our server, Jeff was absolutely outstanding. Excellent service, friendly and knowledgable about the menu. The truffle cheese ball things were quite unique and very delicious. If you're debating about a side, look no further than the potatoes au gratin. The views are very pleasant to look at as well. All in all an excellent dinner.
reviews.author: Nadia F

reviews.title: Terrific!
reviews.text: We spent 4 nights at the Phoenician and ate here the first night.  I had the filet mignon with a beet salad and my husband had the veal porterhouse with onion soup.  We shared sides of baked potato and grilled asparagus.  Everything was cooked to perfection.  Service was friendly yet very professional.  Very good wine list.  Our best dinner while in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: DNDee

reviews.title: NYC quality Food
reviews.text: restaurant was amazing was here for my bachlorette in March with all my girlfriends! The service was phenomenal and the food matched! All the steaks were great and the table  side dover sole should not be missed!
reviews.author: Meagan L

reviews.title: A Great Steakhouse
reviews.text: A great restaurant that's part of the Phoenician Resort but worth the visit on its own merits.  The selection of food will satisfy most people. Had the filet mignon, arrived perfectly cooked at medium rare. For sides had the Asparagus and Mac N Cheese.  Please try all their steak sauces, the BBQ was the best!
reviews.author: Mike S

reviews.title: EXCELLENT!
reviews.text: Came to Scottsdale for a girls trip and decided we wanted a nice dinner and found J & G Steakhouse on yelp. It had great reviews so we figured we would give it a shot. This was just not dinner, it was a dining experience!  To start with our waiter Jeff was amazing. Explained everything and was a pleasure to talk to. He checked on us multiple times (but not so many that it was annoying). To start with we ordered the shrimp appetizer that came with artichoke hearts- delicious!  The appetizer comes with 3 shrimp and Jeff asked if we would like to add another one on so that each of us got 2. Way to look out for us!  It was taking a little longer then normal I guess and Jeff brought us an appetizer of black cheese truffle fritters which were amazing.  I ordered the special of the evening- a 6oz bison filet. I had never had bison before so had no idea what to expect but loved it. It was cooked medium rare and positively delicious! My friend had a filet migon (medium well..eeeekk) but she loved it. We finished with the chocolate cake with caramel ice cream. Again, delicious!  I should mention the view, which was spectacular.  If I ever return to Scottsdale I will run, not walk, to have a dinner here. I just hope I get Jeff as my waiter!
reviews.author: Deana K

reviews.title: A great meal with great views.
reviews.text:
A great meal with great views at sunset BUT there is not a view of the sun setting. The  sun sets in the front of the restaurant-away from the panoramic views. Really nice views. Now, as this is a restaurant review, lets talk about the food.
I had oysters as an appetizer with the Bison as my entree. And it was really good. I ordered a side of cooked mushrooms which paired very nicely. Friends had risotto and tuna tartare and said it was excellent.
reviews.author: DustyJim2014

reviews.title: A vista durante o dia eh maravilhosa mas o restaurante so abre para o jantar.
reviews.text: Garcom e gerentes extremamente atenciosos. So degustamos uns aperitivos e estavam bons. Ambiente muito agradavel.
reviews.author: melpedreira

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Great service and food. Both at the bar and during dinner we received excellent, local knowledge. Bison filet was excellent as were the mushrooms and broccoli. Very nice wine list. Very enjoyable restaurant with excellent views.
reviews.author: Anthony H

reviews.title: Ausgezeichnetes Essen, perfekter Service, tolle Location, atemberaubender Ausblick auf das Valley
reviews.text: Kürzlich besuchten wir das J & G Steakhouse im Hotel Phoenician. Das J & G Steakhouse bietet einen super aufmerksamen Service und wirklich herausragendes Essen an. Große Auswahl an Fleischgerichten und auch einige Fischgerichte. Alles, was wir zum Essen hatten, war frisch, aromatisch und wurde perfekt zubereitet serviert. Unser Veal Chop war superzart, perfekt Medium und einfach köstlich. Der Butter poached Maine Lobster war erstklassig zubereitet und ein Genuss. Sehr gut gefallen hat mir die umfangreiche Auswahl an Champagner, Weiß- und Rotweinen. Die vielen Awards passen und sind verdient in jeder Sicht. Ein tolles Abendessen, absolut empfehlenswert und den Preis in jedem Fall wert. Der Ausblick über The Valley ist grandios!
reviews.author: Frank B

reviews.title: Great view and great steak
reviews.text: This restaurant is on the top floor so offers fantastic views over Phoenix. I had Foie Gras then steak, and it was all perfect. Good selection of wines and helpful friendly staff. Stop at the bar for a pre-dinner cocktail. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: MrsNP712

reviews.title: Over the top incredible food and balcony view!!!
reviews.text: Of course I was on a business trip so expense was not mine.  This place was in a beautiful resort - would love to come back and stay if I'm not paying!  Night time view from the balcony was beautiful.  We got to view a big event happening down below wedding party or work function, but it was an incredible show.
reviews.author: uptown63

reviews.title: Abschied von Arizona
reviews.text:
Unser letzter Abend im wunderschönen
Scottsdale. Traumhafte Aussicht.
service okay. Das Gourmet Menü gut
und preiswert. Die Weinkarte preislich
überzogen.
trotzdem ein schöner Abend.
familie C.
reviews.author: Guido C

reviews.title: Great dinner
reviews.text: We had a great Anniversary dinner at J&G Steak House. The grounds of the Phoenician are always beautiful and inviting. Valet parking attendants are welcoming and efficient. They reminded us to have the restaurant validate our parking ticket. The Steak House is beautiful with inside and outside dining. If the weather is nice I suggest outside dining so you can enjoy the grounds and over look the pool while watching the sunset.. The inside is just as nice with the big windows. The bar area is outstanding. The food, service and ambiance will make this a special dining experience.
reviews.author: Jsb53

reviews.title: Amazing view and amazing food!
reviews.text: Make sure you sit outside to really enjoy the view. The service was outstanding as was the food. If we are ever back in Scottsdale we will go here for dinner again for sure.
reviews.author: Imperial_Eli

reviews.title: Delicious dinner at J&G Steakhouse
reviews.text: Incredible food and wine with a spectacular view overlooking the grounds of the Phoenician hotel.  Excellent wait staff and sommelier.
reviews.author: 007steelhorse

reviews.title: A perfect 25th anniversary dinner!
reviews.text:
I've provided the same review on OpenTable, and Yelp. My wife and I celebrated our 25th anniversary @ J&G, and our dinner was spectacular. In a city with a reputation as a world-class resort/vacation destination, and with an abundance of superb restaurants, I'd rank our dinner as absolutely first-class.

My wife is a native New Englander, and I'm an honorary NE citizen. Our raw bar appetizers and dinner were literally perfect, and on-par with any high-end seafood restaurant I've experienced anywhere. 

J&G made certain that our anniversary dinner was perfect, and we'll return soon!
reviews.author: DBV

reviews.title: Great food, great wine, amazing service!
reviews.text: We recently went here with 5 other couples. We had the private room off the back that looks onto the amazing pool and landscaping to the resort. We had an amazing server who was super knowledgeable with both the food and wine and made sure that we were well taken care of the entire evening.We ordered almost all of the apps on the menu to share and our favorites were the tuna tartar, the truffle cheese balls and the crab cakes. All of them were delicious but those were the 3 that really stuck out. For the mains they had the most amazing cuts of meat. My husband got the bone in bison, which was mouth watering. I also tried the bone in filet, also amazing, but the one that took the cake was the kobe beef that literally melted in your mouth! We had an array of wines and champagne throughout the evening all were delicious and went incredibly well with our food. I would absolutely go back here next time we are in Scottsdale!
reviews.author: BelangerTheExplorer

reviews.title: Best restaurant in Arizona
reviews.text: This place is THE best restaurant in Arizona!!! From the staff to the delicious food! We walked in at 8:30pm & they were closing at 10pm. We sat a table inside the restaurant, but it was too cold for our 9yr old. So the lovely server fetched her a shall to keep her warm. It was so sweet of him to do that. The second server we met set us up with a table outside overlooking Camelback Mountain & the hotel's pool, which was breath taking! There were 2 fire pits outside & it was so beautiful. The food was out of this world! I had a bone in filet mignon, daughter ordered the parmesan crusted chicken and my hubby ordered the lobster tail. The best sides were the asparagus risotto and the Yukon gold mashed potatoes! For appetizers you must try the jumbo shrimp cocktail the east side oysters which were so scrumptious! I could've eaten them all day. This restaurant is gorgeous! The staff go over & beyond to make you happy & so effortless! Every single one of them were in a good mood & so hospitable. Our server was Kandice (hope I spelled it correct), Chris and 2 others that helped out. They work as a team and make sure we are all satisfied and happy. One last thing, try the cheesecake & the chocolate lava cake. You will never want to leave because the food & staff were so amazing & out of this world! Thank you to everyone there! I highly recommend trying this place while in Arizona.
reviews.author: Stephanie N

reviews.title: Amazing first night late dinner!
reviews.text: We starting off our trip with a long travel day and some room issues, so we went to J&G for a light dinner.  Candace took great care of us, and made our first evening amazing!  We had a wonderful table by the window, although they also have tables outside, and the view is not to be missed.  We shared the Shellfish platter and each had a salad and it was just enough.  We loved the food and atmosphere so much, we had dinner there again with our friends from Phoenix, and Candace took care of us again.  She is a treasure to the restaurant experience!  The second dinner we had fillets and lobster, with Stags Leap Artemis wine both times.  The second time we sat outside with an amazing view from the 5th floor overlooking the rest of the resort and beyond.  Great restaurant-food and service
reviews.author: jbug1959

reviews.title: Great Food, Slow Service, High Prices
reviews.text: Stayed at the Phoenician for work trip.  Had reservations for this restaurant.  Went with another couple.  Great Food!  No question the quality of our dinner was excellent.  Prices were high.  Although the food was great, it was not worth the price in our opinion.  Our server was not in any hurry to take our order or check on use.  There was a large group next to us, but it was noticeable by all at our table.  Last issue:  they seemed to have a hard time splitting our bill by couple.  Our friends drank wine and cocktails, which we didn't.  However they said they could only split the bill in half, which meant our bill was much higher than it should have been.  What restaurant that charges what they do can't figure out how to split the bill correctly?
reviews.author: A K

reviews.title: Great view; slow service; inconsistent food
reviews.text: Had a fairly disappointing meal at this top floor restaurant within the Phoenician Resort.  While the views of the pool and the Scottsdale skyline were tremendous, the overall meal was below expectations. A three course dinner took more than 3 hours to complete, including nearly an hour wait for soup and salad appetizers.  Seasoning on the dishes was inconsistent – overly salty asparagus soup was followed by a bland, under-seasoned halibut.  A5 tenderloin was tender as advertised, but extremely pricey.  Poached pear dessert (at the 3-hour mark) was entirely forgettable.  Despite the high end Jean-George Vongerichten branding, we left missing the old Mary Elaine’s!
reviews.author: myangsf

reviews.title: Great Food but Not Service
reviews.text: We came back to this restaurant because we really liked the view, the food and the service when we went there first time. So we went back hoping to have the same experience. Unfortunately, we didn't. We got served by the server named Jeff - nice guy but loves to chat with everyone. There is nothing wrong with being friendly unless if affects the customers. We had to wait for him a few times to order stuff, and then we waited 40 minutes for our steak, and it came out cold. We figured Mr. Chatty forgot to pick it up on time. Things happen and we understand but we wanted to at least hear an apology: we are paying $52 for steak and they make us wait and can't get it right. We didn't get any apology, Jeff handled it like it wasn't a big deal. Well it is for us when we spend $200 for dinner for two we expect more than average service.
reviews.author: Elina W

reviews.title: Great Steak & Service, Oppulent Setting with spectacular view from an elevated terrace
reviews.text:
The Phoenician.  My second time here after a 30 year absence.  The resort was built to the 10's.  It was built by Charles H. Keating, a Phoenix real-estate developer and savings-and-loan executive. The government seized control of the hotel and Keating's other holdings in a middle-of-the-night raid in 1989 on fraud allegations, and he later served time in prison.

In any event, the restaurant was great and the steak cooked to perfection.  The place oozes opulence, it was a pleasant experience, we were not disappointed, and we will likely return again before another 30 years passes.
reviews.author: Rick M

reviews.title: Very Good Meal Outside
reviews.text: If the weather cooperates, please sit outside as the views of the pool, mountains and grounds are far superior to what is really a bland indoor dining room. We had the oysters and tuna tartare to start. Both were good but the guac below the tuna was very bland and the tuna was more diced than chopped which gave it almost a purée taste that I didn't enjoy. The onion soup and spinach salad were second and both did not disappoint. The onion soup was a powerhouse with a simple amount of cheese and just a few croutons which allowed the carmalized onions to seize the day. The spinach salad had a dressing that my wife described as being addictive. We had the Dover sole and bone in filet to finish it off. Both were good but not worthy of a $66 and $56 price point. The Dover sole was a bit off temperature and was very lukewarm. The bone in filet was far too small for a steak at the price point but it did have a great deal of flavor. I would return here but there are better high end dining restaurants in the area. Thus is a grand choice but a bit behind numerous five star options at a $100 plus a head in the area.
reviews.author: Matt B

reviews.title: AMAZING EVENING
reviews.text: Amazing evening in every way with my 80 year old mother and husband! The view from the patio is truly heaven on earth!  One can see nearly every mountain range in the valley including South Mountain, Camelback, and so many others. The grounds of the Phoenician are stunning with the perfectly manicured landscaping, golf course, beautiful gardens of flowers and geraniums and an amazing crystal blue pool.
