We were treated like royalty by Elena who introduced us to J&G's signature Ginger Margarita along with the best tasting appetizers in the world - Black Truffle Cheese Fritters!  Of course we did not stop there and also enjoyed the Crab Cake and Calamari - which were out of this world delicious!  We stayed long enough to watched the sun set and the lights in the valley come on.  My mother is still talking about the beauty and very memorable evening today!  We are really looking forward to returning again in the very near future.
reviews.author: Sonja S

reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: We spent Valentines dinner here and it was a perfect evening.  The wine selections are  great, the service attentive and they were very flexible in seating us earlier than we planned. The food is very wonderful and well prepared.  The desserts are worth the calories!
reviews.author: 5startraveler

reviews.title: Best Fish I've Ever Had!
reviews.text: The wine was free flowing & the food was just amazing. We sat on the terrace, overlooking the entire resort and facing Camelback mountain. While we were eating dinner, I kid you not, fireworks were going off in the distance. It was just an unforgettable time. This restaurant can be very business friendly,  casual, romantic - and above all - it's classy. Highly recommend. If you stay at the Phoenician, you have to eat here!
reviews.author: clarhilary

reviews.title: excellent evening
reviews.text: Truly a great place! Infact the saving grace behind this very dated hotel which is in much need of a remodel.  This restaurant was on point!! From the service, to the ambiance, to the wine list, fabulous. Expensive Yes!  but truly a wonderful dinner was had here.  The menu offered something for everyone (even non meat eaters)  ,  wonderful combination of flavors and presentation was delightful.  Truly share this experience over a fantastic bottle of wine (we had the Malbec from Argentina, LaMadrid, excellent by the way ) and watch the city lights below. Very nicely done!   Would come back to dine here but stay somewhere else.
reviews.author: SimoneSmithson

reviews.title: Its been a while. But it was excellent!
reviews.text: Beautiful view. Excellent service. Excellent food. Its been a while So, don't hold me tom it. but, when I went. It was spot on!
reviews.author: paula a

reviews.title: Why Did Thou Forsake Me
reviews.text:
This restaurant used to have a location at the W hotel in DC.  Loved it even though you had to negotiate through the euro-trash scene in the lobby.

So when we discovered it was just down the from where we were staying, we had to go.  The setting at the top of The Phoenician is perfect for J&G.

Is this really a steakhouse when the seafood offered is so amazing. The Parker House rolls are a kicked up version of that treat to brioche level. You have to eat one and leave it at that because your brain will not apply the brakes.  Shrimp cocktail feature prawns that are fresh and snap when you bite them.  The tuna tartare is unctuous.

The filet with spicy butter sauce was maybe the best I have ever tasted, the steak au poire was like saying hello to an old friend who excites your interest.  The desserts are perfect in amount and nuance of sweetness.

Come back to me old friend, my memory of what you were is vastly exceeded by what you still are.
reviews.author: Marc M

reviews.title: Excellent variety of entrees and delicious sides
reviews.text:
I had the tasting menu which was delicious.  The server recommended that I pair parts of the tasting menu with each other so that my dinner would not be timed behind my companions.  This was fine until there were two hot items served at the same time.  Don't allow them to serve you the "entrees" together or one will be cold when you eat it.  The portion sizes for the tasting menu were excellent.  The entree sizes for the non tasting menu were quite large.  I would've liked to see more variety in the wines available by the glass for a restaurant that has won such a prestigious award from Wine Spectator.  
Server appeared to have too many tables which impacted service.
reviews.author: Kelly O

reviews.title: Best View of Scottsdale
reviews.text: This restaurant replaced our favorite Madeleine Restaurant which has beautiful view of Scottsdale at night.  Over all food was good, but not the same as Madeleine which was more fine dining and creative.
reviews.author: FoodQD

reviews.title: Excellent - Some Wine Overvalued
reviews.text: Organized a fine dining evening with a group of friends and J&G was one of the best option for that. Excellent raw fish appetizers, excellent meat and good wine even though a bit pricey for what they are in some cases. Still found a good Saint Julien for $69 which was way more reasonable than the other Bordeaux.
reviews.author: pferrandi

reviews.title: Good Experience But Your Experience Could Vary
reviews.text:
We had read that the view from this restaurant was really quite wonderful (and there was a lightening storm the evening that we dined there, which made the view even more desirable), but that the food and the service could be uneven.

We were three couples for dinner and the table was arranged so that all the wives faced the view while all the husbands had their backs to the view.  It appeared that this was true for all the tables for 4 or more diners although this is a very large restaurant, and I might have missed some. It would have been nice if the table was set a right angle to the window so everyone could see the view.  One tip - call the restaurant and ask about this if you are with 4 or more diners; if there are just the two of you, be sure you ask for a table where you can both sit and look at the view (if you are so inclined).

We thought the food was very good, a nice variety, meat cooked to order, vegetables al dente were just right.  Service was friendly and professional. The "bus boy" (man, actually) was unusually talkative for his position, which was fine by us on this occasion as we were in the mood.

Cocktails and wine were good - appreciated the recommendations on the wine.

I think you can ignore the bad reviews from earlier in the year as the food and service seems very good now.  Recommended.
reviews.author: BerkeleyJohn

reviews.title: Good atmosphere.
reviews.text: Check to see if you can dine on the terrace. Nice view overlooking the pool from the 5th floor. You can make a meal on appetizers, but good quality steaks.
reviews.author: 1trueVolfan

reviews.title: Good to the last bite
reviews.text: Went here with my wife for my birthday, we enjoyed great food and service by all the staff.  Veiws from this location are great.
reviews.author: dog-dadd

reviews.title: Great food and great service!
reviews.text: Delicious steaks, delicious sides, lovely atmosphere, attentive service.  All in all, an A+!  We recommend it!
reviews.author: CharlesOransky

reviews.title: Prix fixe meal was amazing
reviews.text: If its available, usually in the summer, the prix fixe is one of the  great dining adventures.Wine parings with each amazing course are a joy to the palette.  I forget its nice to have a nice sweet wine with part of a meal.  Sometimes you want to try something a little different or expand your horizons and this is the perfect way to do it.
reviews.author: Kevin B

reviews.title: Phoenician Steak
reviews.text: In a town with lots of top notch steak houses, J & G did not impress, excepting the always over the top Phoenician Resort location. OK service, good appetizers, one OK steak and one way overdone. No one bothered to check back including a walking around manager. For a Michelin-starred owner one would expect more. As a local, I'll choose one of our other favorites like Durant's downtown the next time.
reviews.author: Rick S

reviews.title: Beautiful view...
reviews.text: While steakhouses are not typically our go-to dining option we decided to try J&G for the tasting menu & paired wines to get the Jean-Georges "food" experience without breaking the bank.  Everything was delicious and beautifully presented.  The views are amazing from this restaurant and we found the staff to be friendly but professional.  We'd definitely return the next time we're vacationing in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: CT_SweaterGirl

reviews.title: Top Notch
reviews.text: Visited twice during our stay at the Canyon Suite and on both occasions the food and service were exemplary. We ate both steak, fish and deserts and everything was faultless. This place is one class act and for us Brits was also great value compared to what we would play for the same experience in London.
reviews.author: LSMS

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Excellent meal and service and J&G. Would highly recommend for a classy business meal. We had a large table and the service was top notch. Great recommendations on each course.
reviews.author: Matthew R

reviews.title: Outstanding experience
reviews.text: We are staying at the resort and wanted to celebrate an important birthday. The resturant did not disappoint. The meal was great. Crab cake appetizer followed by filet minion was to die for. What really stood out was our captain Candace.  She was exceptionally professional and  so enthusiastic.  She made our dinner extra special in every way.  Will definitely come back again.
reviews.author: Karen-from-Princeton

reviews.title: Amazing service, view and meal.
reviews.text: We have dined at J & G Stakehouse a few  years ago and the food was excellent so we decided to return for Restaurant Week.  The views from this restaurant are beautiful and romantic.  The service from start to finish was excellent, it was like having your own personal butler.  My husband and I ordered options from the Restaurant week menu and with the variety offered it was an easy choice.  I had the shrimp dumplings, my only criticism was that there was not enough filling, but the dumplings with the broth and mushrooms were excellent.  Then the entrees came, I ordered the Beef Tenderloin, it came on a bed of spinach and topped with chopped mushrooms, delicious.   My husband had the salmon, both were fantastic.  I usually do not eat everything on my plate (saving room for desert) but it was so good there was no room left for desert.  Since desert was included in the Restaurant Week menu we got it to go. We ate the desert the next day.
reviews.author: Denise S

reviews.title: Excellent Anniverary Dinner
reviews.text: My husband and I went here for our 31st anniversary. The view was spectacular. Service was what you would expect from a 5 star resort. We had a few starters and shared the Prime Rib Eye. I LOVED the Black Truffle Cheese Fritters. Overall a really nice celebration dinner.
reviews.author: Jill S

reviews.title: Not our style of service
reviews.text:
We've been here twice now and wouldn't come back for a third attempt. We were staying at the hotel on both occasions and we went there out of convenience.

The restaurant is air conditioned far too cold so at least 2 layers of clothing is required. There were some ladies with off the shoulder dresses beside our table and they left as it was too cold. So not encouraging people to dress up which is at odds with the ambiance they are trying to promote.

Probably out biggest issue is with our waitress. We think she was well intentioned but she was very loud and brash (more New York in style than sophisticated Jean-George's European). This type of service should be slick, professional and in-obtrusive. It isn't. I had a headache by the end of the night. She served us last year as well and it was the same. Again, we think she is well intentioned but it really put us off.

JG Steakhouse charges 20% more than comparable restaurants (e.g. Eddie V's) but it's food is no better. The fish and shellfish are not fresh and the prawns although meaty lacked flavour (chilled for too many days or defrosted), the steak was average but not good enough for the price charged.

Overall, there is not enough finesse in the dishes for the price being charged.
reviews.author: KV1234

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: Everything was terrific from the service to the dining experience. Food was outstanding, great steak house and a romantic atmosphere. Will go back again for a special event or date.
reviews.author: Vegasbetsy

reviews.title: Special dining experience
reviews.text: I went here with a large work group.  Everyone loved their meals.  The service was outstanding -- helpful, knowledgeable, attentive but not overly.  I had a tuna tartare appetizer and a filet mignon that was out of this world.  The only problem at this restaurant is finding room for dessert (which I did!)
reviews.author: DIELLE

reviews.title: Superb Dining with Great Views of Phoenix Area
reviews.text: This restaurant is located in the Five Star Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale. One must be prepared to pay top dollar but the food and service is top notch. You can cut down on expense if desired by ordering the Flat Steak which is cut like a Filet Mignon - superb here. Every item was prepared perfectly and the desserts were great!
reviews.author: Burtdol

reviews.title: Absolutly beautiful resturant with outstanding service
reviews.text: We had the best meal hands down.  The service is top notch and every table has views that go on forever.  The atmosphere is stunning the minute you come off the elevator.  This must be a hidden treasure.  Even if you don't stay here you need to come and dine.
reviews.author: criss994

reviews.title: Divine
reviews.text: This place was incredible. Such a romantic setting with views of Scottsdale as you dine. The food was fantastic, along with the wine and cocktails. The service could have been better, I felt that because of my "youthfulness" I wasn't look after as well as a paying customer should have been. Overall, I really lovely place. If you get time... Have a look around the hotel. It's fantastic!
reviews.author: Coz

reviews.title: S.L.O.W. Service
reviews.text:
The food at J&G in Scottsdale is like delivering a slice of the finest New York steakhouse into the heart of the dessert. 

It's a good thing the chef delivers, because the wait staff doesn't. We waited 25 minutes in between appetizer and entree.
reviews.author: Anonymous10019

reviews.title: Very good indeed
reviews.text: Stayed at the Phoenician hotel for 11 days in August and had dinner here. Very nice setting and atmosphere and wonderful views. The menu is extensive and when we visited there was a three courses for $40 option as well as a la carte. We love our steak and so opted for a la carte - the menu is a little pricey but considering that it is in a high-end resort hotel, the prices are fine. Our steaks were divine and the side dishes we ordered were cooked to perfection. Our 8 year old son adored his food too. The bar area is very attractive and the overall mood of the place is really nice. Anyone staying at the Phoenician should give this place  a try for lunch and/or dinner. I'd highly recommend it. I got the impression that a lot of people who aren't guests of the hotel dine at J&G, which is a sign of its calibre in the area. Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Lauren S

reviews.title: Excellent service, food & experience
reviews.text: I  recently dined at J&G Steakhouse on Friday night with my boyfriend to celebrate the ending of our internships. Being that were both 21, I was nervous about the service that we would receive. However, that was not the case. We were quickly greeted by Loren who was extremely knowledgeable about the menu and provided us with excellent suggestions. Loren asked if it was our first time dining and when we replied yes he promptly informed us of the menu. We were happy with the guidance he gave us with everything from cocktails to appetizers to mouth watering steaks and even a side! He did his job as a server to upsell and it was worth every penny. Loren's server assistant was also on top of everything providing us with what we needed and anticipating our needs. The general manager, Patrick, also came by to ensure our experience was enjoyable and ask if we were celebrating anything in particular. As a food and beverage manager at another Starwood property, I understand how hard it is to touch every table and it was greatly appreciated for him to take time out of a busy evening to speak with us and every other surrounding table. He ended up buying us a round of dessert wine which was unexpected and delightful! All in all, the food was outstanding and the service more than exceeded our expectations. Thank you for the memorable evening, we will be back to see you soon!
reviews.author: Jillian S

reviews.title: Girls weekend
reviews.text: Even though I am a vegetarian I had several options to choose from. The wine selection was fantastic.
reviews.author: Lorilee G

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: I was there with family on New Years eve and everything was great. The service was pretty neat and the place was comfy,not too many people, but super cozy. The food was amazing!
reviews.author: María Alejandra H

reviews.title: Great Sunset Menu - absolutely delicious food - and a lovely view!
reviews.text: Had a delicous meal 'Summer Coundown - Sunset Menu'. Very generous portions and delicious food at an excellent price! Lots of choices. On the 5th floor with lovely views. Great service by each server. If not too hot, has a stunning patio. Best Asparagus and Goat cheese salad I've had - we wanted the recipe :). Delicious Slowly Baked Salmon. And the Dessert. The dessert. The Warm chocolate cake - my mouth is watering thinking about it.
reviews.author: Anne-Marie F

reviews.title: The best steak with an excellent side of Phonenix Views
reviews.text: The food has a bit of an French and Asian flare which makes for a playful menu. The steaks are prepared in a way to showcase the meats aged flavor. The side dishes like mac and cheese, gratin potatoes and spinach were all Delicious! I believe The it was also the biggest Cesar salad I have ever had in my life - so make a friend and share.  The chilled asparagus salad was most excellent and showed the Asian influence in the vinaigrette.  You can also have fish -but the steak is the way to go . They also offer a chef tasting menu which is nice to get a little taste of the best dishes.Enjoy your meal while look over Scottsdale it is impressive as is the service and food.
reviews.author: RayDunkin35

reviews.title: Just Ok
reviews.text: Being from NYC of course my tastebuds can be at a high level for excellence but when traveling I do understand that the best somewhere else has to offer may not be what I consider the best yet still may be good. Bearing this in mind this is not the case here. First the positive points. Great view and the restaurant itself had a great feel. We were in a circular booth and quite comfortable. Now I have read some of the reviews regarding the poor service. I understand the hotel has taken over direct management of the restaurant as there were numerous complaints about the staff and service. If thats so then they have turned the service part around. Our waiter was pleasent attentive and always checking in to make sure we were. This would all be great and sounds like a good review but here is where the one major badpoint comes in. The food is just ok. Not bad but nothing special to write home about. Now for a 300 price tag for four people now just being ok is not good. For that price the meal should be one I talk about for awhile. The French Onion soup just had way too many onions too much bread that absorbed the broth and really no broth left over. The 6 peppercorn steak was just a bit to much overkill on the pepper. 4 would have been enough or even 3 peppers. The steak itself was cooked perfect but again it was just ok. I have had way better steaks elsewhere. The grilled asparagus was without and extra taste again just ok. All four in our party agrred that everything they had as well was just ok. All in all not worth the money paid. U can prob do way better if u look.
reviews.author: mhistmajor

reviews.title: okay food
reviews.text: The food at best was okay.  I think the server tried at times but it was just a huge miss.  Our food was set on a table near us and I figured our server would be right behind to place it on our table.  Not so! we kept waiting….. thinking how weird it was.  I suppose we should've just got up retrieved it ourselves but that also seemed weird.  Wouldn't go back for dinner again.  Maybe for a glass of wine in the bar as the view is amazing
reviews.author: diorandmore

reviews.title: Terrible food and service
reviews.text: Steaks were not good, never saw our waiter after he dropped off our food. Had to walk around and find someone to get our bill!!
reviews.author: Sue C

reviews.title: Cold steaks slow  service
reviews.text: Poor service unfriendly slow disinterested inattentive waiter, the steaks were  cold we had to send them back twice, the waiter was irritated.
reviews.author: roberto a

reviews.title: Remarkable Steak
reviews.text: If you are in Scottsdale,  don't miss this steakhouse.  I'm originally from NY, so I have eaten at many good steakhouses.  This one is up there as one of the best.  I had the the Porterhouse,  it was a great choice. Juicy and cooked to perfection.  I could also not believe the beautiful views from the rooftop restaurant.  Try to reserve a table during sunset, you won't be sorry!
reviews.author: Denise H

reviews.title: Amazing, Beautiful...WOW!!!
reviews.text: We're staying at the Phoenician and had to try this beautiful restaurant on the top floor of the main hotel. The ambiance was stunning with their fire pits, views, soft dark romantic decor and perfect background music. The tenderloin was one of the best I've ever had and the wine list SUPERB! Staff were prompt, professional and very knowledgeable.  Live this place and so will you!!!
reviews.author: Paul B

reviews.title: Fabulous steak and seafood!
reviews.text: Out of town on business and invited for dinner. Not to be missed! First we had assortment of appetizers. Raw bar mixed plate-we demolished half lobster, oysters,shrimp, mussels and best clam I ever ate. Calamari was tender with lemony aoli. Skip the charred corn ravioli not that it's bad but so many other awesome choices. Most interesting thing I ate was truffle cheese balls. You will either love or hate- I loved. Ordered chilled melon tomato soup. Shrimp was room temp so cold soup meets room temp was not my favorite, but had flavor and some heat from pepper. Glad I tried but wouldn't get again. My coworker had French onion soup which he refused to share, so I can only assume it was good. Main course was caramelized tenderloin medium rare...HAPPY! Broccoli side was ok, I snaked some of my co worker's potatoes at gratin -should have gotten that. Looked at others fries and that was a waste of carbs. Full, full, full...but we shared warm chocolate cake with ice cream and homemade tuille.  I found a little space. Someone got cherries jubilee done table side with much flourish- he never looked up when we asked him if it was good- to busy enjoying! Wait staff exceptional. Never saw bill but probably obscene. Would definitely return. Solid menu with some exceptional items. Oh yeah, fab view but didn't notice after food started!
reviews.author: Diane S

reviews.title: Дорого очень
reviews.text: Очень дорогой ресторан. Нет наверное ничего дешевле 40$. Один раз можно раскошелиться для романтично го ужина.
reviews.author: maria a

reviews.title: Not to be missed!
reviews.text:
Amazing views with food and service to match!  WORTH EVERY PENNY!

We make sure to go at least one every time we visit.... This trip, we actaully dined their twice.
reviews.author: twjones100

reviews.title: Sublime
reviews.text: The staff accommodated my special requests for a special birthday meal with attention to detail. Starting off with chilled seafood and sparkling wine was a perfect beginning. The bone in filet was perfectly grilled and an excellent cut of meat. It was a huge portion. We also ordered the lamb steak. The steak house has an excellent assortment of sides. It is easy to order and eat family style.  Excellent wine list. Excellent service. We loved the live music and the stunning sunset view of the valley.
reviews.author: FamilyTraveler0978

reviews.title: NIce Meal for a Couple but Not for a Group
reviews.text: I had the opportunity to dine here on three occasions during a recent business trip. The first meal was just my wife and me and the service, food and view were all outstanding. Our server was attentive but not intrusive and we enjoyed our time there very much. The other two meals were group functions and while the food was good, it appeared the staff was almost overwhelmed by attempting to serve more than two people at a time. Perhaps it was just a training issue and it will not prevent me from returning.
reviews.author: PointAfter

reviews.title: Underwhelming evening
reviews.text:
We had dinner here with another couple. The other couple had a fillet with a side of mushrooms and a salmon dinner.  The fillet was ordered because it is a steakhouse and the other guy wanted to try the steak.  He was disappointed and stated that he makes better steak at home.  He said the mushrooms were tasteless and no one ate them.  The salmon dinner was just average.  
I ordered the caramelized beef tenderloin with fava beans because I wanted to taste fava beans.  The beef was tender but had no seasoning or flavor.  I had to search for the fava beans and finally found two of the world's smallest fava beans hidden within the surrounding puree.  My wife ordered the roasted main lobster.  The waiter said it was a one and a half pound lobster, but in truth it was just some claw meat mixed with greens. 
Our waiter, Anthony, never returned to inquire about our meals. That never happens in a quality restaurant.  There were several guys standing around in suits impersonating secret service agents that added no value to the evening. We even had to ask for water refills.
The restaurant itself is dark and outdated and is badly in need of freshening. This restaurant just needs to start over.
reviews.author: Bob732

reviews.title: J&G works every time.
reviews.text: I loved Mary Elaine's because they gave you tiny little tables on which to rest your purse.  Having said that, J&G has been a good place to go for late night dining.  They have some good classic dishes available and a pleasant atmosphere.
reviews.author: MGM

reviews.title: Good food, bad service
reviews.text:
J&G has the potential to be one of the best steakhouses in all of Arizona.  Let's start with the good:  ambiance, location, and overall the food was very good.  The reason I give this restaurant 4 stars instead of 5 is because of the service.  Our waiter was simply not good.  He made us feel neglected during our entire service.  It took him 10 minutes to even greet us after being seated even though he stopped by both tables on each side of us.  Then when he finally greeted us he didn't even ask us if we wanted something to drink.  Instead he asked us if we wanted an appetizer.  Throughout dinner service he basically continued to neglect us.  The couple next to us had his full attention but they were drinking wine and we weren't.  My wife's drink was left empty for far too long do I actually asked the waiters assistant if he could help get her a drink.  I believe this restaurant could be top notch but management should really monitor the customer service aspect of their establishment.  One other suggestion is to beef up the cocktail menu.  The Thirsty Camel bar on the 3rd floor of the Phoenician has an excellent drink menu but they don't replicate it in J&G.  We believe they should replicate it since many patrons get primed at this bar before heading upstairs to J&G.

We will visit J&G again but I hope our next waiter is better than the first.
reviews.author: foxbrij

reviews.title: Don't Go!
reviews.text: I have dined here on many occasions and had fair experiences. The room was managed by a third party restaurant group and they were on top of it.  The view is among the best in the city.  Apparently the hotel, since taking over management of his room, is not giving the restaurant any attention. I stayed at Canyon Suites recently, and the service was 5 stars plus. However, when we tried to go to the J&G lounge for drinks and apps, we could not even get a glass of water.  We were seated by a hostess who was aloof and "too cool".  We sat at a table in the lounge with menus for 25 minutes and no one wanted to acknowledge our presence.  The place wasn't even busy.  We decided to go downstairs to Il Terrazzo and as we walked past the host stand on our way out, the 2-3 hostesses would not even look at us, and did not even say good evening.  I cannot believe the hotel allows this to go on. I hope the new owners and Starwood get their act together. It is such a shame to waste such a super view and location on a substandard establishment.
reviews.author: imajoe

reviews.title: Best flat-iron steak I've ever had, with a killer view to boot!
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I dined here from the "Sunset Dinner" menu. Our appetizers were shrimp and mushroom salad, heirloom tomatoes in goat cheese and raspberry vinaigrette; our entrees were salmon and flat-iron steak; and our desserts were the raspberry pavlova and the chocolate cake. Every single thing we had was stunning. The steak was the best flat-iron I've ever head - cooked to a perfect medium with a deliciously spiced and slightly charred exterior. There was no possibilities of "leftovers" - my palate was in heaven and my stomach was accommodating; I never felt unpleasantly stuffed, but beautifully sated. The view from J&G is immaculate - one of the best restaurant views of the mountains and city around (Talavera at Four Seasons also has a stunning view). This was simply one of the best meals of my life! (Tip: If you dine between 5 and 7 p.m., all bottles of wine under $100 are half-price.)
reviews.author: Niki D

reviews.title: Wonderful Place
reviews.text:
Went there for a birthday celebration. 
The service is attentive with knowledgeable staff; the ambience can't be beat with a gorgeous view and very good food. 
The only reason I gave this review 4 instead of 5 stars was because of the two appetizers we had; the tuna tartare and the crab cake; although freshly prepared, we thought rather bland.
But steak, lobster and veal porterhouse were all delicious. 
Try the warm chocolate with the caramel ice cream; simply divine!
This was a wonderful place to celebrate a special occasion and honestly can't wait for the next one to go back.
reviews.author: suzanw62

reviews.title: Amazing food and service!
reviews.text: J&G Steakhouse is a must if you are in the Scottsdale area. I dined there with my family and friends during our recent stay at the Canyon Suites at the Phonecian. For a fine dining establishment they were very accommodating of the four toddlers in our group. The service was excellent and efficient and the food was amazing and that is coming from a 'foodie' who has pretty high standards. The wine etiquette was impressive and the selection did not disappoint!
reviews.author: JasleenSD

reviews.title: 10yr Anniversary dinner
reviews.text:
I swore that I would never go to J&G, but never swear on anything !
This was a last minute thought as to I almost dropped the ball on our anniversary dinner plans . 
I decided to surprise my wife with a steak dinner on top on the Phoenician Resort, I figure the view would be amazing for this special night. 
We sat on the terrace for the great view, we ordered a glass of Lucian Albrecht rose, then ordered a bottle at half price of Chateaux Carbonieaux white 2010. Anything under a hundred dollars is half price for happy hour! We then started with the seafood tower, very good, one draw back though, muscles were dry and rubbery, but we sent them back and traded them in for more oysters, and they really took care of us from here on. Their Sommelier recognized me from being in the business and sent us out some apps. Our service was impeccable and so was the food. We ordered a bottle of 2011 Clio from Jumilla, Spain  this is an absolute favorite of mine, I really enjoyed it with my ribeye steak. This came with a variety of sauces  recommended by our sommelier , sauce bernaise and the peppercorn  sauce were the favorites and then came a fantastic dessert combo. This night will be remembered for many years to come. We will definitely be coming back this year. We will make up a good excuse to blow $500 on a very well priced experience!
Never thought I'd ever say that, but very well worth the money,  that I really can't afford to spend very often.
reviews.author: dispersed_camper

reviews.title: great food
reviews.text: food all around was fantastic.  appetizer was one of the best salads i've ever had and service was very attentive.
reviews.author: nageron

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: This place is clueless when it comes to providing any kind of service.  The place is obviously under staffed even though the bar area has one of the best views in all of Scottsdale so you would think they would anticipate a crowd.  It took my party of 4 over 20 minutes to get a cocktail at the bar.  Service at dinner was pathetic.  When I complained after all four of us getting our meals at different times after a very long wait.....the manager there said they'd try harder next time to do better.  There will be no
reviews.author: Kentoos

reviews.title: Another Perfect Evening
reviews.text: The reason I read so many reviews is to ensure a perfect experience when spending ample money. Tripadvisor provided that opportunity, once again. Firstly, I can't stress enough how unusual it is for both of us to order the same thing; and a tasting menu at that. Which means, 4 items for one of the most exotic eaters and also one of the simplest eaters to enjoy. Well we did. And what a test of service a tasting menu is too.  Each course artfully presented, immediately followed by its paired wine, was on a complimentary plate and at the right temperature. I can only use words like sumptuous to describe the food. Assuming the lighter courses would be paired with a chardonnay, I told the wine steward that we've never met a chardonnay we like, in case you serve any. Two of the pairings were, in fact chard, but he expertly paired 2 European whites instead. Beautifully done without any attitude, he clearly cared only about pleasing our palettes. The view is spectacular, and for a James Beard award winning chef, the price was quite reasonable. Cannot wait to return.
reviews.author: winelover11

reviews.title: FAAANTASTIC
reviews.text:
Great food and atmosphere with impeccable service.   Quality comes at a price but it is worth it.
Order the bakes Alaska for dessert.
reviews.author: RSTT3959

reviews.title: Go but don't order the $60. prime porterhouse steak..............
reviews.text: We stayed at The Phonecian so we dined at their restaurant. It is touted as a steakhouse so naturally I ordered the steak. It came perfectly cooked but substantially lacked flavor. Not a good cut of meat. Very disappointed. The waitor convinced me to have the tuna tartare  over avocado. It was good, not great for a John George restaurant.
reviews.author: lfbmonkey

reviews.title: Had our Wedding Dinner Here
reviews.text: The service was flawless, even though the planning process leading up to the event was a nightmare.  The food was excellent, and the room was done beautifully.
reviews.author: SuzanneMWH

reviews.title: Beautiful view at sunset!
reviews.text: The steak was very good, but the dover sole rocked! The wine list had good selections, but prices were more than double the retail cost. It was hard to find any deals. I would eat here again if staying in the Scottsdale area.
reviews.author: Jimking2

reviews.title: Love the view but less than impressed
reviews.text: This is a beautiful space overlooking the amazing resort facilities.  We had amazing wonderful appetizers, but that is where my positives ended.  I ordered a steak rare, it seemed to be more grey in color than cool and red.  The vegetables that we ordered were all quite plain.  We had the chocolate cake for dessert which was perfectly average.  The final impression was that we had ordered 2 glasses of port with our dessert, it was $12/glass.  They charged us for $18/glass port which may not seem like a huge deal after such a large meal, but after tax and tip it was  $20 discrepancy, which is significant to this coupon clipping Mom.  When we pointed it out, they spent 20 minutes tapping away on their screen only to finally tell us that because we had paid as a group and tip had been charged to someone else, they were only able to give us $11 back on their $20 mistake.  This is an unacceptable resolution coming from a place that is supposed to be known for its service.
reviews.author: Elh4572

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: This is a truly outstanding restaurant.  Well worth a trip.  Service and food are off the hook good.  Fantastic view from the balcony.
reviews.author: Longballer

reviews.title: Great food great service
reviews.text: We came to celebrate our anniversary and were not disappointed. Our waiter Jeff was entertaining ( in a good way). Jeff explained how each steak would come out if you ordered rare medium etc. so there were no surprises. They have a nice variety so if you are not into steak the Dover sole was outrageously deliciousness. The biggest surprise came when I was casually explaining to my sister that usually when I drink cognac I like to have my glass warmed it brings out the bouquet in the cognac. No sooner had I said that when the bartender Loren walked over and offered to warm the glasses. That's what I call attention to detail
reviews.author: Omigann

reviews.title: overpriced cow...
reviews.text: great, but if I were paying the bill I'd skip it.... guess I just don't get the steakhouse trend, I thought it ended in the 90s
reviews.author: Ben B

reviews.title: delightful dinning
reviews.text: excellent food and service.  reservations a must. fills up quickly. sit outside the view is excellent, especially at sunset.
reviews.author: TravelnDr

reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.text: We popped in for dinner here without reservations and sat in the bar area ~ not the most comfortable, but we made do.  Good service, delicious steak and baked potato.  Everything is a-la-carte and pricey as you'd expect.  Excellent view if you get seated near the window.  I'd eat there again.
reviews.author: ketml

reviews.title: Perfect for a Special Occasion (or any time you want great steaks)
reviews.text: This was our 1st time at J&G even though we have stayed at the Phoenician several times in the past.  I have no idea why we never tried it before now.  I indicated in the online reservation that this would be our 1st visit and that we would be celebrating my son's 20th birthday.  We got there right before sunset and got seated at a perfect inside round table overlooking the patio with a beautiful view of the mountains, palm trees and opal sky.  The hostess seemed more than happy to take our picture outside.  Service was exceptional in every regard.   Fried calamari, steaks, drinks, vegetables....all beyond delicious.  To top it off, they brought out a beautiful dessert for my son with "Happy Birthday" written on the plate (and no singing!).  We LOVED everything about this restaurant.  Thanks for making my son's birthday celebration so wonderful!  We'll be back in the fall.
reviews.author: cakybr100

reviews.title: The venue and service was exceptional.. the food was just OK
reviews.text:
The highlight of the restaurant is the venue itself.  The place is beautiful and the views exceptional.. Unfortunately, the food takes a back seat to the venue.  While good, the steak quality was average. The appetizer was not good at all.  I had the soup which had no flavor at all.  My friend had the salad and said it was good.  While I understand the chocolate molten cake was invented at this establishment, I have had much better versions at other restaurants.  It was not bad, it just was not exceptional.  
Service was excellent but the food itself, disappointing.
reviews.author: Debbie M

reviews.title: Impeccable Service!
reviews.text: Wait staff was remarkable!  Had a group of 20 and our server remembered everyone's drink order, menu order and was attentive without being invasive.  Food was excellent, especially for this hard to please group!  Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Robin T

reviews.title: good
reviews.text: nice atmosphere - good service - smart professional wait staff, good choices and afterwards the deck with the outside firesides were great
reviews.author: terminal454

reviews.title: Doesn't Live Up to the Hype!
reviews.text: We recently stayed at the Phoenician and were excited to eat at J&G Steakhouse which is located in the Phoenician.  When you walk into the restaurant, the view is spectacular.  Unfortunately, that was the only thing that was spectacular.  The food, drinks and service were mediocre at best.  Our server was over-hyping the award-winning chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.  When we would inquire about a certain menu item, she would say that the dish was one of her favorites and a signature dish.  Although as I listened to her speak with the other tables nearby, when they inquired about other dishes, she said the same thing.  Either all the meals are her favorite and signature dishes or she is not genuine.  My hunch was the later.  Although it was good, I would not go back.  I think they need to train the servers to be more themselves and not an automaton saying the same things to each table.  It really got to be annoying.
reviews.author: Manny C

reviews.title: Steaks have no flavor
reviews.text:
We were at the restaurant for a special birthday for my wife.  Views are awesome.  Service at the restaurant bar while we were waiting was very good. 

I ordered the Rib Eye steak, and my wife ordered the filet.  The waiter told us the chef just cooks the steaks with minimal items, and lets the meat flavors speak for themselves. They did speak--there is no flavor.  One of the most bland uninteresting steaks I've had in some time.  Quite frankly, the petite sirloin steaks we get at Fry's and cook on our own grill are far superior.  And the price for the two steaks--$107 is way over-priced for what you get.
reviews.author: guardian2015

reviews.title: Terrible customer service for my family
reviews.text:
We have taken our girls to the Canyon Suites for the past two years for winter vacation.  We often enjoy the resort's amenities during the first two days or so to get reacclimatized to the weather and time change.  This last time, we took our girls to J&G. We knew the food was excellent, as we've enjoyed meals there when vacationing at the Canyon Suites without the kids. 

The service was shameful.  We chose not to drink alcohol with our kids present, and the service went down from there. As my husband and I "watched the show" being put on by the servers and the manager who lurked around the restaurant, we quickly "got the picture": people buying bottles of alcohol got great service. Our server never explained the menu to us. When asked about certain dishes and how they were prepared, he was really disinterested in making suggestions. We placed our orders hoping things would get better.  When our order arrived without a vegetable we ordered for our daughter, the server never offered any explanation nor an apology nor any acknowledgment anything was wrong. Instead, when my husband asked him why had the vegetable was not brought out, , he turned to offer " I don't know why it didn't come out. It could've been a kitchen error, or a computer error. I just don't know."   We were so embarrassed and shocked that this man behaved like this -- but only with us. Had the manager ever once come to check on us, as he lurked around the restaurant looking worried about something other than his customers--- we would've have surely told him what happened. And I would not have had to write this review. As an employment attorney and employee relations business owner, I get it that one employee shouldn't always define a restaurant's culture.  Bad service can indeed define the culture, however, when bad service is allowed to stand unchecked. I've read other customers' reviews about this restaurant at this location and the customer service is inconsistent at best.  

Juxtapose this with the table next to us (who had their children with them also), but chose to drink alcohol: we heard our server very cheerfully explain EACH item on the menu to another table; he smiled; he seemed genuinely interested in them enjoying their dining experience. At another table diagonal from our table, he was simply charming.  Was it their alcohol order or our bad breath? I don't know, and as a customer, it shouldn't matter.  Excellent customer service to each and every customer should be the default. 

According to the "Customer Experience Impact Report" published in 2010, "Almost 9 out of 10 consumers say they would pay more to ensure a superior customer service experience." As an employee relations business owner, I can go on and on with stats about why businesses close because of customer neglect. 

This restaurant will fail. And it won't fail because of the product--the food was excellent.  It will fail, along with many others, because of its poor customer service. There are many restaurants in Scottsdale that serve excellent food and also have excellent customer service. And when we visit next year and the years after that, I'll always go to those restaurants instead--even though it's a hassle to leave the property, and I'll tell my friends and loved ones who live in Scottsdale or who plan to visit Scottsdale to visit other restaurants who care about all their customers. Speaking of which: Olive and Ivy is an excellent restaurant with great good and great service. It was a very busy Friday night and we walked in off the street with no reservations. They gladly situated us on the patio in a corner with a drippy fountain AND THEY DID EVERYTHING THEY COULD TO MAKE US FEEL LIKE WELCOMED GUESTS. They knew the seating wasn't ideal, but everyone from the hostess, who had to break the bad news to us about the patio, to our server, accommodated us and made us feel like welcomed guests because that's what successful businesses do. After a while, we chalked the cold patio up to ambience. I will pay for excellent customer service every time. This is how it goes for businesses which understand that making customers happy will have the direct side effect of those same customers returning time and time again opening their wallets to pay whatever the price!
reviews.author: ComeOnYall

reviews.title: Dinner at Steakhouse
reviews.text: Excellent presentation and food. Wine list was awesome! We really enjoyed the atomsphere and the Manager actually stopped by to check on the service and the meal.
reviews.author: bretdb

reviews.title: Good Food Big Food
reviews.text: Good food coupled with a lovely wine list. My only issue was that some of the beef portions were much too large for a normal person. They had a 32 ounce prime rib that would weigh in at 22 ounces once the bone was removed. Other cuts were quite large as well and were even too large when you got the "small size" edition. This is not a setting that should feature volume. Small Kobi portions would fit better here. But, a Very Good experience indeed. Try it.
reviews.author: ANOUL

reviews.title: Don't go with a group
reviews.text: We went to the restaurant with a group of about 20 for dinner.  You could tell that the staff was just going through the motions to get us in and get us out.  There was no personality.  We had a fixed menu and the minute we sat down, the waiter said, "Steak or Tuna?"  No explanation of the options, etc. Same way with the wine, "Red or white?"  No explanation of the wines.  I know our bill for the group was hefty but the experience was light.
reviews.author: DillonJames

reviews.title: Lovely Evening
reviews.text:
I was here for a business dinner with a few foodies and JG did NOT disappoint. We started with foie gras, then ordered more appetizers, and then enjoyed steak for most of us at our table. The array of flavors are very well done and the chef clearly knows how to impress. I would highly recommend this restaurant. It was nice to go outside on the verandah after dinner for a wonderful ending to a fabulous dinner. 

Only issue, the bottles of wine are a little pricey so be careful what you select. A few were 2-3xs the cost --- according to a wine expert in our group.
reviews.author: georgianna w o

reviews.title: awful
reviews.text: Was looking forward to eating there due to their renowned head chef. Coming from New York and being a foodie, my expectations were high. My husband ordered a steak. It was extremely pricey, yet it was thin, the portion was small, it was overcooked and yet arrived cold. The portion of creamed spinach "to feed two persons" was pricey and small. I don't mind paying more for great food. I did mind paying for that meal
reviews.author: Michele L

reviews.title: Превосходные стейки!
reviews.text: Прекрасный панорамный ресторан. Отличное вино,вкуснейшие стейки делают вечер прекрасным,а ночная панорама Скоттсдейла дополняет картину. Обслуживание на высшем уровне. Столик лучше бронировать заранее. Отличное место для спокойного романтического вечера.
reviews.author: Alexander D

reviews.title: Great Food....Terrible Service
reviews.text: Went to J&G for our anniversary!  Was seated right on time for our 7:15 PM Reservations but then it took 45 minutes to get our drink order and bread. It then took another 30 minutes to get our food order placed and another 30 minutes for the food to arrive.....and then without our side order.  In fairness, the hostess (mgr) came to our table to ask how the evening was going.  I explained the situation and how displeased we were with the service,.....especially at the Phoenician....one of the top restaurants in Phoenix.  She removed the wine and side dish charges from our bill, which was a nice gesture.  Hopefully this first class restaurant will improve the training of their staff to maintain their first class status.;  I may go back again to see how they are doing!!!
reviews.author: BareboatCaption

reviews.title: J & G over priced and disappointed
reviews.text:
Recently I went out to dinner with my wife to J & G at the Phoenician, the atmosphere and setting was very nice. Unfortunately we were very disappointed in the quality of service and food.
Our appetizer was very late in coming (but they did offer little morsels of fired truffle cheese balls).
I ordered the "Tomahowk Wagyu steak for two"  The meat was ordered as medium and arrived medium rare. Wagyu beef is supposed to be similar to Kobe. Our waiter told us it came from Australia, Have to check on this. It was a very expensive dish and I expected more. The meat was very grizzly and had a lot of "silver" liniing in it. About 50% of it was inedible fat.  The side dishes were ok, nothing to write home about and same for the desert. I did order a lobster tail that never came and the waiter just joked about it. I was not charged for it.
Over all, I think it's a great place to sit on the terrace, enjoy a glass of wine and order appetizers.  The Pork belly was good.
reviews.author: tvk111

reviews.title: Amazing dinner
reviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed an amazing dinner here this past week. We decided on the Chef's tasting menu with the wine pairing. Each course was amazing and the wine complimented each course perfectly. The filet was tender and the chocolate dessert paired with port was a perfect ending to the dinner.
reviews.author: Gail042014

reviews.title: Surprise Valentine Availabilty
reviews.text: We were able to get a table last minute on Valentine's day!  What a nice surprise since it was well communicated through hotel that they had been booked for months.  Delicious dinner, great wine, superb service!
reviews.author: CDonovan9

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Of all the amazing restaurants in scottsdale, this place is certainly among the top.  The service and food were excellent.  Great for dinner or even to sit in the bar and enjoy apps and a drink.
reviews.author: Jeffrey L

reviews.title: Service & views
reviews.text: This is a beautiful space overlooking the lively Phoenician pools. It is seriously gorgeous and also the best place to eat if you are staying at the Phoenician.  The service was very attentive and timely. We had the pork belly and the truffle puffs. The pork belly was good and the truffle puffs were ok, not memorable.   I had the petite filet and my table mate had the sole. The filet was good, not the best I've ever had but it was decent. The sides were great. We had the macaroni and cheese and the creamed spinach. Both were delicious. The J&G carrot cake was superb.   Overall a nice dinner.
reviews.author: MEGADAN

reviews.title: J & G Steakhouse at the Phoenician
reviews.text: Just had a conversation with Patick H General Manager at the Steackhouse concerning Jan Elliotts" post of 12-1-14. I'm the one in the wheelchair (I wanted to show off Phoenix in the best (?) hotel to two special people). It seems making a reservation early (early Oct?) or the 2 follow up calls I made requesting a view (and remindiing the staff I was in a wheelchair) was not the only thing that needed to be done. On the day of the reservation if you are not happy with the table or location one just has tell the manager (?) . I assumed calling 2 months early was the key. Not so. Requests made to the restaurant change day to day, They try their best to accommodate all of us. I was disappointed my early reservation was not, well, not important enough. As to the view we didn't get one because where we were at the back of the the room far from the view plus the room was full of light (for the kids?) and blocked the outside view. Very disappointed
reviews.author: MAUREEN M

reviews.title: A+ Prices, B+ Food, A+ Views
reviews.text: Very pricey for steaks with absolutely no seasoning. But the view is great. I suggest just ordering the caramelized Brussels sprouts and the least expensive steak. Also, we were told the only available reservations were at 6:15 p.m. When we left at 8:00pm, over half the tables were still empty!
reviews.author: TexasLina

reviews.title: Excellent choice for a special night out
reviews.text: We went out to this restaurant for two friends birthdays.  We were seated within 15 minutes (right on time for our reservation).  My wife had a foot in a cast and had a knee scooter.  The staff picked up on this and immediately placed a portable ramp on the stairs to our table, before taking us to it.  Nice touch.  The food was excellent, service was excellent and the food came out perfectly paced so as to not make us feel rushed.  The manager visited us several times to make sure everything was perfect.  He was friendly and played well with our joking around.  It turned out to be a very nice meal.  We all ordered the Tasting Menu.  You cant go wrong with that choice.
reviews.author: Capt65

reviews.title: Popular and tasty
reviews.text: We have been here a few times and if the weather permits, I recommend the outdoor seating.  You should get reservations to ensure a spot as it does get busy, especially on weekends.  The food is good; the atmosphere is excellent.
reviews.author: AKEPIL

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Very nice menu.  Dover Sole is excellent.  I think we've eaten most items on the menu and have always been pleased.  The shrimp are very large and very good.  Wonderful service.
reviews.author: T P

reviews.title: Excellent food but service was bad
reviews.text: We went there for dinner and the service was terrible. Dinner for four lasted over three hours. The food was wonderful but not good enough to overcome the terrible service.
reviews.author: sandykjd

reviews.title: Average steakhouse expected more
reviews.text: J&G is a pricy steakhouse but it isn't to par. To me, an average steak house visitor, it was just average. The cuts of meat are ok but the taste was subpar. We shared a porterhouse and I've had better porterhouses at restaurants in the valley for half the price. The waiter was great and informative but the menu and price is not. Im not sure how much longer this place will stay open.
reviews.author: JamezDean

reviews.title: Exceeds expectations
reviews.text: I was very pleasantly surprised by this on site steakhouse. My expectations were not very high, as I expected that being a hotel, even a resort, restaurant would mean that it could get by with mediocre. But it wasn't, neither the service or the quality of the meat. Both were several notches above where I would have expected. It was, quite honestly, one of the best steaks of my life !!
reviews.author: soapdodger73

reviews.title: Not a "rose" picture
reviews.text:
We were there in early December for 4 days.
L &G Steakhouse is supposed to be main restaurant of this landmark resort in Scottsdale. We called for reservations the second night of our stay and requested a table for 7:30 PM. We were told that they could not accommodate us until 8 or 8:15. So we showed up at 8 PM to face an almost empty restaurant. Only a few tables were occupied!!!
I am always worry when you see an almost empty restaurant on a weekend especially if the hotel in which it is located is almost full.
We ordered a bottle of rose from the Wine list menu of the restaurant, "Chateau Fontenille 2006".
The server served us the wine...a true Bordeaux explaining to us that this particular RED is really called a ROSE. I respectfully explained to the waiter and later on to the manager that the wine served and falsely labelled as Rose is a Bordeaux as indicated by the color (deep ruby) and as indicated on the label of the bottle....! I even pointed out the grape composition detailed on the label of the bottle (75% Merlot ,15 % Cabernet Franc and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon)
To no avail, they both insisted that it was a rose as listed on the wine menu. I asked to see the sommelier but was told he was not available......(obviously no sommelier)
We finally ordered another bottle but the waiter and the manager were not not very happy...
The meal itself....very average (kegs style) but with much higher prices.
Service below average. Extremely disappointing experience given the prices of the rooms and  meals as well as the reputation of the resort.
For the rest of our stay, we ate at the Italian restaurant Il Terrazo restaurant on the lower floor of the hotel. Much better in terms of service, quality/price ratio and ambiance. The staff also know their wines a lot better.
I do not foresee a very long life to L & G Steakhouse.
reviews.author: jpl346

reviews.title: Beautiful view and food
reviews.text: We tried the tasting menu and we were not disappointed.  It was a great way to sample some key dishes and were completely full when we were done.  The panoramic view of the city was amazing from our table as well.
reviews.author: Amy

reviews.title: What a great meal and experience!
reviews.text:
My family took me to J&G for my birthday dinner - they couldn't have picked a better place.  The servers were very friendly and extremely knowledgable about everything on the menu and wine list.  It was fun just listening to them describe the food and how it was prepared.  We followed their recommendations on just about everything and we were not disappointed.
Onion soup was the best my brother ever had and that is saying a lot.  The steaks were superb.  Everyone was cooked as ordered.  We shared several sides which is the way to go.  I had the baked Alaska (coconut) and I would go back just to get another.  It was a true "dining experience". 
Almost forgot to mention the beautiful view of the sunset and Phoenix at night from the restuarant.
reviews.author: MBM910

reviews.title: Right on the mark
reviews.text:
Had dinner there while staying at the hotel. Nice to walk straight to the restaurant.

No problem with a Friday night reservation during the Christmas break. Nice. 

The atmosphere is very nice. Warm colors, low light and fantastic view . Seating was private and comfortable. Lounge pions player enjoyable and not too loud. 

We did the tasting menu with wine pairings. Enjoyed it but probably wouldn't do it twice. For a tasting menu the servings were a bit better than average. Wine pours average. The food was well prepared and presented. The mushroom risotto excellent. The grouper exceptionally light. Steak the only miss. Nice cut but undercooked. Chocolate cake for dessert spot on. 

Wines were Ok. A bit too sweet of whites for my personal liking. The red with the steak was good however. Fun to try 5. 

The best aspect was service. Excellent all night. Professional, attentive and well timed. 

Easy to recommend for a slow dinner with someone special.
reviews.author: Maplehawk

reviews.title: Great Steak
reviews.text: Expensive but delicious. We shared some apps but left room for steak and sides....all good; very well serviced in a gracious setting at the Phoenician.
reviews.author: lkatz430

reviews.title: Excellent dining experience
reviews.text: The food and service were outstanding. The resort is lovely (we did not stay at the resort, just went for dinner), and was decorated beautifully for Christmas. In the summertime, plan for sunset as the view is very nice. Our server was exceptionally helpful, and everything we ordered was delicious. I would gladly go to J&G Steakhouse Scottsdale at The Phoenician every time I am in Phoenix.
reviews.author: lfitzs

reviews.title: Elegant Steakhouse With Amazing Views
reviews.text: J&G Steakhouse was wonderful, the staff were very nice and they were always there if you needed anything. The steakhouse has a patio with scenic views of the city horizon. The food was very good, there stakes are definitely worth ordering. The stake(s) come with 3 different stake sauces, I found each one to be extremely delicious! Their seafood is also very good, and fresh. Usually on Friday or Saturday nights they have a singer or a guitar player. J&G Steakhouse, which is located on the top floor of the Hotel, is a great place to eat especially if you are staying at the Phoenician!
reviews.author: Dj112

reviews.title: Overpriced and rushed service
reviews.text: Ordering the tasting menu promptly unleashed a rushed service of the four courses along with wine pairing that was equally hurried.  However, first of all we were unable to read the menu as our table was in darkness due to thejplacement of the table uner recessed lighting. No effort was made to assist us with the lighting issue.   Food was OK but very rich, but tasty.  Over all value was disappointing. (This is a very poor substitute for their World Class predecessor, Mary Elaines!)
reviews.author: miner53

reviews.title: great service, great steak
reviews.text: This steakhouse is definitely a place to come back to.  Lots of space around the tables, a wonderful view, but the service and food brings me back.  The petite filet is larger than its 8 oz. size reported on the menu---done perfectly and the service was just right.
reviews.author: Jim F

reviews.title: Very good, but overpriced
reviews.text:
We dined here as guests, the reservations having been made by out-of-towners who based their selection on a variety of reviews.
As locals, we would not return.  The food was fine--a very nice selection of steaks, plus chicken and fish.   Salads were probably resort-guest friendly, as there was nothing that spoke of creativity.  Side dishes were similarly "safe".  The wine list seemed extensive.
As a really nice resort restaurant, J and G does a fine job with its appeal to a variety of diners from all over the world.  Does it reflect its southwestern location and availability of ingredients? No.
I will say that at this time of year, Phoenix gets cold once the sun goes down.  There is outdoor seating, and with the doors constantly opening and closing to serve guests on the patio, the draft is constant.  Bring a wrap!!
reviews.author: JARPHX

reviews.title: Nice evening out
reviews.text: We enjoyed the bone in fillet and it was excellent. Others had Grouper...very good. The service and atmosphere great. Have dinner in the evening when the sun is setting and bring a camera....beautiful view.
reviews.author: Donald V

reviews.title: No vale lo que cobran
reviews.text: el lugar es muy bonito, espectacular la vista, carísimo, vale la pena ir si quieres pagar por ver gente bonita, porque aunque la comida es bastante buena, el servicio no esta a la altura de la decoración, menos de los precios que cobran
reviews.author: R B C

reviews.title: A for ambiance, A- for food, C+ for value
reviews.text: My steak was very good, but $10 for a baked potato seems a bit exorbitant (and I don't usually notice these things).  It would be difficult to get out of there for less than $100 a person (with wine and tip).  It seems they train staff, and engineer menu and wine list, to make sure your tab is as high as possible.  I've been to lots of other high-end steak houses (Ruth's Chris, Mastro's, Palm) but for some reason felt this place is doing a bit of price-gouging.  Overall, very nice bar, views, and design ... but is it worth it?
reviews.author: will505

reviews.title: Great dinner & view
reviews.text: We enjoyed an excellent dinner with very good service from the staff. The view from our table was outstanding.
reviews.author: Cyndi J

reviews.title: Great food but a bit expensive
reviews.text: The food at J & G was excellent.  Try the butternut squash soup for an excellent appetizer.  All entrees we ordered were very well prepared and delicious.   If ordering steak, be sure to explain how you want it prepared.  Their medium-rare is a cold center for example.   Great place for a special occasion.   The city light views are amazing.
reviews.author: agg2011

reviews.title: Great Views and Good for Cocktails
reviews.text: I went there for Thanksgiving.  The food was good and the service great.  The only thing was that my friend is in a wheelchair and we were somehow put out of the way in a room that seemed like an old banquet room and was filled with children.  It seemed like it was more suitable for families. Where we were located was very disappointing and we mentioned this to the manager not sure though that he was very interested.  The booking had been made a month before.. If you book here make sure you ask for a central location in the restaurant...
reviews.author: JDE0911

reviews.title: Food was better than the service
reviews.text: The J&G located at the Phoenician resort: it is a great location, top floor, great view, nice fireplaces outside, nice tables outside, nice setting inside. The food we ordered was very tasty also; 12 oz filet was $47, there is a nice chicken dinner that is closer to $22- pretty reasonable, given the setting. Where it is a bit "ehh" is the service. It doesn't match the setting. Not quite attentive enough, the drink service not as professional as you might anticipate. Overall- it is OK. Been there maybe five times in recent trips to the area, and it is just OK. There are a couple of alternative down the road a few minutes that are very strong, and make the decision more difficult.
reviews.author: getawayfunforus

reviews.title: Great food.
reviews.text: I went there for a couple meals.  Truly enjoyed the food.  Service perfect, food equaled the service.  Even though I was by myself, I felt like I was well attended.
reviews.author: Glenn L

reviews.title: Excellent steak - try the Fillet Mignon
reviews.text:
Arrived unannounced with a colleague, and were sat in the bar area: similar seating, and the same menu.  We were underneath an aircon outlet, and moved as we were getting a little cold, but no other complaints at all.

The service was excellent, the food also. We had:
- lobster
- fillet mignon
- t-bone steak
My t-bone was excellent, but I also shared some of my colleague's fillet mignon, which was even better.

Oh, and try the bread rolls: full of butter and very tasty!
reviews.author: MikeCamel

reviews.title: Overall Very Good Food in a Lovely Atmosphere
reviews.text: This Steakhouse is located in the beautiful Phoenician Resort. This restaurant is a steak house and more featuring some foods laced with mildly Asian Flavors. The two plates we had that Blew me away were the delicious Tuna Tartare and the scrumptious Black Truffle Cheese Fritters. These are MUST get plates! I can't always eat raw tuna and my husband hates avocado but somehow J&G made the Tuna Tartare absolutely delicious. The Black Truffle Cheese Fritters are additive. They are small and marble sized but they are so darn tasty we were sad when they were finished and could have eaten a boatload of them. They are seasoned like the most delicious risotto you ever had studded with truffle taste and have a thin crispy shell that reminds me of potato chip taste. For dinner I had the Sautéed Grouper with Spaghetti Squash. I was told my fish was flown in that day. The fish was perfect and Miso Sesame broth with chili oil was seasoned very delicately not to over power the fish. My husband had the 19oz. Prime Rib Eye. I thought the Steak on par with other steak houses of this price range but the Black Pepper Condiment was very memorable. It tasted like a mixture of Confit Onions cooked down with beef drippings and Black pepper. The condiment was very developed with flavors. The only thing that faired less well with me and I note only due to my taste was the Brussels Sprouts. Not bad but didn't sing to me. For dessert we shared the Apple Crumble with cinnamon ice cream. It was as delicious as an apple crumble can be but I admit I was hoping for something more fancy from a fine place like this. Overall very good Food. Service was very efficient.
reviews.author: TheSaltyPepper

reviews.title: delicious steak and very accommodating
reviews.text: The view was absolutely stunning; we went at 5:30 as the sun was setting in brilliant pinks against the rocky landscape. The steak was delicious.  And best of all, when my son found his chosen entree "too chewy", the maitre de was so kind; he took my son seriously and very generously had a tender piece of filet brought out.
reviews.author: Waterburian973

reviews.title: Excellent, top notch!!
reviews.text: This was our third visit to this restaurant and it just gets better. The only downside is the noise, but that seems to be the norm for American restaurants. The food was excellent, the Dover sole being the best I have had outside of England. Good attentive service, not over bearing. Will dine here again when we return to the Phoenician.
reviews.author: Jumbuck06

reviews.title: Good food and service
reviews.text: The steaks were cooked to perfection, although I didn't care for the optional sauces as they overpowered the steak. The sides were perfection! It is a steakhouse, and not as good as his other restaurants, but it is on par with a Morton's, Ruth Chris or S&W.
reviews.author: mbtravel2016

reviews.title: Average service and an otherwise excellent meal
reviews.text: Sorry J&G and the Phoenician. I would love to give J&G an excellent rating  - the food was excellent and your ambience/view can't be beat but our waiter was just OK.  A little inattentive and not much personality.  I'm guessing  you nail it 9 out of 10 times so I wouldn't hesitate to return for another try.  My peppercorn strip was cooked to perfection and my wife's sole was beautifully prepared and bursting with flavor.
reviews.author: CraigFloyd

reviews.title: Lovely Decor, Mediocre Food
reviews.text:
Last evening my hubby and I and another couple tried J & G for the first...and last...time." Knock your socks off" fantastic view. Wine (Tuscano sangiovese and Oregon pinot noir)  and drinks (cosmo) were great  but then.... Appetizers crispy calamari were well prepared, but dip was not enhancing, six cheese ball were good too.Wait for main entree was endless.Granted they had two large groups near us, but waiter had warned us to order soon to head off group's order, which we did, but to no avail.Totally understaffed for these sizable groups.  Rolls were dry and tasteless, we all ordered 12 oz. filet mignon ( $47.),which were grilled to our wishes, but bland. Bernaise sauce was totally off the mark: overly lemon flavor; should have been more buttery with only a hint of lemon.We selected sides of saute'd mushrooms of questionable flavor, flavorless brocholi with pecans which were too dry and crunchy, but bravo for the scalloped potatoes with creamy comte cheese. Birthday dessert ended on a plus with delightful small lava cake  and so-so ice cream.
    Decor is impressive, however due to so many hard surfaces, place is overly noisy, making it difficult to carry on a conversation, even with the person next to you.We were not impressed.
reviews.author: luvgr8trvl

reviews.title: Delectable food and gorgeous views!!!
reviews.text: Though this is named a steakhouse, it is so much more.  We had salmon and it was absolutely wonderful.  We also got the 4-sauce option that usually comes with a steak selection but the Bernaise sauce went beautifully with the salmon.  The wait staff catered to our every need and made sure we were happy and comfortable.  We arrived just before sunset and when the sun did set, wow, what an amazing sight up on that mountain overlooking the valley and city lights and seeing the other mountains in the distance!!  This is one of the premier resorts in this area and I can see why.  If you want a special meal or want to treat a guest, this is a perfect choice.
reviews.author: Cathy H

reviews.title: Fabulous setting for a wonderful meal
reviews.text: Either you're a fan of high-end meats or you're not, but either way, you'll enjoy J&G Steakhouse. The restaurant is on the 5th floor of the Phoenician Hotel in Scottsdale and all the exterior walls are glass, so the views go on forever from just about every seat in the lounge and dining room; weather permitting there is also a patio. Time your visit for sundown for the best sky possible! Signature cocktails were terrific (the ginger margarita is incredible) and the bartender suggested the crab cake appetizer, which might be the best I've ever tasted (and I know my way around a crab cake)! Skip the bread (disappointing) add the grilled asparagus side (perfectly prepared) and pick an entree. My companions thought the steaks were uneventful -- but the ahi tuna was amazing, and the dover sole spectacular. We left enough room to share the carrot cake for dessert and it came with cream cheese ice-cream and carrot sorbet. That and a cup of espresso made for a grand end to a great meal.
reviews.author: StChienne

reviews.title: Inconsistent
reviews.text:
Typical dark wood club style steak house – with an air of sophistication.
Good wine.
Steak was good.
Heritage tomato salad with onions – came with good tasting slices of green, orange and red tomatoes – Russian dressing and then to top it greasy batter covered onion rings – could have been good with a few thin slices of red onion but missed the mark.
Inconsistent service
reviews.author: TheTonyTraveller

reviews.title: Great view, average food
reviews.text: Felt pretty typical for a hotel steakhouse.  Service was good not great.  Same for the food.  Was fine for the convenience factor of being in the resort, but not worth a special trip.
reviews.author: Whitney D

reviews.title: "Excellent Food"
reviews.text: I'll begin by saying that the food, the ambiance and the views were outstanding.  Our server, Patrick was kind of demining, I asked for his name after he spent several visits at our table. I said to him, I apologize but I don't remember your name, he responded by saying "I never told you my name". This is a high end establishment and that kind of respond is inappropriate, I spent over $400 dollars. The rest of the wait staff were absolutely perfect, everyone was very attentive, except Patrick. He almost spoke to us like we didn't deserve to be there, one of our guest ordered a drink that he wanted to cancel and Patrick told us that was impossible because it would be too much trouble, are you kidding me. I didn't want to tip 25% but I couldn't punish the wait team for Patrick's behavior.
reviews.author: Michael Z

reviews.title: the best of the best
reviews.text: My friend came to visit from denver for s girls only week. Took her to j & g steakhouse at the Phoenician. She was overwhelmed with the experience,  we were there for restaurant week. The food , the view, the service was A+. Been there numerous times but this time was the best
reviews.author: Marilyn G

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: loved the ambience, food was delicious, view great, excellent service. They have an amazing watermelon soup and tuna tartare.
reviews.author: patriahart

reviews.title: Great Steak as you would expect
reviews.text: The beef was excellent.  The wine list was somewhat limited and really didn't have the upscale offerings that you would expect in an upscale steak house.  The food and service was outstanding.
reviews.author: Michael K

reviews.title: Love the steak!
reviews.text:
Very good service and nice environment!
The steak is very good.
My kids had a great time drawing while we eat.
The menu is on the pricy side but would love to be back in the future.
reviews.author: XxBBxX

reviews.title: Great View & Service
reviews.text: Very nice setting, service and food were excellent. This would be a great place for a special occasion.
reviews.author: Lovetogolf71

reviews.title: Great Summer Menu
reviews.text:
We are locals in Scottsdale and summer is a great time to dine in the resorts as it's easy to get a table (though Elements at Sanctuary was booked full that night) and there are some good bargains to drive business in the slow season.  This summer J&G teamed up with local chefs to create "Sunset Menus" that are good from 5-7p.  These are $40 prix-fixe for 3 courses so a good deal and wine is 1/2 off/bottle.  This month the chef-partner is the guy from Crudo, as mostly that restaurant is raw vegetable oriented I've never been but I really liked his "buttery spicy" filet mignon.  But on to the regular menu.

My wife had the tuna tartare, a staple in the Valley but this was no question the best we've had, and we've been almost everywhere since we are local.  The tuna was wonderfully fatty so actually had some flavor, this is why you pay extra for Toro and I was happy to pay the $18 for this.  I had the crab cake which was served on avocado slices and in a grapefruit broth with slices of tart grapefruit as well.  After an overly fussy crab cake at John Howie's in Bellevue, WA that cost a lot more, I really appreciated this one, and it was bright and light for summer.  My daughter had the charred corn ravioli served in a light bright green basil sauce, again very summery and totally tasty.

For entree my wife had the burger which she seemed to like.  Steaks were cooked perfectly to order, which is something steakhouses seem to get wrong all the time.  The potatoes gratin were actually French dauphinois type and were out of this world, this slices with béchamel sauce and lots of mild French cheese, so great!  Creamed spinach had a much lighter touch than most steakhouses.
