Dessert had a good cappuccino, the peach and raspberry crumble with buttermilk ice cream was tasty but proved too heavy to eat more than 1/2 even with my wife sharing.

The view is really wonderful as you look over all of the East Valley, this time of year you don't get much sunset but in the winter you do.  The dining room is still very sleek and attractive, the leather chairs are kept in great condition and were very comfortable.  Other places have a more private, intimate feel though.  Making up for it is the great deck with fire pits and it's wonderful to enjoy our great weather out there.  All in all a great experience and I love all the art and sculpture filing the property.
reviews.author: JamesR36

reviews.title: Overprices, no taste and not as upscale as promoted
reviews.text: There seems to be absolutely no dress-code. We spotted shorts, T's and flip-flops. Restaurant does not acknowledge any special events like an anniversary. And honestly, the food was disappointing and lacked taste or was overly sweet.
reviews.author: Lars S

reviews.title: J&G Steakhouse: Jolly Good
reviews.text: I have been to J&G three times in the last year. Each visit for business. There was ample underground parking with easy elevator access to the restaurant. The decor is second to none, and the environment was perfect for a meeting. The staff were incredibly attentive and knowledgeable. The recommendations were spot on. I have had the tuna avocado tartar three times and loved it every time. The rolls are really quite unbelievable. I have had the prime porterhouse once and the bone-in-filet mignon twice. The meat was cooked to perfection and exactly as I expected it to be. The sides are all a-la-carte and were delicious (the creamed spinach was particularly good). Having never sampled the desert I am unable to comment, though the coffee was both fresh and smooth.
reviews.author: pipervienna

reviews.title: really good food
reviews.text: We enjoyed this restaurant mote than the Il Terazzo in the same hotel.  Steak wad great service and ambience excellent.
reviews.author: Highlandlass38

reviews.title: Seriously good dining
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic evening meal here the last night of our recent trip to the US.  J&G Steakhouse was seriously good, and we cannot understand why it isn't rated higher in Scottsdale.

We asked for a table with a view when making the reservation, and boy did we get one!  Right in the middle of a huge picture winding looking out over the pool area and out towards Scottsdale and Phoenix.

We found the service to be professional and efficient.  We never had to wait long, but were also not rushed.  Amusingly we had to explain how to make an Irish Coffee at the end of the meal, but it was the manager himself who stepped in when his staff couldn't understand what we were asking for.

The food was outstanding.   Naturally we had steaks.  The fillet was enormous, and we were impressed that the chef didn't butterfly it when faced with a well done request.  We also had seafood, including a mix of west and east coast oysters which were amongst the best we've had.

We highly recommend this restaurant.
reviews.author: SussexCpl

reviews.title: Yummy!
reviews.text: Delicious food and great views of the valley.  Half off wines $100 or less during the summer, before 7pm.  Only downside, it got a bit loud when the music started.
reviews.author: JJBock0929

reviews.title: Outstanding food and service
reviews.text: They treated us so special when they heard about our anniversary celebration. The food is sublime and the customer service and view can't be beat.  Definitely worth the splurge.
reviews.author: bunnyfeet1

reviews.title: View is the best part
reviews.text: Lived in Phoenix for 2.5 years now and finally had dinner at J&G.  As you drive into the resort you get an impressive Palm Beachy feeling.  Grounds are extensive and manicured.  Beautiful fountain as you pull up to the valet.  J&G is actually on the top floor of the resort which will give you some pretty great views from the south.  Our dinners were nothing to write home about.  Felt that places like Ocean Prime and Capital Grill had better steaks.  There two saving graces about this expensive meal.  One was the view and second were the desserts.  Next time I am just going for a cocktail and a dessert.  Tab for 3 people and drinks was close to $400 with tip.
reviews.author: Michael A B

reviews.title: Excellent food, great ambiance
reviews.text: There is a lot of great things to say about this restaurant. Firstly, the view is really nice. Secondly, the food (steak) was excellent. Thirdly, the service was really good. Finally, the ambiance was really nice thanks to the guitarist who was simply stunningly good. A truly memorable place for a nice dinner.
reviews.author: BBreton

reviews.title: Consistently very good
reviews.text: We always eat at J &G steakhouse when in Scottsdale. The classics are always very good as is the service, particular standout this trip was the roasted lobster, absolutely brilliant. Whilst never cheap, the food and service are worth the price here.
reviews.author: AUKTourist

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: This is a great location, on top of the Phoenician with a great view.  Should be much better, the cost is not outrageous, service is great, food was below expectations. The service was fantastic, staff and waiter was knowledgeable, helpful and very attentive.  Also a very good wine list, although some were very pricey, but we found something we liked for less than $100.  The meal was average at best.  The shrimp of my shrimp cocktail were nice size but a little tough, I liked the heritage tomato salad.  I had the veal porterhouse, it was cooked correctly but had a lot of fat and sinew in the cut.  My dining partners cheeseburger came initially severely undercooked and wasn't much better after the reheating, she didn't finish her entree, and they didn't charge for it either.
reviews.author: Ellsworth T

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: We stayed 5 nights at the Phoenician and 4/5 nights ate at J&G!! Blown away by the food and AMAZING service! Both the managers Ryan and Patrick were the most attentive people I have ever met, we have travelled the world and eaten at hundreds of restaurants, but nothing compares to this!! We just couldn't get enough of the amazing food and ambiance! I can honestly say I have never been so impressed by management as I was with Ryan, he truly deserves his position!! He is the reason we kept going back for more, just made our nights fantastic. Thank you!!!!! And a HUGE thank you to all the amazing staff in your establishment
reviews.author: Dana A

reviews.title: Very good steaks and seafood
reviews.text: Just like you'd expect, the Phoenician's big night out restaurant has great food and high prices.  My husband raved about his prime rib and I had a extremely good piece of halibut.  It was pricey but worth every penny.  Awesome view of Scottsdale after dark as well.  Plan to linger in the lounge after dinner.
reviews.author: ScrapChickTampa_FL

reviews.title: Worth the $$$
reviews.text: What a view from on top of this hotel and excellent wine selection. Oysters were exquisite and fresh. Nothing like having my after dinner drink al fresco while seeing their pools below and parts of the city. Definitely order steak. On point. Very refined and my kind of place. Bravo!!
reviews.author: SteveTravels365

reviews.title: Perfect preparation
reviews.text: Our steaks could not have been better prepared. The sides were tasty and fresh. The manager was gracious, providing the proper wine glasses. i also commend his decision to hire Jeff, our very pleasant and knowledgeable server who made the evening fun.
reviews.author: Ken B

reviews.title: A must in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
Outstanding 
The wine list was extensive and the guy pre- tasted before serving . Service , food & atmosphere top class
reviews.author: Normanfran

reviews.title: Expensive but worth the experience
reviews.text: Sat at the bar since I was alone.   The barman was very nice and was very knowledgeable which was appreciated.   He recommended a few dishes.   I had bluepoint oysters and I must say there were decadent!  Then had a lemon Caesar salad which was also lovely.   For my main dish an 8 oz filet mignon with baked potato.   The steak was cooked to perfection if you like medium rare! Wow!   For dessert I had an amazing blueberry cheese cake!  Omg it was amazing!   The barman recommended it and it was a perfect end to a great dinner.   This restaurant is on the 5 the floor of the Phoenician Luxury Hotel,  the views on the terrace are breathtaking looking over the hotel premises and the mountain behind this hotel.    A modern decor inside the restaurant and a big enough bar lounge if you only want to go up for drinks.   It is an expensive restaurant but definitely worth a trip if you like great service and food.
reviews.author: Traveller & Foodie

reviews.title: Good but EXPENSIVE!
reviews.text: Our first night at Phoenician and we decided to eat on site. We had Rib eye for 2 which came beautifully sliced. It was delicious but we have had it just as good for HALF the price elsewhere. I did love the heirloom salad but with cocktails (2 each) appetizers and 1 dessert with coffee our bill came to $350.00! The steak was $130.00 alone which will prompt me to ask price next time. Makes this the most expensive meal my husband and I ever ate. Sanctuary at Camelback was much more reasonably priced, AMAZING FOOD, with a view to die for and would recommend take the 2 mile drive there instead.
reviews.author: Cathy B

reviews.title: Fantastic !
reviews.text: Went for my birthday and the $55 per person , 5 course meal, fifth anniversary offer (expired April 27th). I consider myself pretty food savvy and can honestly say that this is one of the best meals that I have ever had. Food, service, ambiance and view were fantastic. I will definitely go back.
reviews.author: Stephen1952a

reviews.title: Great steak and view
reviews.text: On top of the Phoenician hotel with a view across the valley, J & G offers great food and a wonderful view.  The wine list is amazing and the service is among the best.  Lamb t-bone came out as ordered with great flavor.
reviews.author: dfutransky

reviews.title: Fun evening with friends.
reviews.text: Our food took a bit longer than expected, but we didn't mind as we were enjoying he evening. Veal Porterhouse (ordered by two at our table) was overcooked, but everything else was delicious.
reviews.author: Michelle D

reviews.title: Great restaurant in great great ambience
reviews.text: The food and service was amazing. The views were fantastic. It would be better with a date, but even for work it was great.  I recommend it highly.
reviews.author: ShahramG

reviews.title: The most impressive Steakhouse I've been to
reviews.text: J & G is hands down the most impressive Steakhouse I have ever been to. I have been to Morton's, Ruth's, and Capital Grill and J & G Steakhouse by far exceeds the rest. The service was also first rate. We were visiting ASU for my daughter and celebrated her 18th birthday and they made an amazing strawberry banana cake for her that was out of this world. In addition, the restaurant has a breathtaking view and they had an amazing musician singing. This steakhouse can't be matched!!!
reviews.author: magicdisplay

reviews.title: Incredible view, good steaks
reviews.text: The view at the top of the Phoenician overlooking the valley is stunning, especially at night. The food is very good and well prepared. Two particular items stand out, the veal porterhouse and the ribeye. Both are very flavorful and well portioned. The service is very attentive without being overbearing. One tip, order your steaks one half step more cooked than you would typically order. For some reason they slightly undercook, at least for my taste.
reviews.author: MDFreqTvlr

reviews.title: Very Good Food
reviews.text: The ambience and location of this place is fantastic.  We ate here 2 evenings in a row.  The first evening, I had one of the best pieces of Salmon I've ever had.  We ate on the patio and received wonderful service from Lauren (who we discovered is a descendant of Madame Curie!).  We returned the next night to try the $66 Dover Sole.  It was filleted table side and it was worth the money.  Service on the second evening was a bit sub par however with the server leaving us with the dessert menu, but never coming back to take our order.  He walked past us 3 times and we waited about 15 minutes without him coming back to check on us.  We asked a bus boy for our check and left without feeling valued as patrons.  Other than this incident, the restaurant is well run.
reviews.author: Anthony G

reviews.title: Order the tomohawk steak or the Sole!
reviews.text: We had dinner at JG (Jean George Vongerichten), the famous steakhouse where I dined with a colleague on a tomahawk steak with mushroom and spinach as sides.  The steak was done the way it was ordered (ordered it medium rare) and its flavours were just right with the perfect marbling.  The wine list is very good as well and all the server seemed to know a lot about wine and wine pairings.  Again a sign of a well trained and caring staff.  For starters we had the seafood platter with a bottle of Shramsberg Blanc de Blanc, an excellent Californian sparkling wine.  We had a Californian Cab with the steak and for dessert we shared a delicious apple crumble.  From a service, food presentation and ambiance perspective, it was excellent and I would definitely go back if we were ever in AZ again.
reviews.author: SavvyTraveler738

reviews.title: So close to being Excellent.
reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant in a very high end hotel outside of Phoenix. The entire setting is fabulous with a large, trendy  dining room with large windows creating a very scenic view. The dining room is next to the bar area that has live music. Even if you’re sitiing far from the entertainment, the music can be somewhat loud at times. There is also a banquet room next to the dining room & the day we were there, some sort of function was taking place so we had numerous outbursts of applause, laughter, etc., while not really annoying—it just interfered with the entire experience. The menu is primarily steakhouse although several fish options are also available. While the steaks were very good & were of top notch quality, I don’t believe they have the proper cooking equipment to cook them as a 1st rate steak house should. Just got the impression that the steaks could have been cooked at a higher temperature in order to give them that seared, smoky flavor. I think they could have been seasoned a bit more as well. That being said, the food was very good. Our issues were with the service—very similar to what another reviewer noted. When you’re paying close to $100 a person---no excuse for weak service. It appeared we had at least 10 different people service us during our dinner and they all seemed confused. We had several drink orders come out wrong, meals were served to the wrong person, etc. Just no excuse for that. The Baked Alaska was a big flop. However, all in all, I will give them a second chance the next tome we're in town.
reviews.author: babcme

reviews.title: Perfect for Valentines day or romantic dinner
reviews.text: Came here with hubs this is such a romantic spot overlook all of Scottsdale and camelback mountain. We sat outside on the terrace I suggest you do the same. Service was superb! We ordered the seafood tower, tuna tartar and steaks. Everything was perfect! Mojitos were awesome too. Very reasonable pricing compared to the J&G we have at home in DC
reviews.author: Ariana U

reviews.title: High end dining with a great view
reviews.text: A destination steakhouse at a premiere resort, with the kitchen, service, and wine list you would expect for a top-tier location. Not inexpensive, but provides the full experience, with a view of Phoenix laid out in front of you - so try to get a table with a good view of the Valley to complement the meal.  Special note: the wait staff very pleasant and knowledgeable, and helpful with the wine selection.
reviews.author: jeffOnTheRoad2010

reviews.title: Rotten Tomatoes - Not Jean George Quality Food
reviews.text: Wife and I just had a meal at the J&J Steakhouse and we have to say we were very disappointed.  The service was not good except for good recommendation on wine and some oysters.  Service was extremely slow to the point I was wondering if they were trying to give us a European dinning experience or just couldn't get the food out of the kitchen fast enough.  Some of the dish were down right terrible.  THE TOMATOES IN THE HEIRLOOM TOMATO SALAD WERE ALMOST ROTTEN.   The french onion soup tasted like it was the type you get from the freezer section of your local grocery store.  My wife and I have been to his local at the Trump in NYC and loved it but he should really consider taking his name off of this restaurant.  Upside is the view and ambiance was awesome.
reviews.author: Stephen J

reviews.title: Love, love, love it!
reviews.text: So this was our second night at J & G. We've been to two of the Jean Georges restaurants in NYC (one at the Mark Hotel and the Michelin-starred fancy one) and both were lovely. One obviously more upscale than the other, but both with great attention to detail and the fancy one having superlative rather than just great service. With this background, we were excited to find a J-G restaurant out here in conjunction with our visit to Mayo Clinic. J-G Steakhouse lies somewhere in between: still outstanding food and also the hallmark great service. Highlights: dirty Grey Goose martini with blue-cheese-stuffed olives; ginger margarita; outstanding wine list; peekytoe crab cakes; oysters; butternut squash soup; dover sole; slow-cooked salmon; lobster; fantastic wine list; all just gorgeous. Lowlights: none. This restaurant is just such a great surprise in this location and is a standout for Phoenix. Do not miss it!
reviews.author: wendyruffini

reviews.title: Lives up to reputation
reviews.text: Bellinis best I have ever had. Lettuce wedge yummy.  I requested they chop it for me.  The veal chop large and cooked to perfection.
reviews.author: Carolea G

reviews.title: Let down
reviews.text:
Very mediocre, good waiter, look of attention.
Great view on the balcony but mediocre service, slow, disruptive, 
Processing!
If you are stuck there it's not bad, it Scottsdale has a lot more to offer.
Five star attitude at a three star level, can't beat the view from the balcony under the nice heaters.
reviews.author: Norbert1951

reviews.title: Tasty!
reviews.text: I have had better food for that price but I dont think I have ever had a better view!! The best part of our meal was by far the oysters.  They were amazing! Definitely go and sit on the patio.
reviews.author: Melissa W

reviews.title: They had us at hello.
reviews.text: From the moment we sat down at our table we were in heaven. The wait staff were excellent and took care of our every need. The food, oh the food! Iron chef quality and taste. We even bought a cookbook on the way out so we could relive the experience at home.1
reviews.author: R T

reviews.title: Beautiful, with issues.
reviews.text: Gorgeous restaurant with amazing views and delicious food...if you can get it.  There seems to be some real issues with service here though.  Incorrect orders, food that never comes, etc.  If they can correct this, it would be a great place.
reviews.author: LVonthemove

reviews.title: Large group, mediocre food.
reviews.text:
I was guest in a group of 40. The bi-entree menu selection may be responsible for my disappointment, but the appetizers, main courses, and accompaniments were quite pedestrian.
I am sure the menu must be better, though there were very few diners in the restaurant.
reviews.author: BillyReyn

reviews.title: Great Steakhouse
reviews.text:
Likes:
Food - All the food we had here was terrific
View - Spectacular view, ask for a seat on the patio or near the window
Service - Impeccable service
reviews.author: nmiler84

reviews.title: A million dollar view!
reviews.text: Go just after sunset and watch Phoenix come alive at night from your table while enjoying top of the line dishes and a GREAT wine list! Service is impeccable and the feature of leaving your dogie bag at the exit for you is a nice touch (do we really like walking through a vice restaurant carry a little brown bag?).
reviews.author: ajijic4me

reviews.title: Enjoyable Evening
reviews.text: Great views towards the south of the Phoenix area.  Sunset views are really beautiful.  We didn't dine outdoors but it looked like a great venue.  Very sophisticated and contemporary indoor decor.  Service was attentive and the waitress was very knowledgable.  It wasn't crowded but, if it were, it might be a bit loud.  So if you're looking for quiet to super quiet eat outside.  Excellent menu.  We aren't big beef eaters so the menu had nice choices of fish, chicken, etc.  Not extensive but each entree was excellent for us.
reviews.author: dps_Sedona

reviews.title: Updating
reviews.text:
This is our all time favorite restaurant in town so I thought I would update my review since we were just there last night. This is a great place for locals to go and also to bring your out of town guests. The ambience is amazing - the view - the fire pits and the live music. We have eaten here many times and everything is always delicious. The salad with shrimp, the soups,the lobster, the steak - always have a hard time deciding what to have! Have the same trouble picking a dessert!
The service couldn't be more friendly or helpful. Great way to spend our anniversary and my birthday.
reviews.author: Louvain71

reviews.title: Excellent restaurant
reviews.text:
The restaurant is very elegant and food is delicious. Beautiful view from windows and fire pit on the patio. The service was great with detailed explanation of food and its preparation. I forgot my reading glasses and was very surprised when  waiter bring glasses for me. The crispy calamari were delicious, and my tenderloin was smooth and tasty. Slowly cooked salmon was so good, we never ate so delicious prepared salmon. The Champaign was good, as the wines. Desert list for ours surprise was short at this day, so we did not have Napoleon cake, but what we got was good.

The price is high, but food is great and interior is beautiful. We will recommend this place for  special occasions and romantic gateways.
reviews.author: smr1021

reviews.title: Top notch excellent steakhouse!
reviews.text: No dislikes at all, the food and pairings were amazing.  We were pleasantly surprised at some great sauces that accompanied our dishes.  There is no need to leave the resort with J&G.
reviews.author: TexasAg99

reviews.title: Flawless!
reviews.text: This was the best steak and the best service in my life. We started by sharing a delicious crab cake, and we’ve taste many over the years but this was spectacular. The menu was ala carte and our table ordered grilled asparagus and sautéed mushrooms as sides. The portions were ample, the presentation elegant, with impeccable but not hovering service. The location is fabulous also. The building it is in backs up to the Camelback Mountain, giving the restaurant a wonderful view of the valley and lights below. This restaurant is expensive and once again I learned that you get what you pay for. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Pat M

reviews.title: Special place for a special occasion
reviews.text: We went there for our anniversary.  The atmosphere and service was exceptional.  Candace, our waitress, did a great job helping us with our food and wine selection.  The food was very good. The wine was expensive but great. We were given a free dessert because of our anniversary.  We had the warm chocolate cake which was very good.  The next night we went back just for dessert on the patio by the fire pit.  We had the Baked Alaska which was very tasty! Overall, we had a great experience, and would definitely go back if we are in Scottsdale again.
reviews.author: Markus H

reviews.title: Indulgence at it's finest
reviews.text: This steakhouse is one of the best I have encountered, The ambiance & the view is to die for & the food simply magnificent.
reviews.author: wicketty

reviews.title: Great Views
reviews.text: The steakhouse is on the 5th floor .We ate out side just as the sun was going down great for picture taking . The views are great you can see all over the Phoenix valley The food and service were very good . There are many choices of steak and sea food to chose from . We will be going again in the next few weeks to try something different.
reviews.author: James L

reviews.title: Beautiful views with excellent service.
reviews.text:
Live entertainment in the bar area was phenomenal as was the bar atmosphere.  

I would highly recommend sitting outside for sunset or enjoy cocktails, your meal or dessert near the fire pits.  The view was stunning and the calm quiet ambience a perfect match to the upscale menu and food.

The butternut squash soup with mushrooms was decadent and delicious.
reviews.author: Jacqui

reviews.title: First Rate
reviews.text: Great view. SIt outside. Very knowledge staff and excellent food. Consistent with other J&G locations.
reviews.author: RAHWilmette

reviews.title: Where to start....
reviews.text:
First off the view is amazing but it is pretty much downhill from there.  To start with you are greeted by a person with so many tattoos that she is no way representative of such a high end steak house.  Service was good although it was interesting that the sommelier did not know the first thing about the wine we ordered.  It was a good wine but nothing like he described.   

I ordered the tasting menu and it was horrid except for the steak.   The beet risotto was inedible, the swordfish dry and tasteless, and the only good thing was the steak.  It is a steakhouse and maybe they should stick to just steak as that was the only thing they seemed to get right including desert.   When asked even our waiter bashed the chef and stated most of the risotto and swordfish had been sent back.   Interestingly he stated we should not expect too much and actually recommended another much better restaurant.

In the end it was way too over priced for such bad food.
reviews.author: jorge g

reviews.title: Disappointing service but superb with everything else.
reviews.text:
Dear Mr Patrick N GM of restaurant: it is very nice to see that you respond to all the reviews but clearly your words are lost on your waiting staff.

We were at your restaurant on Thursday 10 Oct and once agin your waiter Jason did not give the price of the Tomahawk despite your comments made several times in TA. Equally the speed at which he ran through the menu was so fast we couldn't understand what he was saying and he had to say it all again. Also once he realised that we were not interested in his Tomahawk or several bottles of wine, and then we split some food, he totally lost interest and he clearly has a issue and attitude problem. Leave that to you!

All of this seriously detracts from what is an exceptional restaurant, wonderful views , nice menu, excellent food great ambience etc.

What bothers me is that you see all the reviews which more or less say the same thing, sort out the service! You must be wondering why you are number 45 in TA as you should be well into the top 10, well,  there's your answer.

Why not just print the Tomahawk on the menu as an option and put the 120 in writing, if it's not available than tell the waiters to say so, just like the ribeye that was not available last night.
reviews.author: Ffejc

reviews.title: Excellent meal and view from patio
reviews.text:
This place is in the Phoenician Resort at the base of Camelback in Phoenix. We visited during 
Restaurant week and watched sunset over Phoenix while we dined. The food was outstanding. We had the Barramundi and Steak and everything was cooked perfectly. Definitely our new favorite Steakhouse and worth the money.
reviews.author: Dan R

reviews.title: Excellent food and view
reviews.text: Great view over Phoenix and Scottsdale, really pretty at night. Enjoyed my salmon and mashed potato was superb.  Steaks were expensive and we did not indulge. Passion fruit sorbet in meringue bombe was best pudding we have ever had in a restaurant - superb!
reviews.author: Pete_Gill_W

reviews.title: Birthday Dinner
reviews.text: Had a great meal in this restaurant that offers a great view of the sunset and city.  The meal was cooked to perfection and the wine list was vey nice.  Order the chocolate cake, it is a great way to end the night
reviews.author: Rebel82

reviews.title: Scottsdale - Best Dinner!
reviews.text: We enjoyed an excellent dinner at J&G Steakhouse at the beautiful Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale during our 2 days in this area. The price may seem a little on the higher side, but well worth the price. Between three of us, we had filet, chicken and salmon - all delicious, and shared two sides - garlic mashed potatoes and asparagus. We would definitely return when in the area. Also a great selection of wines - we found a new Riesling which we have never tried and it is now our favorite.
reviews.author: Debszoo43

reviews.title: Great steakhouse with a beautiful vista
reviews.text: Loved the view. Was nice to sit and look at the view during dinner and then go out to the large patio afterwards. Food was good. This is a high end steakhouse so be prepared for the price point!! Steak and lamb were ordered and both were fantastic. The shrimp cocktail was perfect. The lobster was not however. Would not order that again. Great service as well. If you are looking to spend a good deal of money on a special occasion I'd say this is the place!
reviews.author: Mauibums

reviews.title: They have it all: view, food, service
reviews.text: This is one fine restaurant. We wandered into the resort just to see what it looked like and when they said they had a steak house on the top floor, we decided to try it.  The service was impeccable, thought we were back in NY. The menu had a nice variety and a good wine list. We chose the fixe priced "sunset" special" and were delighted with every bit of it. We watched the sunset and the planes circling and coming into Phoenix Sky Harbor airport. Great place to dine in the Phoenix area and the prices were reasonable for the setting.  We look forward to going back the next time we are in town.
reviews.author: saintjack

reviews.title: Brilliant birthday dinner!
reviews.text: I celebrated my birthday at J&G steakhouse and it was excellent.  The food was superb and this was backed by outstanding service.  Although everything tasted great, noteworthy mention goes to the Lobster entree it was described as "the best ever" rare praise from a person who eats regularly at Jean Georges in New York City.  The complimentary chocolate cake with candle was much appreciated.  Thank you for a birthday dinner to remember!
reviews.author: AUKTourist

reviews.title: Pure steak bliss!
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at the Phoenician for a two say staycation for our anniversary and had dinner here our first night.  The place is located on the top floor of the resort and has an incredible view of the city.  The place is dark but that adds to the romantic feel of the place.  They had a tasting menu available but we also wanted to take advantage of the 25% off our second entree deal and since they would not offer it for the tasting menu we opted for a la carte.  

We started with the tuna tartare, which was excellent.  We then shared the watermelon gazpacho with poached shrimp.  They split the soup for us, which was a nice touch but the taste was average.  It was refreshing though.  For our entrees, my wife had the bone in filet and I had the bone in ribeye.  We had the creamed corn and creamed spinach for our sides.  The steaks were amazing with great flavor and was cooked perfectly.  They were both huge portions and I not only finished my steak but about 1/4 of my wife's too.  They also bring out several sauces you can try with your steaks too which was fun.  They were definitely not necessary because they had great flavor as is, but it was fun trying the different sauces.  We both agree that the J & G steaksauce was the best which had carmelized onions in it.  

My wife and I compared how this steakhouse compares to the many others we have tried and think it ranks a close second, just barely behind Mastro's City Hall.  This decision was made on the basis of the flavor, cost, and atmosphere.  Having said this, we would gladly come back here again because it is an excellent steakhouse.
reviews.author: acwong

reviews.title: Great view from the Restaurant
reviews.text: This restaurant is on the top floor and has is a lovely view looking out towards the mountains.   My partner had the steak and thoroughly enjoyed it.  I am a vegetarian so I had a baked potato and the macaroni cheese, both were very tasty.
reviews.author: Sunshine51_12

reviews.title: Good ...
reviews.text:
We dined in a group of eight with good food and service. Price/value is a bit strong but not unreasonable. Menu is well balanced in the choice of meats as well as some fish plates. The wine list is reasonably comprehensive but too pricey. This is probably normal for Usa where, despite some progress, wine with the meal is still seen as a luxury rather than a necessity. The two choices for fixed menu were well balanced in the choices of both fish and meat. 

The view at sunset was exceptional. One contradiction is the music - great if you are sitting at the bar but intrusive if you are trying to sustain a conversation over dinner. It is strange the management does not recognise this problem as the overall restaurant ambience is very nice. 

In summary, a dinner for 8 persons at ca $450 provided for a pleasant and well spent evening
reviews.author: JeffT535353

reviews.title: Excellent Service - Candace
reviews.text:
This restaurant has a glorious view with romantic torches casting warm light on the terrace balcony.  We lingered over our meal until the torches were put out and the staff was ready to leave.  The highlight of our meal was our server, Candace.  She was knowledgeable about the offerings on the menu, but more than that she was enthusiastic, offering her opinion of certain dishes and side dishes, spices, sauces, etc.  We had eaten at this restaurant the previous evening and the experience was much less satisfying due entirely to the blase attitude of our server.  He didn't seem to care about the menu, nor about communicating to us, his voice soft and lethargic and his service was much the same.  It is not what you do, but HOW you do it.
Hoping that if you choose to visit this restaurant you will enjoy GREAT SERVICE like that provided by Candace.
reviews.author: dewdropfairy

reviews.title: Fantastic atmosphere, staff and menu items
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful dinner experience at this restaurant. First the lounge, great energy, service and decor....really we almost wanted to lounge here the night out sipping on our cocktails made to perfection. This would have been a mistake as dinner was even better. It reminded me of another fabulous steakhouse at the Ritz Carlton Cancun. J&G staff were amazing, present but not too much, great knowledge of the menu. From Patrick To Ryan to David, they all contributed to create a WoW experience...I was not expecting such a level of service in this large resort.
reviews.author: Eric_Chico

reviews.title: Buena comida
reviews.text: La comida es exquisita, muy elegante y sofisticada. Los precios son moderados. Tiene una terraza muy linda con una vista preciosa.
reviews.author: MagditaB

reviews.title: Mouth watering delicious
reviews.text: Steaks were fabulous. The side dishes were just as fabulous. The service was impeccable. Gorgeous evening view. Rolls, yum. Very romantic. Cute little boxes of matches at desk too. It's hard to get matches anymore. I love them.
reviews.author: travelingannie2013

reviews.title: Good steak, Good wine and Good view
reviews.text:
I've been a frequent to Jean George's restaurants in NYC. So I was expecting nothing short of great - and it did not disappoint
The steak I ordered was cooked just perfect (though, I've had better steak in NYC), the wine suggested by our server paired quite well with it as well. 
Though, the best part was the view from top.
reviews.author: amalpani

reviews.title: Scalped by the Tomahawk!
reviews.text:
I always finish off my vacation at a prime steakhouse so I was expecting big things from this place which is located in the Phoenician hotel.  The grounds are impressive as well as the 180 degree view from the restaurant deck.   Within the Phoenix and Scottsdale area there were other comparable steakhouse options available but since I had never been to the Phoenician before this got the nod.

We started with a couple Belvedere dirty stuffed olive martinis and a seafood tower ($40) with two shrimp cocktails ($16/each).  Unfortunately the martinis were not dirty as requested and we only received one shrimp cocktail.  The waiter asked if they drinks should be returned and shaken or if bringing the olive juice over was OK.  I opted for the olive juice and didn’t ask for the second shrimp cocktail.  Other starters included a Caesar salad ($11) and onion soup ($11).  While both were a bit pricey for the quantity to me the soup was more overpriced.  There were five shrimp on the serving and were as good as I have had anywhere.  What was off the mark was the cocktail sauce.  The tower was very good but not great.

For entrées it was steak all around.  We ordered two filet Mignons ($45 each / 12 oz.), a 20oz. rib eye ($59) and the Tomahawk which comes with a 32 oz. hunk of prime rib hanging off an extended bone (note it is not on the menu).  I have had these before so I was looking forward to the experience.  Note that the filet Mignon with a bone costs about $14 more per piece which is a premium price to pay for maybe some additional flavor.  All steaks were cooked to order and were of high quality.  Sides come separate so we ordered two for the tables.  The Tomahawk steak comes on a cart to your table and is hand cut by the wait staff as part of the Show.  The potatoes were very good but the spinach was prepared with dill and some other non-traditional herbs which to us was not a good combination.

We ordered a bottle of wine from their nicely appointed wine list to accompany our dinner.  We ended with coffee but no desert.  So at this point I felt we had great evening until I received the check.  I almost fell out of my chair when I saw the price for the Tomahawk steak … $120!  To me anytime you offer an off-menu item that is this expensive there should be some integrity displayed by the waiter to tell you the price even if you didn’t ask.  Because of this I would never come back again.  Total tab with tax and 18% gratuity for the four of us was $590.
reviews.author: MrOcho

reviews.title: As Snoop Dog would say "this place is the sizzle in your schnizzle".Yumm YUmm Yumm
reviews.text: The bar was fun and filld with energy. Dining on the balcony overlooking the pool and by a fire pit was incredible. Love the decor, ambiance and servers are the best!
reviews.author: Paul B

reviews.title: Dissappionting and Mixed Experience
reviews.text:
We were really excited to have dinner here, unfortunately we were dissappointed.  The food was fantastic and our waiter Lauren was very good but overall the staff is very unattentive.  It started with coming out of the elevator and being blasted by the electric piano/singer who's music is not only inappropriate for the venue given all the hard surfaces that the sound reverabrates off of but, also isn't that talented.  We made our reservation for 7:30 and arrived at 7:20 and still had to wait until 7:45 to be seated all the time being blasted by the electric piano/singer!  And then we get seated as close to the blasting music as possible. We were moved but, not any better.  Terrible ambiance!!!!  

We loved the menu selections.  We chose the Cold Seafood platter for an appetizer and it was delicious once it actually came but, getting it was interesting.   The manager finally had to go and stand over the kitchen crew shucking the oysters. Don't know what the issue was but, the manager served the platter and apologized and comped the appetizer.  Only served one lemon slice for the whole platter....asked for more and it finally came just as we devoured the last oyster....

The bone in filet's were amazing the perfectly cooked.  All sides were wonderful....creamed corn and spinach, baked potato.  Yummy!  ordered a second cocktail and it came right before desert...not great timing there....

Cherries jubillee and peach crunch for desert...Wonderful!  

The whole thing would have been fine even with the baubles if not for the irritating music!  Wouldn't go back after that one issue....would have if it were only for the service issues....
reviews.author: Away500

reviews.title: Chew On This!
reviews.text: Great view, great atmosphere, great service and a great price. The menu reminded me of Mastros steakhouse by selection and cost. The menu is ala carte with entrees running from the high $20's to upper $ 40's more or less. The view of the distant lightning storm through the picturesque windows was magical. The waitress mentioned a couple of specials including a 32 oz. bone in steak for two, which we ordered. After it arrived, the HUGE bone was removed, leaving roughly 24 ozs. of meat or about 12 ozs. each. It was very good. The shock came with the bill. I expected to spend some bucks, but $120 for a steak...well I was shocked. I really think the price should have been mentioned along with the description. It felt deceptive. I recommend J&G, just watch out and ask questions!!
reviews.author: DesertTravelGuy

reviews.title: Good food, service lacking
reviews.text:
We made a reservation at the J&G Steakhouse to celebrate my birthday. We discussed going to one not onsite at our hotel but decided for convenience in the end. My wife made a reservation and requested that we be seated outside, and if not outside at least at the window so we could enjoy the view. We arrived 10 minutes early and were told that "we seat closer to your reservation time, please get a drink in the bar." I thought it was rude to put it that way, as if I did something wrong by coming early. Then, we waited 10 minutes in the bar area and weren't greeted by the server for the area or anything. I gave up waiting and went to the bar to order our drinks, which were phenomenal by the way. I mean it. While I was waiting for the drinks to be made, the cocktail server came up to me and told me he would take care of me. Too late, you make me wait 10 minutes without even saying I'll be right with you and it's just too long. He was clearly busy and we understand that - but just say sorry for the wait I'll be with you in a few and all can be forgiven. On to the dining experience.

We were seated 35 minutes later than our reservation...so apparently they don't seat closer to reservation time as I was informed upon arrival? Confusing. Then, we were seated in the second row away from the window. Not outside and not next to the window. The server took forever to bring anything or come back after bringing something to see what else we needed. Overall, the porterhouse I had was terrific. But based on the service I experienced I doubt I'd return. I compare this experience to all the other steakhouses I've been to - Morton's, Ruth's Chris, Capital Grille - and I can't say I've had a similar experience at any of them. It was just plain frustrating and I just couldn't focus on the food or the beautiful views of Phoenix. It's too bad; the place has potential but with lackluster service like that I don't think it'll ever be in the big leagues without some serious work.
reviews.author: Doug E

reviews.title: Mediocre Food and Service to Match
reviews.text: Wow! What a let down. Four of us went to J&G during Restaurant Week as the regular prices are extremely high. What I didn't realize was that by getting a fixed price meal we would be treated as a lesser class of people. Our waiter was intrusive and unfriendly which was emphasized when he literally tossed the bill on to the table at the end of the meal. The food was hit and miss. The fish was under seasoned. The shrimp appetizer was excellent however. The steak was good. Desserts were okay. The ambiance was sort of a slightly upscale Sizzler Steakhouse. What really amazed me was they used disposable paper place mats and no tablecloths. This is the signature restaurant at one of the nicest Phoenix resorts with top dollar prices. I expected so much more. There are many other steakhouses and better restaurants in Phoenix. Skip this one.
reviews.author: AdventureandRomance

reviews.title: Great Steak
reviews.text: We had a lovely meal here in a very nice 'warm' environment. The waitstaff were really nice and enjoyed our 'Aussie' slang. We found the food to be well above expectation.
reviews.author: travellinallover

reviews.title: Fabulous food, great service
reviews.text: Food is phenomenal, whether you order a burger or a steak, price is reasonable and wonderful service.
reviews.author: Sassymae1

reviews.title: A good replacement for a grand hotel-resort
reviews.text: The original incarnation of the elegant restaurant at the Phoenician Resort was Mary Elaine's, named after the wife of the developer.  This recently renovated restaurant, managed by Jean George Vongerichten and his company, is a good and valid reincarnation.  It provides high end service, serves excellent food and is highly priced.  It has a wonderful ambiance and an even better view through the ceiling to floor windows, as well as the outdoor seating, which is fine if the outside temperature is acceptable.
reviews.author: Jack F

reviews.title: Great food and service
reviews.text: We regularly dine at this restaurant whilst staying at The Royal Palms Resort and Spa which is just 5 minutes away.  The food is consistently good as is the service, I tried the Arizona Restaurant Week menu which was very good, my dining partner dined a la carte, which they described as excellent.  Although a little pricey it is worth the extra for the views and quality of the dining experience.
reviews.author: AUKTourist

reviews.title: First class dining
reviews.text: We happened to be there during Restaurant Week and got a wonderful 3 course dinner for $40.  It was just great.  The room is lovely and service terrific.
reviews.author: Townhaven

reviews.title: Restaurant Views and Food are Superb
reviews.text:
Rather than driving to a restaurant, we chose to eat in the hotel after a fun day at the pool  It's all about view here.  It has a lovely expansive view of city lights. We came during the daylight hours and left at dark, so we were able to enjoy both types of views.
The waiter was kind and attentive. The food was excellent. Try the Asparagus Risotto! and The banana cream pie dessert was yummy!  We would definitely go back, all aspects are a ten!
reviews.author: Beverly T

reviews.title: Better than expected, great food and transcendent atmosphere.
reviews.text:
We sat outside near one of the braziers, after having arrived early for a cocktail or two. As the restaurant was not yet crowded, we enjoyed the drinks and the view for a while before ordering. It really is a beautiful view at sunset, and the gas flames nearby were great both for atmosphere and to chase away the chill as evening set in. The wait staff was accommodating, attentive, and excellent all around. We shared the tuna tartare appetizer, which I recommend. They split it for us and I initially thought they'd brought us two orders!

For dinner, I had a bone-in buffalo ribeye, which was a special of the evening, and my wife had the hangar steak. The ribeye was expensive ($65) but ranks among the best steaks I have ever eaten. There was little left on the plate save for the bone, which I may or may not have gnawed on a bit. The sear was perfect while the center was a very pleasant medium rare. The hangar steak was also very good, not overcooked at all and obviously a fine piece of beef.

The cocktails were excellent, too, and they have an extensive wine list. 

Overall probably our best meal in Scottsdale, though also our most expensive. Still, the beautiful location, great food, and impeccable service all make this steakhouse an excellent value by my estimation.

Although we stay on property often we would make the trip to this restaurant even if we were not on property. reviews.text: Wonderful food and a stunning view.  When you make reservations, ask to be seated outside.  Well worth the money.

My husband had the marbled one with the bone which was very good.  I liked the mushrooms and the Brussels sprouts.  The view is nice.  Tiramisu was different and fine.  We enjoyed our evening.

reviews.title: Outstanding Vistas and Dinner
reviews.text:
We made reservations at the J and G because it was listed to have a beautiful view and it did!!  It also had delicious food! The Phoenician Resort is a true Five Star experience. Everyone was so gracious and helpful!! Now to the food.  We had the chef's tasting dinner and each course was delicious! My favorite was the Sea Bass and of course the molten chocolate cake with ice cream. The service was very good and very personable, not pretentious. 
We will definitely dine here on our next trip to Scotsdale!!
reviews.author: Christie K

reviews.title: Outstanding !!!
reviews.text:
Sue and I went for dinner this week while in Scottsdale and it was Outstanding!!!

We first split the "Parmesan Risotto with Fall Mushrooms and Herbs"...delectable! Then Sue had the "Parmesan Crusted Chicken with Basil-Lemon Butter White Asparagus"...the chicken was superb, but the asparagus was a bit overdone. We then shared the "Warm Chocolate Cake" but substituted the caramel ice cream with the blood orange sorbet...YUMMY!

Sue has a new favourite cocktail... Orange Elderflower Cosmo...WOW!!! She had two!!! A close second to the Lemongrass Splash at the Viceroy in Santa Monica...!

Highly recommend...sit on the deck and take in the view...Amazing!!!
reviews.author: FLY_GUY62

reviews.title: Buffalo beats beef... really
reviews.text: Would have never thought about ordering buffalo, but we did and it was really delicious. Skip the asparagus, too tough and tasteless, spend the calories on the scalloped potatoes though! Dining on the balcony made for a perfect evening!

reviews.title: Steak of Steak
reviews.text:
Excellent steak with a flare - and sides like  brussell sprouts, macaroni and cheese and broccoli.  Each is amazingly unique.
Be sure to sit outside or near the windows.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.title: Second time was a great as the first
reviews.text: Back to the desert and we spent our first night, which happened to be on valentines, at J&G's.  we dinned again outside on amazingly had the same waiter, which remembered us being from Idaho!  I had the outstanding 10 oz NY Strip with sides of asparagus and mac/cheese.  My husband had the lamb chops, which were big, juicy and just perfect.  My steak was out of this world.  We finished it off with the apple cobbler desert.  J&G's hit another home run with us and will always be on our list to dine at when in Scottsdale!
reviews.author: Piper0127

reviews.title: Hit & Miss
reviews.text:
J&G Steakhouse is an upscale modern take on the classic steakhouse. Stone Rose Lounge meets Morton's if you will. The dining room features stadium style terraced seating incorporating tables and rich leather lined booths. The main feature is the panoramic view of The Valley of the Sun.

+ Floor to ceiling windows offer a stunning view
+ Nice selection of wine
+ Complimentary valet parking

- Inconsistent quality of preparations coming from the kitchen (sent a steak back 3 times and in the end did not eat it at all - details below)
- Odd details like paper placemats and faux butcher block tables
- Side dishes are an afterthought at best

The question one must ask about J&G Steakhouse is, without the view is the cuisine good enough to come back? Sadly, the answer is no. Scottsdale offers many choices that offer superior food and service.

Details from our recent dining experience.

This was our second time dining at J&G Steakhouse. I hate to give J & G Steakhouse a bad review but we gave them several chances to fix the mistakes with our order and they simply failed.

Arrived on-time for reservation. Hostess A and Hostess B audibly argue over where to seat us. Had requested "Romantic seating in a cozy booth". Hostess B tells us they are fully booked and instructs Hostess A to seat us in the "Sunset Room". We follow the hostess through the main dining room. The ambience is warm and inviting with mood lighting, candles, and flickering fireplaces on the patio. We are lead into the Sunset Room which is devoid of the warmth and charm found in the main dining room. The sunset room is obviously set-up for conferences & private dining and was being used for overflow. Despite 30% of the tables in the main dining room being empty we are sat at what I would consider the worst seat in the house. As far away from the scenic view as possible, against the back wall, and next to a pair of doors the staff uses to bring food back and forth. Hostess A makes a meekly apologetic comment and tries to paint a rosy picture with a, "the view is pretty good from here too" comment. Five minutes later another couple is sat to our right and they are fairly upset with the seating in the Sunset Room as well. In retrospect we could have eaten at the bar and enjoyed more ambiance and a better view than was available from the back of the Sunset Room.

Seeing as how they claimed to be fully booked we decided to order a bottle of wine, relax and enjoy the food. The table to our right is swarmed with service. Water, bread, and amuse bouche all arrive within minutes. The sommelier brings their wine selection and yet we are still waiting for so much as a hello or menu. Our table in the corner must make us invisible to the wait staff. Finally our waiter arrives. He was perfectly professional and very nice all evening but must have been assigned too many tables as there is too much time between visits and he misses the mistakes made by the kitchen. By the time our wine is served the table to our right is finished with their first course. We were in no rush but the time from being seated to be offered water and other drinks seemed extraordinarily long.

On to the food. 
Starters
- Amuse bouche: We were offered none
- Calamari: Nothing special. Skip it.
- Pork Belly: Very tasty. Best bites of the evening. Highly recommended.
Sides
- French Fries: Good but not a stand out. Capital Grill does it better.
- Cheese bites: Best description is inconsistent. There are a handful in the basket and some are light tan and barely cooked while others are a dark brown nearly burnt. The flavor varies wildly between them. Impossible to distinguish what the chef's original intention was with this dish.
Entrees
- Pepper Steak: Cooked to a perfect medium. Nicely seasoned and juicy. Not the best steak I have ever enjoyed but perfectly acceptable. If everything had been at least as good as this steak I could recommend J&G Steakhouse.
- Filet: Ordered medium, arrived well done. The steak was completely gray throughout, not a trace of pink. With our waiter no where to be found I waved down a food runner and sent the steak back. A manager appears to apologize. 10-15 minutes later the new steak arrives, my wife cuts into it and it is raw, not rare, raw. It goes back to the kitchen again. 10 minutes later the steak arrives back again this time hot and charred on the outside and raw-to-rare on the inside. At this point I give half of my pepper steak to my wife. It is no longer piping hot but it is cooked to a perfect medium and she is starving. When the manager appears again we explain that after several failed attempts from the kitchen to produce a medium filet we give up and are splitting my entree.
- Dessert: Chocolate lava cake as good as any in town and better than some. The ice cream served alongside the cake was indistinguishable from store bought. 
- Dessert wine: When they did not have the ice wine my wife prefers the sommelier was able to offer a suggestion she found quite a nice pairing with the chocolate cake.

Overall: One diner received a perfectly cook medium steak while the other diner (who ordered their steak cooked the same way) never received an edible steak. How is this possible from a restaurant with Steakhouse in their name? Between the inconsistent food we received (steak, cheese bites, calamari, ice cream), the lack of ambience in the Sunset Room, and other elements of the evening that seemed less than stellar I can not recommend J&G Steakhouse.

I do want to be clear that after all the trouble we experienced the management went above and beyond when it came to the check at the end of the evening. We were charged for the wine we consumed (about 75% of our total bill) and nothing more. While I would have been happy to pay for everything but the filet I do appreciate their generous gesture. I think management knew the kitchen had failed and wanted to make it right. I sincerely appreciate this gesture and only wish it had not had been necessary. Everyone would have been happier if the kitchen had been able to produce what had actually been ordered.

reviews.title: Terrific food and service
reviews.text: The steaks are some of the best we have had anywhere. Nice wine list but very expensive. It is a very pretty restaurant.

reviews.text: i have to agree with  bear003.  Beautiful view, excellent service, strange paper placemats and ok food.  The steaks were good (we had the filets medium rare) but not great as I would have expected.  The wedge salad was typical.  The heirloom tomato salad excellent!  We had mushrooms as a side and they were just ok.  We tried the southwest coffee for dessert and it was the best part of the meal!  All in all our experience was just ok .
reviews.author: Lora T

reviews.title: Refined and Gorgeous Restaurant.
reviews.text:
We hosted a Company Holiday Dinner Party at J&G in December.  What a beautiful space!  Perfect for couples and small to medium groups.  Not usually partial to restaurants known for their "beauty factor" and caters to tourists (since it's located inside the Phoenician Resort) but this restaurant pairs food that rivals some of the best the Phoenix Valley has to offer with stunning views from
every table.  I can't say enough about the group catering staff.  Very professional, friendly and informative as we planned the menu.  Our service staff was well trained and efficient without being stuffy or overly bubbly.  Food presentation was gorgeous and timing of each course was done with perfection for a large group.  My only suggestion was the seating arrangement for a group of 10.  They placed us at a long table (one side was a long booth facing the view windows) with the other side facing a back wall, and very difficult to have conversations.  They also split the long table into two tables to enable the "booth side" to get in and out.  A bit awkward.  Menu was delicious and prepared well.  Excellent wine list.  I would return for another business meal without hesitation!

reviews.title: Excellent Steaks, gracious dining
reviews.text: The food here, like all of the Jean Georges restaurants, is superb. The wait staff is knowledgeable, attentive and genuine love the food they are serving
reviews.author: Santa_Fe_Jeffrey

reviews.title: Prepare to enjoy
reviews.text: While I have stayed at the hotel many times, this is the first time at the restaurant.  I invited a local relative to join us as opposed to going somewhere else.  I was told it was good - they were right!  The rib eye bone-in steak was wonderful.  I have had lesser quality and paid more for it.  The view of the valley is great and makes the total package worthwhile.  Like others on this review page have indicated, the paper placemat was a question mark.  But, they took the dinner one away and gave a clean one for desert.  I guess that's for the clean factor.  For a good meal with atmosphere and NO RUSH, this met my expectation.
reviews.author: Skip M

reviews.title: Beautiful views, not worth the price!
reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant - great views from the large windows. I agree with the contributor who spoke about the paper placemats - I, too, was surprised at that! Pricey; very good service. Steaks were good; sides were OK (plain baked potato which we had to dress ourselves!). Excellent carrot cake for dessert with great icing!

reviews.title: Amazing dinner great service beautiful view

reviews.title: Flawless
reviews.text:
In it's heyday this was the most beautiful elegant Dining experience in town-a tribute to the lovely then wife of the genius egomaniac Charlie Keating. Gone are the pre purse-hook days of furniture especially for your coveted handbag. Fortunately the pleasure of Dining here has not faded away-not one bit. The Restaurant still echoes the many many happy occasions celebrated in the past and looks forward with a snazzy old school Playboy Club vibe, excellent service and amazing food.
Steaks are the focus but don't let that distract you from probably the freshest Oysters in the state, Lobster, a marvelous Bar Burger (great drink program in the Bar too), Dessert, House Sauces, Fries (yes worth mentioning) or anything that flys out of the Kitchen. Service is attentive but not intrusive. Fabulous fabulous tree top views overlooking lush green formerly Citrus tree filled Arcadia.
Depending on the time of year you might see sexy date night dressy attire or track suits and post Golf attire. Thankfully either or any in between work here and it's just a great Dining experience.

The decor of the restaurant was modern and nicely appointed and our table had excellent views of the valley.

The menu had many excellent offerings and we chose the bone-in filet as this is a steakhouse.  The children were able to order off a special menu and their meals were delivered promptly.  The filets were done to perfection and the sides were served family style and delicious.  The wine list was amazingly large with so many selections to choose from.  Service was excellent.

The steaks were small and bland.  I thought for all the awards they received it would have been much, much better.  My small filet was supposed to be 8oz.  No way. Plus the views from the restaurant's balcony are amazing.  I would go again in the cooler months and sit outside with a drink before or after dinner just to enjoy that setting.

As to the food, we thought it was very nicely done and the service was top notch.  The wine list was very extensive which we liked.  The only thing that surprised me was that the place was not busy at all on a Friday night at 8 pm.  It is a lovely place so you would think it would draw more of a crowd.  Oh well, their loss!

This will definitely be a stop for us again!

Outstanding food and service
Excellent hotel And view

Desserts were excellent as entree
