reviews.title: "J"oyous & "G"ratifying Special Dinner at J & G!
reviews.text:
I've been a huge fan of Jean Georges for years beginning with Prime at Bellagio, followed by Market in Paris. In Las Vegas, we used to go at least once each trip we made there. With so many new restaurants popping up in Sin City, we've chosen to try others, but after our dinner at J & G Steakhouse at the Phoenician, I think next time we go back to LV, we'll have to make a reservation at Prime. The menus are very similar, in JG's typical French-Asian inspired steakhouse. 

First of all, the restaurant space is just gorgeous . . . and its location atop the Phoenician is a perfect setting for twinkling city views. Patio dining in the premium months alone would make it worth the price of admission. I particularly love the semicircle booths that ring the main dining room. We opted for seats by the window, and really enjoyed the "corner" like booth we shared. It was our 22nd wedding anniversary, which I let them know by reservation through "Open Table", and we were greeted warmly by the hostess acknowledging our celebration, as did our waiter, the restaurant manager, and just about everyone who served us at our table. It was lovely.  Our server Brian was delightful . . . very unassuming, friendly and informative. He was very helpful in offering suggestions, highlighting favorites, and not overselling, which I find to be a real drag at many other finer dining establishments. The one thing I found incongruous in the entire setting was the "butcher paper" place mats. They just seemed so out of place for this elegant establishment.

To start, my hubby ordered a half-bottle of Mount Veeder Cabernet. Neither of us are big drinkers, and the fact that J & G had a pretty extensive list of half-bottles was a real treat! It was full bodied and delicious, and just a perfect amount to see us through our dinner.  

My husband ordered a sampling of the days selection of oysters on the half-shell.  All were perfectly shucked, but the Blue Points were supremely meaty with a little salty finish. For starters my husband ordered the wildly popular Tuna Tartare. The tuna was so light and fresh and melded well with the bed of avocado and ginger marinade. I opted for the Butternut Squash soup, a favorite of mine at Prime as well. It was just how I remembered. The oyster mushrooms come in the bottom of the bowl, and the attendant then pours the soup over it . . . it is so creamy, a little sweet, a little savory. I would have licked the bowl had I not been in a public room. Yum!

Hubby splurged and chose the 16 ounce Six Peppercorn Prime NY Steak. He was on Cloud Nine. I totally forbid eating red meat at home, so when we dine out, I don't make a fuss if that's what he chooses. The steak came perfectly medium rare and it was accompanied by four sauces from which he could choose.  In order of preference, Béarnaise, Smoked Chili Glaze, J & G Steak Sauce and Black Pepper Condiment. I ordered the Chilean Sea Bass with Honshimeji Mushrooms in a Miso Yuzu Broth. It was to me an unusual preparation for Chilean Seabass, but was simply refreshing and clean with a bit of a citrus finish. Honestly, I could only finish half as I was so stuffed from the starters. In addition, we ordered two sides, the Caramelized Brussels Sprouts with Balsamic Vinegar and Pecans and the Potato Gratin with Comte. Both were great for sharing. The potato gratin was so rich, between the both of us, we could only eat half the order. Needless to say, we brought a little of everything home with us in a "doggie bag" and had it for lunch . . . and it was just as delicious warmed in the microwave now that the flavors had time to sit.

If you can believe, we saved room for dessert! For our anniversary we were treated to a free Raspberry and Rose Pavlova with crisp Meringue and raspberry sorbet. We also ordered the Warm Chocolate Cake with caramel ice cream. Hubby loved the Pavlova the best and pretty much consumed it all before I could even get a good taste. He was on a major sugar high. I had a couple of bites of the warm chocolate cake and was blown away by the texture of the cake with its warm bittersweet chocolate center. I was in chocolate heaven. The caramel ice cream was a perfect pairing. Some of the best ice cream I have tasted in eons.

As we left, we were both in our "tummy full, nap now" mode . . . very sated with the atmosphere, service and cuisine!
reviews.author: msblueyz

reviews.title: Great experience during Arizona Restaurant Week
reviews.text:
Had not dined at this restaurant since it was Mary Elaine's in the 80's. $40 3-course meal during Arizona Restaurant Week was too tempting to pass up.  The decor has been totally revamped and modernized to a sleek, contemporary look with glass and dark wood accents.  The valley views through the floor to ceiling windows have always been spectacular and there is an outdoor patio to enjoy when cooler temperatures prevail.  
The restaurant was also featuring certain bottles of wine for half price so we ordered a cabernet to compliment our filets.  The only downside of the entire meal was the ordinary, run-of-the-mill white flour dinner rolls served with our wine.  Many upscale Phoenix area restaurants present a very creative and healthier variety of breadsticks, lavosh, muffins and/or multigrain rolls.  J & G would do well to upgrade this aspect of the meal.  For the appetizer, my husband chose the warm asparagus with shitake mushroom topping and goat cheese.  I chose the warm shrimp salad on a bed of butter lettuce with an avocado slice.  They were excellent in flavor, portion size and quality of ingredients.  We both had the petite filet which, unlike Flemings and Cartwrights, was served without a salty coating that detracts from the flavor of the meat itself.  The portion size was perfect and each was cooked properly.  For dessert we enjoyed the warm chocolate cake with caramel ice cream.  The cake was a small version of a molten lava cake yet not too cloyingly sweet.  The caramel ice cream lacked a depth of flavor and was more like an ice milk in consistency.  The entire meal was nicely paced and we never felt rushed. The noise level increased as the evening progressed but the table spacing is such that we could still talk to each other without shouting.  The only thing that bothered me was the background music which was contemporary and annoying.
reviews.author: gingerbear16

reviews.title: Stunning views, Amazing food, & Impeccable Service
reviews.text: This place is a treasure.  We actually were lured in by the invitation for Phoenix Restaurant week.  When we entered I was struck with what a pretty restaurant it was.  Very elegant and extremely well appointed.  The view will take your breath away.  I had the shrimp salad as an appetizer and my husband had the tuna tartare.  Both were extraordinary.  Both of our steaks were cooked to perfection.  And the desserts were too amazing to resist.  Since the dessert was included in the restaurant week menu, I thought I would just take a bite or two of the lemon tart.  Nope, I could not stop eating it.  If you can, try to plan your reservation to watch the sunset.  It is stunning to watch one of Arizona's gorgeous sunsets and then watch the lights of the valley come to life like fireflies.
reviews.author: MissEileen

reviews.title: The Jazz on Thursday nights is a do not miss
reviews.text:
Love, Love, Loved the Jazz.  I will defintely make sure I arrive on Thursday on my return so I don't miss it.  It was a shame they only played for happy hour.

I enjoyed my food and the service was excellent.
reviews.author: Mplsdtgirl

reviews.title: Lovely atmosphere, excellent service, good food
reviews.text: Our family dined at J & G last Saturday night.  The service was top notch.  The wine list was respectable and had some nice affordable options. We had a few appetizers, the best was the calamari.  The house was out of their signature corn raviolis appetizer which was a disappointment. Being a steakhouse, the majority of our guests chose steaks of some sort, but two selected seafood.  It is obvious that steaks are the strong suit at J & G.  My husband ordered the lobster, it arrived moderately warm and had a very odd, chemical flavor.  The preparation was Asian style with peas and frankly tasted quite odd.  On the positive side, the steaks were all top notch and well prepared.  They offer a variety of steak sauces to choose from including old stand bys, but also some interesting options like an Asian chili glaze which was fabulous.  The desserts we chose were the chocolate lava cake and the carrot cake--both were  amazing!
reviews.author: RMG66

reviews.title: Very good steaks and nice atmosphere
reviews.text: The meat quality was good, but not wet aged only steaks - I feel dry aged is much better. Service was good and the wine list was also sufficient.
reviews.author: mdbasile

reviews.title: Our Favorite Restaurant
reviews.text: We go quite often as we take everyone who visits and for birthdays and anniversaries.The location is very impressive and we have had the best of meals with no complaints from anyone.The sevice is excellent and the price is what you would expect for the location.With all the people we have taken we have also tried all the desserts- so we tasted and liked them all. Can't wait to go again!
reviews.author: Louvain71

reviews.title: Great Food
reviews.text: Excellent food !  and great professional service.  The creativity and quality of the dishes was good. Excellent steaks and good starters. Loved the cold corn soup !
reviews.author: Samer A

reviews.title: Mediocre at best
reviews.text: My wife and I celebrated our anniversary at J&Gs.  After reading the numerous outstanding reviews, we were expecting an outstanding meal.  The waiter recommended the tuna tartare and fillets.  We both opted for the taster menu, which included the recommended plates.  The tuna tartare was inedible, literally.  The curry/ginger flavor overwhelmed the dish. The corn raviolis and hallibut were both fine, just not memorable - we wouldn't order then again.  The filet was terrible!  Absolutely no taste, cold, and just bland.  The accompanying steak sauce was unnedible.  The saving grace to this dish were the French fries, which were warily similar to those served at Burger King.  Dessert was again adequate, just not amazing.  Overall, we dealt the food was "foo foo" for "foo foo" sake, but not enjoyable.  The views were nice, but not worth the cost and poor food.  Skip this restaurant.
reviews.author: heatherLA

reviews.title: Views and Food will blow you away!
reviews.text:
Upon entering the restaurant, you look thru the panoramic windows where the resort and Arizona's mountains and beauty all come together.  

Full service menu will offer all diners an array of choices! So, for a relaxing enviroment, with great service and food, make it a point to stop at J&G Steakhouse.
reviews.author: Michelle-OdysseyTrvl

reviews.title: Great food and sunset.
reviews.text: Great view and food. Pricey but worth the sunset. Ask for drink specials as they will likely do half off wine bottles. Outside tables were quiet and had a great view.
reviews.author: merwest

reviews.title: Jean Georges at his best
reviews.text: The steakhouse is on the fifth floor with good views of the grounds. The food is excellent and is matched by equally good service. As always this comes at a cost.
reviews.author: AUKTourist

reviews.title: Tasting Menu
reviews.text: Order the tasting menu with the wine supplement. It is delicious, the portions are the perfect size and the waiter seemed to know what he was talking about when it came to the wine recommendations.
reviews.author: cynbyn

reviews.title: Great view...great meal
reviews.text: We went for cocktails but the view and atmosphere were so nice, we stayed for dinner.  We had an outstanding 3 course special during restaurant week.  The food, especially the beef, was excellent and so was the service.
reviews.author: KauaiLover

reviews.title: Great view
reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant, great view, elegant, but the steak and service was average.
reviews.author: Lynn M

reviews.title: FANTASTIC FOOD, over attentive service
reviews.text: We ate here twice during a recent vacation at the Phoenician, the first time taking the taster menu with wine recommendations, the second taking a steak.  Both meals were superb and highly recommended.  The taster menu comprised of five fabulous courses including wonderful fish and of course steak. All cooked to perfection.  The second dinner was a delicious fillet, which we took with some great sides.  Coming from the UK we can't easily get Yukon Gold potatoes so when we visit the States we eat them as often as we can.  The Yukon mash was ambrosial!  Again a great dinner.  The only negative comment I have is that the three Head Waiters and our server insisted on asking us if everything was ok, so there was a constant stream of interruptions to eating the wonderful food.  We will definately return!
reviews.author: Rob G

reviews.title: Nice view
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our dinner here, the salmon was delicious.  My only complaint is that the chef had very few gluten-free options.  They do customize for those who are gluten free, however, still limited overall.
reviews.author: K Pastore

reviews.title: surprisingly underwhelming
reviews.text: We were prepared for the very best and found only an adequate meal for the price. Location is spectacular, service was very attentive and helpful. Prices are high and not worth the llackluster quality. Wine list was adequate.
reviews.author: didr

reviews.title: A special evening
reviews.text: We were on vacation with two grown daughters but took the evening off for a "date night". Still special after 50 years of marriage. Had reservations at 6 PM which was quite nice and before they got really busy. Service was excellent. Scenery set a wonderful mood for the evening.  The steaks were pricey and cooked to perfection. We shared a salad, appetizer, two veggies and a dessert. All serving sizes were plenty for the two of us. You really should try the steamed shrimp salad with avocado and mushroom/champagne vinaigrette, the crab cake over sugar snap peas remoulade, the potatoes gratin and the carrot cake. The perfect end to a wonderful vacation at the Canyon Suites.
reviews.author: Gram41

reviews.title: CENA ROMANTICA AL TRAMONTO
reviews.text: Se Vi trovate a Phoenix, non lasciatevi sfuggire la possibilità di una suggestiva cena con vista panoramica in questo eccellente ristorante situato all'interno di un maestoso hotel (The Phoenician). Ristorante elegante e raffinato, ottimo servizio, ricca carta dei vini (assaggiate il rosato dell'Arizona); sinceramente credo di non aver mai assaggiato carne così tenera e saporita in vita mia.
reviews.author: carolina973

reviews.title: excellent
reviews.text: The food, service and view were excellent!  We will definitely make a return trip.
reviews.author: kandjphx

reviews.title: You cannot beat THE VIEWS!!!
reviews.text: Great food, UNBELIEVABLE VIEWS! Wonderful fire pits up high overlooking the Valley of The Sun.
reviews.author: Ralph D

reviews.title: $$$$$ but good
reviews.text: My kids love this restaurant and begged to return from our last visit.  It is absolutely beautiful inside and out, with terraces that view the city.  But it is very pricey for a family, and the portions are small.
reviews.author: lamagid

reviews.title: Great Food and Views
reviews.text: The steak and seafood here was great.  Went there two nice.  Nice wine selection, everything prepared perfectly.
reviews.author: AHSteinberg

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Phoenician last Thursday night and ate here. Excellent in every single way. Service, food, atmosphere all a 10+.

Highly recommend.
reviews.author: intrepidtravelerfla

reviews.title: Good for a $25 meal, not a $100 meal.
reviews.text: I went with a group of 8 friends for a late reservation on a Saturday.  Prices were a bit high and entrees include no sides or salad. Those are all extra. 6 pieces of asparagus or a bowl of plain French fries for $9 seemed excessive to me. Most steaks we're between $40 and $60. We were actually told that they did not have an appetizer that fed more than two people, which was disappointing as we're we're all very hungry. I chose an $11 Caesar to start and split some roasted mushrooms and asparagus for $9 each. Skip those sides. Asparagus was bland and blah. Mushrooms were cold, but I'm not the complaining type. I ordered a 16 oz peppercorn ny prime steak for $49, cooked to medium rare. To their credit, my steak was perfect. 3 of the 5 medium rare steaks ordered at our table were cooked to a perfect medium rare. However, 2 of the steaks which were ordered medium rare came out with cold, raw centers. They were politely sent back. One came back medium and the other was still raw in the center. After debate, we decided to address the issue with our waiter. He was very understanding and polite and the manager had an entire new fillet cooked for the gentleman. Unfortunately, it came out even more undercooked than the previous. At this point, the manager could do nothing but apologize and offer the entire table free dessert and drinks a a comped meal, although he left hungry ad was later satisfied with a $15 joes pizza. We didn't let this ruin our visit, but it did sour the "steak experience" quite abit. Total bill was around 1200 for two large bottles of wine and standard 2 course meal for 8 guys. 2 raw steaks and dessert was comped. Not worth the money in my opinion, but kudos to the management for doing their best to rectify the situation.
reviews.author: Mike7244

reviews.title: Great food!
reviews.text: Loved the whole menu! Would recommend to others if it weren't in this damn awful hotel!
reviews.author: Champagnejen

reviews.title: Too much money for the stuff we ingested.
reviews.text:
We thought being at the Phonecian Resort, it would be 5*'s all the way.  I had to go ask another waiter if there was a waiter for us out on the patio because we waited at least 15 minutes before I went inside & told someone we were there.  There was only 1 other couple outside.  I ordered the pork belly bites (something like that) & they weren't that amazing.  The flavor of it reminded me of pork butt roast I've made in the crockpot at home.  My husband & I both ordered the Six Peppercorn Prime NY Steak medium well.  I thought it was perfect but my hubby wasn't as impressed. The waiter let us try all sauces for our steaks & everyone of them were disgusting.  I guess I don't have a refined pallete because my taste buds could not handle the foulness of it all.  As for sides, we had the Black Truffle Cheese Fritters which were more like fried cheese balls to me and Potato Gratin with Compte which tasted like regular ol' scalloped potatoes in a cast iron mini skillet to make it look all fancy.  The rolls were rock hard. I seriously think they were sitting out since morning because even the butter didn't soften them up.  ugh! Lemme give you a tip Jaques...Rhodes Frozen Yeast Rolls.  You can't go wrong there.  For dessert my husband ordered the carrot cake with a side of cinnamon ice cream (super cinnamony & yummy) The carrot cake didn't even taste like it.  It was smothered in some sort of vanilla custardy type  stuff with gel icing & surrounded with 2 balls of orange sorbet which tasted weird.  Not cute.  The cappucino I ordered was just average.  

The nicest thing was the firepit outside & the view.  The worst thing was some loud drunks on the lower deck laughing all haughtily about nonsense.

Wayyyyyy to expensive for the taste of this stuff.
reviews.author: Mona A

reviews.title: Fantastic view!
reviews.text: Food was very good and the view was spectacular!  I'm a vegetarian so I can't comment on the steaks, but my husband said his was very good, though not fantastic.
reviews.author: PPriceTOsborne

reviews.title: like a n y steak house
reviews.text: the food was delicious and the presentation beautiful. best carrot cake we've ever eaten watching a view of camelback mountain. prices reasonable
reviews.author: phoebeparker

reviews.title: Fabulous in every way
reviews.text: Where to start......... the view, the food or the service?  It was all superb. Don't miss sitting around the fire pit   on the terrace overlooking the city lights of Phoenix with a martini, I highly recommend it!
reviews.author: BetseeS

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: This is an expensive restaurant and the food and service wouldn't be acceptable in a mid priced establishment.  The french onion soup was mushy, the crab cakes would have been really good except that they were floating in a nasty tasting liquid which made the bottom third of them soggy.  The steak was burnt to a cinder.  All 4 of us found our meals inedible.  The service could best be described as lackluster.  We actually had to walk over to our server twice to get refills on wine and iced tea.  Nice ambiance and great views but too many other good restaurants to go back to this one.
reviews.author: Mike R

reviews.title: Gorgeous atmosphere & excellent food!
reviews.text:
The candlelight & fire on the expansive patio outside the J & G Steakhouse on the 5th floor at the Pheonecian set the mood for a tremendously enjoyable evening. Having a private room & large party, we found the courses to arrive a little slow. But, this minor hiccup did not change the fabulous food, accommodating staff, & near perfect atmosphere.

There was a constant buzz both indoors & outdoors at the resort. The patio outside the restaurant overlooks the expansively beautiful landscaping and pools. I highly recommend the restaurant for both a date night and your next destination dinner!
reviews.author: Kendrabuck

reviews.title: Incredible food and view!
reviews.text: Had dinner with friends at a table overlooking the city.  Wow!  Loved the food(
reviews.author: Justin S

reviews.title: Deliscious
reviews.text: Tasting menu is lovely, great flavors, filet mignon melts in your mouth.  Most amazing desert ever - Passion Fruit Pavlova.  Very slow dining, as with the Il Terrazo but worth the wait!
reviews.author: Nicky

reviews.title: OMG - Amazing
reviews.text:
One of the best meal experiences in Scottsdale - Every aspect of the dining experience was over the top.  Pricey but worth every penny!
The view, service, food quality and preparation, ambiance and the decor was what once would expect at a rerstaurant of this caliber.  $$$$ - I would return tommorrow
reviews.author: J-and-B-007

reviews.title: Fine Dining in the Desert
reviews.text: The J&G Steakhouse felt different than any restaurant we have experienced in Scottsdale.  It felt more like a big city dining experience, with its location in a very upscale hotel and its formal staff.  The food and service were excellent.  Our server was very knowledgable about preparations and very willing to make suggestions. Some of the entrees were very unique and all proved to be delicious.  The view of the lights of the city was really beautiful. Because we are from a big city and have access to this type of restaurant where we live, I would hesitate to eat here again while on vacation.  Instead, I enjoyed the restaurants with a more unique local feel and menu. If you are looking for a special and expensive dining experience such as those you might find in Chicago, New York, or Las Vegas, then this might be the place for you.
reviews.author: happywanderer351

reviews.title: Great spot
reviews.text: This is a great restaurant, especially being in a Scottsdale hotel, since most of the restaurants in the hotels here are average.  The view is spectacular and their Thursday evening happy hour is the best in town, with a great bar menu at half price and fancy cocktails reasonably priced.  The dinner is expensive, but if you plan on spending alot anyway, you cannot go wrong with this one.
reviews.author: AZFoodWorshipper

reviews.title: Horrible service mediocre food!
reviews.text: Skip this one!  I went there and had a reservation and was a little early.  I told them to get me when it was ready and went to the bar and had a drink and appetizer.  They never came.  I was VERY disgusted!  The food was not very good it was like going to the typical chain restaurant.  The thing that irritated me was I spoke with the manager and explained that night what happened and how upset I was and he could have cared less.  TRUST ME and PASS!
reviews.author: Geekontherun

reviews.title: Best staeaks and the best view of the Valley of the sun also.
reviews.text: This place for a drink and watching the sun set over the valley. The food is exceptional with service to match it. The steaks are superb no matter which type you order it is cooked to your taste. It is a little bit expensive but worth the extra dollar or two.
reviews.author: PETER M

reviews.title: View and Food were special.
reviews.text: A fantastic view, fine dining and great service. The desserts were divine. The lightest cheesecake ever...like a mousse.
reviews.author: SR-1007

reviews.title: Top-Shelf Steakhouse!
reviews.text: The setting is breathtaking, dining with a view overlooking the twinkling lights of Scottsdale and Phoenix and a veranda that has gas fire pits to sit outside and enjoy the moonrise - and on top of all the wonderfulness of the place, the service is amazing & the food is delicious!
reviews.author: Aunt M

reviews.title: You get what you pay for here
reviews.text: Having eaten burgers almost every afternoon for lunch, both times we ate dinner here, I had the salmon.  It was wonderful.  The soups are lovely as well.  Service is impeccable.  Ambience is warm and relaxing.  Be sure to make a reservation, but if you don't, don't hesitate to take a table in the bar area - service is great there too and the people watching is fun.
reviews.author: pemard

reviews.title: What a gem
reviews.text: We are from Kansas City and we know steakhouses.  This truly is a great steakhouse!
reviews.author: Matt F

reviews.title: Pricey, but amazing.
reviews.text: I sure am glad that dad payed for this one. I had a $60 piece of fish that knocked my socks off it was so good, but I would never have ordered it had I been paying the bill. Sorry dad, but thanks.
reviews.author: Ryan G

reviews.title: Loved this place
reviews.text:
Great food, amazing service.  Our server, Jason, was just awesome.  He never acted rushed and talked with us as long as we liked.  The maitre d was also just awesome, and after talking my husband discovered that they're both bostonians.  
Would HIGHLY recommend J &G.  The filet was wonderful and the sides were great!
reviews.author: letitsnow1

reviews.title: Great atmosphere!
reviews.text: Went with a group of girlfriends for Restaurant Week! Excellent value..$30 included an appetizer, main meal and dessert! Had the salmon and it melted in my mouth! Unfortunately, there was no happy hour in the adjacent bar prior.
reviews.author: aztravelgrl

reviews.title: top total dinner
reviews.text: Start with a wonderful seat on the outdoor patio overlooking the entire south valley. The choices and wine were great but the service was even better. Romantic plus and a walk around the Phoenician resort was relaxing
reviews.author: stan k

reviews.title: Worth the trip
reviews.text: This was one of our favorite places....if you have a chance to see it in the daylight up against camelback Mountain...beautiful.  We went for drinks on a Thursday in the lounge and they had a jazz band which was great.  Then we had dinner ....the view was fab but wished we asked to sit out on patio with fire pit...   I had a mushroom risotto for an app and husband had the calamari.  Both were excellent!!!  Then for a meal I had a cheeseburger and Husband had the salmon.  Again...soooo delicious!!!!  Service was also very good!!!  Prices were on the high side but for a special night it was worth the trip!!!!  Would def go back!!!
reviews.author: wpunch

reviews.title: Exceptional service
reviews.text: The food quality was very high. The early dining fixed price menu was creative. It was, however, the service which blew me away. Attentive, informative and friendly, but not overwhelming. The views are lovely.
reviews.author: CanadaFamily

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The food was amazing!  Wished we had gone earlier on our trip.
reviews.author: fasiVirginia

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text:
Top shelf steak, but menu is a little limited.

Very nice place and solid service.

Would/will return.
reviews.author: bobk1717

reviews.title: Great Restaurant
reviews.text:
This restaurant is the best!  I asked for a window seat.  Even though they
were booked  we waited for a short time and they seated us as requested.  The view is unbeatable. This restaurant isn't owned by The Phoenician Resort. Even though I didn't like the Phoenician this restaurant is a gem by itself. Great food, Great Service, and beautiful view.  Frank
reviews.author: Frank C

reviews.title: A Hip Modern Restaurant tucked into a Desert Hotel
reviews.text: J&G steakhouse is on the top floor of the Phoenician hotel.  Its dark, modern design are a stark contrast to the muted desert tones found in the rest of the hotel.  The food was wonderful.  I had the five course tasting menu, which was a steal at $58.  The whole experience was welcoming and friendly.  This is the type of place you can dress up.  Many ladies were very nicely dressed, especially on a Friday or Saturday night.  This restaurant is becoming very popular with locals as the neighborhoods surrounding the hotel cater to a well-off crown.  We would definitely recommend this restaurant.
reviews.author: chammill

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The service was great!  The peppercorn steak with salt and peppered baked potato was really good
reviews.author: travelshooter71

reviews.title: Cold Steak
reviews.text: My wife ordered a medium rare steak which was cold. When we brought this to the attention of the manager we were told that was because it was medium rare !! Needed some pushing to get money off.Poor attidude and communications. Never went back there and ate at IL Terrzzo for the remainder of our 10 night stay.Food and service there top class
reviews.author: FrankP62

reviews.title: Great food, great atmosphere, wonderful views
reviews.text: We'd had drinks in the wonderfully dark and elegant bar at J&G steakhouse on a previous visit to the Phoenician but this time we ate as well and had a delicious meal.  One of us had steak, the other fish, and some excellent side dishes from a menu that is short but wide-ranging enough for most to find something they like, whether it's steak or not.  The service was outstanding, and we loved the view across the valley.  You don't even need a window table to enjoy it - in fact, some of the tables on the raised section in the centre of the restaurant have a particularly good view as you can see over the heads of the other diners.  We liked the fact the lighting was low and the decor dark; the restaurant felt elegant, romantic and atmospheric just like the bar; it would be a good choice for a special occasion meal.  Don't miss a visit to the terrace just outside the restaurant as it offers great views hotel's pools and grounds.
reviews.author: UKLizzie

reviews.title: one of the best steaks ever!
reviews.text: great views and excellent food especially the steaks.  Might be a little dark for some in the evening but try and get a table near a window.
reviews.author: Mav1244

reviews.title: One of the best restaurants in the city
reviews.text: My  wife and I have been to J & G 4 times this past year. Each time we have gone there, the food has been EXCELLENT. Not only is the food delicious and meticulously prepared and presented, but the service is also stellar. The wine list is one of the best in Phoenix/Scottsdale and the view from the dining room is so very nice. This is a top spot.
reviews.author: apfradella

reviews.title: Outstanding Experience
reviews.text: We had dinner outdoors surrounded by a nice view, peaceful setting, and fire pits  and to boot, the food and service was great.
reviews.author: bobk1717

reviews.title: Beautiful View
reviews.text: This is the fine dining option at The Phoenician Resort and it is suitably priced for that locale.  It is located on the top floor and most tables overlook the Phoenix valley with some located on the balcony.  It is very dark and formal looking, though many of the patrons were very casually dressed.  Our party of eight was accomodated promptly and had a great view of the surroundings.  The food and wine was all first rate and the service was acceptable.  As you might imagine, the tab was as impressive as the surroundings.  Strictly for special ocassions or expense accounts.
reviews.author: santhony

reviews.title: Valentines Dinner
reviews.text:
Went to J&G for Valentines Day this year. The meal overall was really good and the atmosphere was amazing. Incredible views. The service was excellent as well.

The crab cake appetizer was exceptional, really one of the best I have had. The potatos Gartin was also suberb. I could not say enough good things about those two items. I had the Red Wine Short Ribs, which were very average. I definetly would not order them again at any point.

After dinner we walked around the cactus garden, which was a great activity. It is right up against Camelback Mountain and lit beautifully at night. It was an incrdible way to round out the evening.
reviews.author: bbergersen

reviews.title: Upscale yet casual and romantic with delicious food and great view
reviews.text:
My husband was working in Phoenix, so I visited him for a weekend.  We decided to go to a nice dinner and chose J & G based on the recommendation of my brother.  It was fantastic!
The atmosphere was upscale, but the service was casual as opposed to uptight. Everyone in the restaurant seemed to be relaxed and having a good time.  We ordered some soups as well as steak and asparagus with a bottle of wine.  Everything tasted phenomenal.
The location is amazing.  Driving up to the lobby to reach the restaurant is a long drive of immaculate landscaping.  The restaurant has a beautiful view of Camelback and the deck has some great firepits.
After dinner, my husband and I went to the patio off the main lobby to enjoy an after dinner drink while sitting next to a gas fire pit that kept us warm.  The patio overlooks the many palm trees and pools on the grounds.
reviews.author: floondy

reviews.title: Food, Service, Ambience = All Outstanding!
reviews.text:
Our dining experience at J & G Steakhouse was truly outstanding! From the Watermelon Gazpacho, to the Shrimp Salad, from the side order of Mac & Cheese to the 8 oz. Filet Mignon - all were truly exceptional!

The service was just as good. Our waiter, Jesse, was always there if we needed something. Outstanding service!

The ambiance couldn't be any better as well. Overlooking Camelback Mountain, the setting is truly in a class all by itself (as is the Phoenician Resort!)

We shall be back on our next trip to Scottsdale!!
reviews.author: thegoodsongs

reviews.title: View great, service great... food, well...
reviews.text: For a $250 tab for 2 (no bottles of wine either), I'm looking for 5 out of 5 on all rankings.  Not so.  My med-rare bone in rib eye was way overdone, sent it back, came back, way under done.  Kept it since my wife was already 1/2 done with her entree. However, the service was great and the view from the balcony seating was great.  I doubt we'll subject ourselves to that disappointment again.  There are too many other places to chose from in Scottsdale to risk another bad steak.  Wait.. the ahi appetizer was awesome and so was the french onion soup.  Still... too expensive to risk.  Many many other options in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: gopogotom

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text:
We were staying at The Phoenecian and booked J&G for a special occasion. We both decided on the tasting menu which had 5 courses for $58. All of the courses were delicious and although they were smaller than full size dishes it was plenty of food and it was great to try so many different things. I particularly loved the tuna tartare. The petit filet came with a bunch of different sauces on the side which was nice for dipping.

Totally yummy
reviews.author: HollyHop_9

reviews.title: Only Thing Better Than the Food is The Resort View from Balcony
reviews.text: We dined on the Balcony and could almost not even enjoy the food and moment due to the breathtaking view of the manicured grounds and pool at the Phoenician. This is a must for all travelers looking for the best of the best in Scottsdale
reviews.author: Jason Anderson

reviews.title: The worst service bar none
reviews.text: Went to J&G for NYE and expected something special. Instead, we found mediocre food and the worst service I have ever experienced in a $100+ per person restaurant (or even a $50+ pp restaurant). It took 20 minutes for us to get someone's attention to take our drink order (both tables on the sides of us were doted on). The person who we managed to get to take the order turned out to be our busboy--our actual waiter didn't make an appearance until after the 2nd course! Everything that came out of the kitchen was missing something--we had to ask for plates for the appetizer, spoons for the sauces, sugar for the coffee, and the sommalier had to be asked to keep our white wine chilled. I got better service and more interesting food at the mexican place we went to the next night for $20 per person.
reviews.author: RelaxingTravels

reviews.title: If you can afford it, it's awesome!
reviews.text: Food, service, atmosphere, view, and drinks were simply outstanding. It's expensive though.
reviews.author: OraPubTraveler

reviews.title: Hey it's not Mary Elaines anymore...this is J&G Steakhouse
reviews.text:
This place that now sits where  Mary Elaines once was is a far cry from the former.
Highly recommended, but very disappointing from the beginning. Tiny side dishes that were uninspired. Onion soup too salty. Water was not filtered at all,,,very chemical tasting. Main dishes not cooked correctly & rather plain. Milanese Pork chop too dry & bready.
Stingy small glasses of (good) wine at $13-17 a pop
Add a cold room that did not improve with begging.
So don't go here...try Donovan's instead.

Scottsdale Fine Food Lover
reviews.author: scottsdalediamond
